```javascriptreact
  const image = images && images[0];

      <Link href={`/products/${slug}`} aria-label={`View ${title} details`}>
        <div className="relative aspect-square bg-gray-100 overflow-hidden cursor-pointer">
          {image ? (
            <Image
              src={image}
              alt={`${title} product image`}
              fill
              className="object-cover group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-300"
            />
          ) : (
            <div className="w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center" role="img" aria-label="Product image placeholder">
              <svg
                className="w-24 h-24 text-gray-300"
                fill="none"
                stroke="currentColor"
                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                aria-hidden="true"
              >
                <path
                  strokeLinecap="round"
                  strokeLinejoin="round"
                  strokeWidth={1}
                  d="M4 16l4.586-4.586a2 2 0 012.828 0L16 16m-2-2l1.586-1.586a2 2 0 012.828 0L20 14m-6-6h.01M6 20h12a2 2 0 002-2V6a2 2 0 00-2-2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v12a2 2 0 002 2z"
                />
              </svg>
            </div>
          )}
          
          {!inStock && (
            <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black bg-opacity-50 flex items-center justify-center" role="status">
              <span className="bg-white px-4 py-2 rounded-lg font-bold text-sm">
                OUT OF STOCK
              </span>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </Link>

      {/* Product Info */}
      <div className="p-6">
        <Link href={`/products/${slug}`}>
          <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold mb-2 group-hover:underline cursor-pointer">
            {title}
          </h3>
        </Link>
        <p className="text-2xl font-bold mb-4" aria-label={`Price: ${price.toFixed(2)} dollars`}>
          ${price.toFixed(2)}
        </p>
        
        <Link
          href={`/products/${slug}`}
          className="block w-full bg-black text-white text-center py-3 rounded-lg font-medium hover:bg-gray-800 transition-colors"
          aria-label={`View ${title} details and purchase options`}
        >
          {inStock ? 'View Details' : 'View Product'}
        </Link>
      </div>
    </article>
  );
}
```

## **Step 8: Add Google Analytics Tracking** 🟡

```javascript
/**
 * Google Analytics Integration
 * Track page views and events
 */

// Initialize Google Analytics
export const GA_MEASUREMENT_ID = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_GA_MEASUREMENT_ID;

// Track page view
export const pageview = (url) => {
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.gtag && GA_MEASUREMENT_ID) {
    window.gtag('config', GA_MEASUREMENT_ID, {
      page_path: url,
    });
  }
};

// Track custom events
export const event = ({ action, category, label, value }) => {
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.gtag && GA_MEASUREMENT_ID) {
    window.gtag('event', action, {
      event_category: category,
      event_label: label,
      value: value,
    });
  }
};

// Common event trackers
export const trackAddToCart = (product) => {
  event({
    action: 'add_to_cart',
    category: 'ecommerce',
    label: product.title,
    value: product.price,
  });
};

export const trackRemoveFromCart = (product) => {
  event({
    action: 'remove_from_cart',
    category: 'ecommerce',
    label: product.title,
    value: product.price,
  });
};

export const trackPurchase = (orderData) => {
  event({
    action: 'purchase',
    category: 'ecommerce',
    label: 'Order Completed',
    value: orderData.total || 0,
  });
};

export const trackPODSubmission = (productType) => {
  event({
    action: 'pod_submission',
    category: 'print_on_demand',
    label: productType,
  });
};

export const trackFormError = (formName, errorType) => {
  event({
    action: 'form_error',
    category: 'validation',
    label: `${formName}: ${errorType}`,
  });
};
```

```javascriptreact
'use client';

/**
 * Google Analytics Component
 * Loads GA4 script and tracks page views
 */

import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { usePathname, useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation';
import { pageview, GA_MEASUREMENT_ID } from '@/lib/analytics';
import Script from 'next/script';

export default function GoogleAnalytics() {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!GA_MEASUREMENT_ID) return;

    const url = pathname + (searchParams.toString() ? `?${searchParams.toString()}` : '');
    pageview(url);
  }, [pathname, searchParams]);

  // Don't load GA if measurement ID is not set
  if (!GA_MEASUREMENT_ID || !GA_MEASUREMENT_ID.startsWith('G-')) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <>
      <Script
        strategy="afterInteractive"
        src={`https://www.googletagmanager.com/gtag/js?id=${GA_MEASUREMENT_ID}`}
      />
      <Script
        id="google-analytics"
        strategy="afterInteractive"
        dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{
          __html: `
            window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
            function gtag(){dataLayer.push(arguments);}
            gtag('js', new Date());
            gtag('config', '${GA_MEASUREMENT_ID}', {
              page_path: window.location.pathname,
            });
          `,
        }}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

```javascriptreact
'use client';

/**
 * ProductDetail Component
 * Interactive product detail with Add to Cart
 */

import { useState } from 'react';
import Image from 'next/image';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useCart } from '@/context/CartContext';
import { useToast } from '@/context/ToastContext';
import { trackAddToCart } from '@/lib/analytics';

export default function ProductDetail({ product }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { addToCart } = useCart();

  const [selectedSize, setSelectedSize] = useState(product.sizes[0] || '');
  const [selectedColor, setSelectedColor] = useState(product.colors[0]?.name || '');
  const [quantity, setQuantity] = useState(1);
  const [addedToCart, setAddedToCart] = useState(false);

  const handleAddToCart = () => {
    if (!selectedSize || !selectedColor) {
      alert('Please select size and color');
      return;
    }

    addToCart(product, selectedSize, selectedColor, quantity);
    setAddedToCart(true);

    // Reset notification after 3 seconds
    setTimeout(() => {
      setAddedToCart(false);
    }, 3000);
  };

  const handleBuyNow = () => {
    handleAddToCart();
    router.push('/cart');
  };

  return (
    <>
      {/* Success Notification */}
      {addedToCart && (
        <div className="fixed top-20 right-4 bg-green-600 text-white px-6 py-4 rounded-lg shadow-lg z-50 animate-slide-in">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <svg
              className="w-6 h-6"
              fill="none"
              stroke="currentColor"
              viewBox="0 0 24 24"
            >
              <path
                strokeLinecap="round"
                strokeLinejoin="round"
                strokeWidth={2}
                d="M5 13l4 4L19 7"
              />
            </svg>
            <span className="font-medium">Added to cart!</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-12">
        {/* Product Images */}
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div className="aspect-square bg-gray-100 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border border-gray-200 relative">
            {product.images[0] ? (
              <Image
                src={product.images[0]}
                alt={product.title}
                fill
                className="object-cover"
              />
            ) : (
              <div className="w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center">
                <svg
                  className="w-32 h-32 text-gray-300"
                  fill="none"
                  stroke="currentColor"
                  viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                >
                  <path
                    strokeLinecap="round"
                    strokeLinejoin="round"
                    strokeWidth={1}
                    d="M4 16l4.586-4.586a2 2 0 012.828 0L16 16m-2-2l1.586-1.586a2 2 0 012.828 0L20 14m-6-6h.01M6 20h12a2 2 0 002-2V6a2 2 0 00-2-2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v12a2 2 0 002 2z"
                  />
                </svg>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Product Details */}
        <div className="space-y-6">
          <div>
            <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wide mb-2">
              {product.category}
            </p>
            <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold mb-3">{product.title}</h1>
            <p className="text-3xl font-bold">${product.price.toFixed(2)}</p>
          </div>

          <p className="text-lg text-gray-600 leading-relaxed">
            {product.description}
          </p>

          {/* Size Selection */}
          <div>
            <label className="block font-semibold mb-3 text-lg">
              Size: <span className="text-gray-600 font-normal">{selectedSize}</span>
            </label>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
              {product.sizes.map((size) => (
                <button
                  key={size}
                  onClick={() => setSelectedSize(size)}
                  className={`px-6 py-3 border-2 rounded-lg font-medium transition-all ${
                    selectedSize === size
                      ? 'border-black bg-black text-white'
                      : 'border-gray-300 hover:border-black'
                  }`}
                >
                  {size}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Color Selection */}
          <div>
            <label className="block font-semibold mb-3 text-lg">
              Color: <span className="text-gray-600 font-normal">{selectedColor}</span>
            </label>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
              {product.colors.map((color) => (
                <button
                  key={color.name}
                  onClick={() => setSelectedColor(color.name)}
                  className={`px-6 py-3 border-2 rounded-lg font-medium transition-all flex items-center gap-2 ${
                    selectedColor === color.name
                      ? 'border-black bg-black text-white'
                      : 'border-gray-300 hover:border-black'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div
                    className="w-5 h-5 rounded-full border-2"
                    style={{
                      backgroundColor: color.hex,
                      borderColor: color.hex === '#FFFFFF' ? '#e5e7eb' : color.hex,
                    }}
                  ></div>
                  {color.name}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Quantity */}
          <div>
            <label className="block font-semibold mb-3 text-lg">Quantity</label>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
              <button
                onClick={() => setQuantity(Math.max(1, quantity - 1))}
                className="w-12 h-12 border-2 border-gray-300 rounded-lg hover:border-black transition-colors font-medium text-xl"
              >
                −
              </button>
              <span className="text-2xl font-bold w-12 text-center">{quantity}</span>
              <button
                onClick={() => setQuantity(quantity + 1)}
                className="w-12 h-12 border-2 border-gray-300 rounded-lg hover:border-black transition-colors font-medium text-xl"
              >
                +
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Add to Cart Buttons */}
          <div className="space-y-3 pt-6">
            {product.inStock ? (
              <>
                <button
                  onClick={handleAddToCart}
                  className="w-full btn-primary text-lg py-4"
                >
                  Add to Cart - ${(product.price * quantity).toFixed(2)}
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={handleBuyNow}
                  className="w-full btn-secondary text-lg py-4"
                >
                  Buy Now
                </button>
              </>
            ) : (
              <button
                disabled
                className="w-full bg-gray-300 text-gray-600 px-8 py-4 rounded-lg font-medium cursor-not-allowed text-lg"
              >
                Out of Stock
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Features */}
          <div className="border-t border-gray-200 pt-6">
            <h3 className="font-bold text-xl mb-4">Features</h3>
            <ul className="space-y-2">
              {product.features.map((feature, index) => (
                <li key={index} className="flex items-start">
                  <svg
                    className="w-6 h-6 text-black mr-2 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5"
                    fill="none"
                    stroke="currentColor"
                    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                  >
                    <path
                      strokeLinecap="round"
                      strokeLinejoin="round"
                      strokeWidth={2}
                      d="M5 13l4 4L19 7"
                    />
                  </svg>
                  <span className="text-gray-700">{feature}</span>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
```

```javascriptreact
'use client';

/**

 */

import { useState } from 'react';
import Image from 'next/image';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useCart } from '@/context/CartContext';
import { useToast } from '@/context/ToastContext';
import { trackAddToCart } from '@/lib/analytics';

export default function ProductDetail({ product }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { addToCart } = useCart();
```

```javascriptreact
  const [selectedSize, setSelectedSize] = useState(product.sizes[0] || '');
  const [selectedColor, setSelectedColor] = useState(product.colors[0]?.name || '');
  const [quantity, setQuantity] = useState(1);
  const [addedToCart, setAddedToCart] = useState(false);

  const handleAddToCart = () => {
    if (!selectedSize || !selectedColor) {
      toast.warning('Please select size and color');
      return;
    }

    addToCart(product, selectedSize, selectedColor, quantity);
    setAddedToCart(true);
    
    // Track analytics
    trackAddToCart(product);
    
    toast.success(`Added ${quantity} ${product.title} to cart!`);

    // Reset notification after 3 seconds
    setTimeout(() => {
      setAddedToCart(false);
    }, 3000);

        {/* Product Details */}
        <div className="space-y-6">
          <div>
            <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wide mb-2">
              {product.category}
            </p>
            <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold mb-3">{product.title}</h1>
            <p className="text-3xl font-bold">${product.price.toFixed(2)}</p>
          </div>

          <p className="text-lg text-gray-600 leading-relaxed">
            {product.description}
          </p>

          {/* Size Selection */}
          <div>
            <label className="block font-semibold mb-3 text-lg">
              Size: <span className="text-gray-600 font-normal">{selectedSize}</span>
```

```javascriptreact
'use client';

/**
 * Checkout Page
 * Order form and confirmation
 */

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useCart } from '@/context/CartContext';
import { useToast } from '@/context/ToastContext';
import CartSummary from '@/components/CartSummary';
import { sendRegularOrderEmail } from '@/lib/order-email';
import { validateForm, commonRules } from '@/lib/validation';
import { trackPurchase } from '@/lib/analytics';

export default function CheckoutPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { cart, clearCart, getCartTotal, getCartItemsCount } = useCart();
  const toast = useToast();
  
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    customerName: '',
    customerEmail: '',
    customerPhone: '',
    customerAddress: '',
    notes: '',
  });

  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState({});

  // Redirect if cart is empty
  useEffect(() => {
    if (cart.length === 0 && !isSubmitting) {
      router.push('/cart');
    }
  }, [cart.length, isSubmitting, router]);

  // Show loading while redirecting
  if (cart.length === 0) {
    return (
      <main className="min-h-screen bg-gray-50 flex items-center justify-center">
        <div className="text-center">
          <p className="text-gray-600">Redirecting to cart...</p>
        </div>
      </main>
    );
  }

  const handleChange = (field, value) => {
    setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, [field]: value }));
    // Clear field error when user starts typing
    if (fieldErrors[field]) {
      setFieldErrors((prev) => {
        const newErrors = { ...prev };
        delete newErrors[field];
        return newErrors;
      });
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setFieldErrors({});

    // Validate form
    const validation = validateForm(formData, commonRules);
    if (!validation.isValid) {
      setFieldErrors(validation.errors);
      toast.error('Please fix the errors in the form');
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);

    try {
      // Send order email
      await sendRegularOrderEmail({
        ...formData,
        items: cart,
      });

      // Clear cart
      clearCart();

      // Show success message
      toast.success('Order placed successfully!');

      // Redirect to success page
      setTimeout(() => {
        router.push('/checkout/success');
      }, 500);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Order submission error:', err);
      toast.error('Failed to submit order. Please try again.');
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (

              </div>

              >

          {/* Order Summary */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-1">
            <CartSummary showCheckoutButton={false} />

            {/* Order Items Preview */}
            <div className="mt-6 bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-xl p-6">
              <h3 className="font-bold text-lg mb-4">Order Items ({getCartItemsCount()})</h3>
              <div className="space-y-3">
                {cart.map((item) => (
                  <div key={item.cartItemId} className="flex justify-between text-sm">
                    <div className="flex-1">
                      <p className="font-medium">{item.title}</p>
                      <p className="text-gray-600 text-xs">
                        {item.selectedSize} • {item.selectedColor} • Qty: {item.quantity}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                    <p className="font-bold">
                      ${(item.price * item.quantity).toFixed(2)}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}
```

```javascriptreact
'use client';

/**
 * Checkout Page
 * Order form and confirmation
 */

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useCart } from '@/context/CartContext';
import { useToast } from '@/context/ToastContext';
import CartSummary from '@/components/CartSummary';
import { sendRegularOrderEmail } from '@/lib/order-email';
import { validateForm, commonRules } from '@/lib/validation';
import { trackPurchase } from '@/lib/analytics';

export default function CheckoutPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { cart, clearCart, getCartTotal, getCartItemsCount } = useCart();
  const toast = useToast();
  
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    customerName: '',
    customerEmail: '',
    customerPhone: '',
    customerAddress: '',
    notes: '',
  });

  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState({});

  // Redirect if cart is empty
  useEffect(() => {
    if (cart.length === 0 && !isSubmitting) {
      router.push('/cart');
    }
  }, [cart.length, isSubmitting, router]);

  // Show loading while redirecting
  if (cart.length === 0) {
    return (
      <main className="min-h-screen bg-gray-50 flex items-center justify-center">
        <div className="text-center">
          <p className="text-gray-600">Redirecting to cart...</p>
        </div>
      </main>
    );
  }

  const handleChange = (field, value) => {
    setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, [field]: value }));
    // Clear field error when user starts typing
    if (fieldErrors[field]) {
      setFieldErrors((prev) => {
        const newErrors = { ...prev };
        delete newErrors[field];
        return newErrors;
      });
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setFieldErrors({});

    // Validate form
    const validation = validateForm(formData, commonRules);
    if (!validation.isValid) {
      setFieldErrors(validation.errors);
      toast.error('Please fix the errors in the form');
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);

    try {
      // Send order email
      await sendRegularOrderEmail({
        ...formData,
        items: cart,
      });

      // Track purchase in analytics
      const subtotal = getCartTotal();
      const shipping = subtotal > 100 ? 0 : 10;
      trackPurchase({ total: subtotal + shipping });

      // Clear cart
      clearCart();

      // Show success message
      toast.success('Order placed successfully!');

      // Redirect to success page
      setTimeout(() => {
        router.push('/checkout/success');
      }, 500);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Order submission error:', err);
      toast.error('Failed to submit order. Please try again.');
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-gray-50">
      {/* Header */}
      <section className="bg-white border-b border-gray-200">
        <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-12">
          <h1 className="text-4xl md:text-5xl font-bold">
            Checkout
          </h1>
        </div>
      </section>

      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-12">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8">
          {/* Checkout Form */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-2">
            <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-xl p-6 md:p-8">
              <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-6">Shipping Information</h2>

              <div className="space-y-6">
                {/* Full Name */}

                  <label htmlFor="customer-name" className="block mb-2 font-medium">
                    Full Name <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                  </label>
                  <input
                    id="customer-name"
                    type="text"
                    value={formData.customerName}
                    onChange={(e) => handleChange('customerName', e.target.value)}
                    className={`w-full px-4 py-3 border rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-black ${
                      fieldErrors.customerName ? 'border-red-500' : 'border-gray-300'
                    }`}
                    placeholder="John Doe"
                    aria-invalid={!!fieldErrors.customerName}
                    aria-describedby={fieldErrors.customerName ? 'name-error' : undefined}
                  />
                  {fieldErrors.customerName && (
                    <p id="name-error" className="mt-1 text-sm text-red-600" role="alert">
                      {fieldErrors.customerName}
                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Email */}
                <div>

                    Email Address <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                  </label>
                  <input
                    id="customer-email"
                    type="email"
                    value={formData.customerEmail}
                    onChange={(e) => handleChange('customerEmail', e.target.value)}
                    className={`w-full px-4 py-3 border rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-black ${
                      fieldErrors.customerEmail ? 'border-red-500' : 'border-gray-300'
                    }`}
                    placeholder="john@example.com"
                    aria-invalid={!!fieldErrors.customerEmail}

                  />
                  {fieldErrors.customerEmail && (

                    />

                  <div>
                    <h3 className="font-bold text-yellow-800 mb-1">
```

```javascriptreact
'use client';

/**
 * POD Upload Form Component
 * Complete Print-On-Demand workflow with:
 * - Product selection
 * - Size and color selection
 * - File upload with Cloudinary
 * - Live preview
 * - Shipping details form
 * - EmailJS order submission
 */

import { useState } from 'react';
import { useToast } from '@/context/ToastContext';
import { uploadToCloudinary } from '@/lib/cloudinary';
import { sendOrderEmail } from '@/lib/emailjs';
import { validateForm, commonRules } from '@/lib/validation';
import { trackPODSubmission } from '@/lib/analytics';

const PRODUCT_TYPES = ['Hoodie', 'T-shirt', 'Cap', 'Tote Bag', 'Shorts'];
const SIZES = ['S', 'M', 'L', 'XL'];
const COLORS = ['Black', 'White', 'Grey'];

export default function PodUploadForm() {
  const toast = useToast();

  // Form state
  const [step, setStep] = useState(1);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    productType: 'Hoodie',
    size: 'M',
    color: 'Black',
    designUrl: '',
    customerName: '',
    customerEmail: '',
    customerPhone: '',
    customerAddress: '',
    notes: '',
  });

  // UI state
  const [uploadedFile, setUploadedFile] = useState(null);
  const [previewUrl, setPreviewUrl] = useState('');
  const [isUploading, setIsUploading] = useState(false);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [uploadError, setUploadError] = useState('');
  const [submitSuccess, setSubmitSuccess] = useState(false);
  const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState({});

  // Handle form field changes
  const handleChange = (field, value) => {
    setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, [field]: value }));
    // Clear field error when user starts typing
    if (fieldErrors[field]) {
      setFieldErrors((prev) => {
        const newErrors = { ...prev };
        delete newErrors[field];
        return newErrors;
      });
    }
  };

  // Handle file selection
  const handleFileSelect = (e) => {
    const file = e.target.files[0];
    if (file) {
      if (!file.type.startsWith('image/')) {
        setUploadError('Please select a valid image file');
        toast.error('Please select a valid image file');
        return;
      }
      if (file.size > 10 * 1024 * 1024) {
        setUploadError('File size must be less than 10MB');
        toast.error('File size must be less than 10MB');
        return;
      }
      setUploadedFile(file);
      setPreviewUrl(URL.createObjectURL(file));
      setUploadError('');
      toast.success('Image selected successfully!');
    }
  };

  // Upload to Cloudinary
  const handleUploadToCloudinary = async () => {
    if (!uploadedFile) {
      setUploadError('Please select a file first');
      toast.error('Please select a file first');
      return;
    }

    setIsUploading(true);
    setUploadError('');

    try {
      const result = await uploadToCloudinary(uploadedFile);
      setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, designUrl: result.url }));
      toast.success('Design uploaded successfully!');
      setStep(5); // Move to shipping details
    } catch (error) {
      setUploadError('Failed to upload image. Please try again.');
      toast.error('Failed to upload image. Please try again.');
      console.error('Upload error:', error);
    } finally {
      setIsUploading(false);
    }
  };

  // Submit order
  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setFieldErrors({});
    
    if (!formData.designUrl) {
      toast.error('Please upload a design first');
      return;
    }

    // Validate form
    const validation = validateForm(formData, commonRules);
    if (!validation.isValid) {
      setFieldErrors(validation.errors);
      toast.error('Please fix the errors in the form');
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);

    try {
      await sendOrderEmail(formData);
      setSubmitSuccess(true);
      toast.success('Order placed successfully!');
      setStep(6); // Success screen
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error('Failed to submit order. Please try again.');
      console.error('Submit error:', error);
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  // Reset form
  const resetForm = () => {
    setStep(1);
    setFormData({
      productType: 'Hoodie',
      size: 'M',
      color: 'Black',
      designUrl: '',
      customerName: '',
      customerEmail: '',
      customerPhone: '',
      customerAddress: '',
      notes: '',
    });
    setUploadedFile(null);
    setPreviewUrl('');
    setSubmitSuccess(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto">
      {/* Progress Steps */}
      <div className="mb-12">
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
          {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((stepNum) => (
            <div key={stepNum} className="flex items-center">
              <div
                className={`w-10 h-10 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-bold ${
                  step >= stepNum
                    ? 'bg-black text-white'
                    : 'bg-gray-200 text-gray-400'
                }`}
              >
                {stepNum}
              </div>
              {stepNum < 5 && (
                <div
                  className={`w-16 h-1 mx-2 ${
                    step > stepNum ? 'bg-black' : 'bg-gray-200'
                  }`}
                ></div>
              )}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
        <div className="flex justify-between mt-2 text-xs text-gray-600">
          <span>Product</span>
          <span>Size</span>
          <span>Color</span>
          <span>Design</span>
          <span>Details</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Step Content */}
      <div className="bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-2xl p-8">
        {/* Step 1: Product Type */}
        {step === 1 && (
          <div className="space-y-6">
            <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold">Select Product Type</h2>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
              {PRODUCT_TYPES.map((product) => (
                <button
                  key={product}
                  onClick={() => {
                    handleChange('productType', product);
                    setStep(2);
                  }}
                  className={`p-6 border-2 rounded-lg font-semibold transition-all ${
                    formData.productType === product
                      ? 'border-black bg-black text-white'
                      : 'border-gray-200 hover:border-black'
                  }`}
                >
                  {product}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Step 2: Size */}
        {step === 2 && (
          <div className="space-y-6">
            <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold">Select Size</h2>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-4">
              {SIZES.map((size) => (
                <button
                  key={size}
                  onClick={() => {
                    handleChange('size', size);
                    setStep(3);
                  }}
                  className={`p-6 border-2 rounded-lg font-semibold text-xl transition-all ${
                    formData.size === size
                      ? 'border-black bg-black text-white'
                      : 'border-gray-200 hover:border-black'
                  }`}
                >
                  {size}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={() => setStep(1)}
              className="text-gray-600 hover:text-black"
            >
              ← Back
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Step 3: Color */}
        {step === 3 && (
          <div className="space-y-6">
            <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold">Select Color</h2>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4">
              {COLORS.map((color) => (
                <button
                  key={color}
                  onClick={() => {
                    handleChange('color', color);
                    setStep(4);
                  }}
                  className={`p-8 border-2 rounded-lg font-semibold transition-all ${
                    formData.color === color
                      ? 'border-black bg-black text-white'
                      : 'border-gray-200 hover:border-black'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div
                    className={`w-12 h-12 rounded-full mx-auto mb-3 border-2 ${
                      color === 'Black'
                        ? 'bg-black'
                        : color === 'White'
                        ? 'bg-white border-gray-300'
                        : 'bg-gray-400'
                    }`}
                  ></div>
                  {color}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={() => setStep(2)}
              className="text-gray-600 hover:text-black"
            >
              ← Back
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Step 4: Upload Design & Preview */}
        {step === 4 && (
          <div className="space-y-6">
            <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold">Upload Your Design</h2>
            
            {/* File Upload */}
            <div>
              <label className="block mb-2 font-medium">
                Choose your design file
              </label>
              <input
                type="file"
                accept="image/*"
                onChange={handleFileSelect}
                className="block w-full text-sm text-gray-600 file:mr-4 file:py-3 file:px-6 file:rounded-lg file:border-0 file:font-semibold file:bg-black file:text-white hover:file:bg-gray-800 cursor-pointer"
              />
              <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-gray-500">
                Supported formats: JPG, PNG, SVG (Max 10MB)
              </p>
            </div>

            {uploadError && (
              <div className="p-4 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 rounded-lg text-red-600">
                {uploadError}
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Live Preview */}
            {previewUrl && (
              <div className="space-y-4">
                <h3 className="text-xl font-bold">Preview</h3>
                <div className="relative bg-gray-100 rounded-lg p-8">
                  <div
                    className={`w-64 h-80 mx-auto rounded-lg relative ${
                      formData.color === 'Black'
                        ? 'bg-black'
                        : formData.color === 'White'
                        ? 'bg-white border-2 border-gray-300'
                        : 'bg-gray-400'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {/* Design overlay */}
                    <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center p-8">
                      <img
                        src={previewUrl}
                        alt="Design preview"
                        className="max-w-full max-h-full object-contain"
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-center mt-4 font-medium">
                    {formData.productType} - {formData.size} - {formData.color}
                  </p>
                </div>
                
                <button
                  onClick={handleUploadToCloudinary}
                  disabled={isUploading}
                  className="w-full btn-primary disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
                >
                  {isUploading ? 'Uploading...' : 'Continue to Shipping Details'}
                </button>
              </div>
            )}

            <button
              onClick={() => setStep(3)}
              className="text-gray-600 hover:text-black"
            >
              ← Back
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Step 5: Shipping Details */}
        {step === 5 && (
          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-6">
            <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold">Shipping Details</h2>
            
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
              <div>
                <label htmlFor="pod-name" className="block mb-2 font-medium">Full Name *</label>
                <input
                  id="pod-name"
                  type="text"
                  value={formData.customerName}
                  onChange={(e) => handleChange('customerName', e.target.value)}
                  className={`w-full px-4 py-3 border rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-black ${
                    fieldErrors.customerName ? 'border-red-500' : 'border-gray-300'
                  }`}
                  placeholder="John Doe"
                  aria-invalid={!!fieldErrors.customerName}
                  aria-describedby={fieldErrors.customerName ? 'pod-name-error' : undefined}
                />
                {fieldErrors.customerName && (
                  <p id="pod-name-error" className="mt-1 text-sm text-red-600" role="alert">
                    {fieldErrors.customerName}
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>

              <div>
                <label htmlFor="pod-email" className="block mb-2 font-medium">Email *</label>
                <input
                  id="pod-email"
                  type="email"
                  value={formData.customerEmail}
                  onChange={(e) => handleChange('customerEmail', e.target.value)}
                  className={`w-full px-4 py-3 border rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-black ${
                    fieldErrors.customerEmail ? 'border-red-500' : 'border-gray-300'
                  }`}
                  placeholder="john@example.com"
                  aria-invalid={!!fieldErrors.customerEmail}
                  aria-describedby={fieldErrors.customerEmail ? 'pod-email-error' : undefined}
                />
                {fieldErrors.customerEmail && (
                  <p id="pod-email-error" className="mt-1 text-sm text-red-600" role="alert">
                    {fieldErrors.customerEmail}
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>

              <div>
                <label htmlFor="pod-phone" className="block mb-2 font-medium">Phone *</label>
                <input
                  id="pod-phone"
                  type="tel"
                  value={formData.customerPhone}
                  onChange={(e) => handleChange('customerPhone', e.target.value)}
                  className={`w-full px-4 py-3 border rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-black ${
                    fieldErrors.customerPhone ? 'border-red-500' : 'border-gray-300'
                  }`}
                  placeholder="+1 234 567 8900"
                  aria-invalid={!!fieldErrors.customerPhone}
                  aria-describedby={fieldErrors.customerPhone ? 'pod-phone-error' : undefined}
                />
                {fieldErrors.customerPhone && (
                  <p id="pod-phone-error" className="mt-1 text-sm text-red-600" role="alert">
                    {fieldErrors.customerPhone}
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>

              <div className="md:col-span-2">
                <label htmlFor="pod-address" className="block mb-2 font-medium">
                  Shipping Address *
                </label>
                <textarea
                  id="pod-address"
                  value={formData.customerAddress}
                  onChange={(e) => handleChange('customerAddress', e.target.value)}
                  rows={3}
                  className={`w-full px-4 py-3 border rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-black ${
                    fieldErrors.customerAddress ? 'border-red-500' : 'border-gray-300'
                  }`}
                  placeholder="123 Main St, City, State, ZIP"
                  aria-invalid={!!fieldErrors.customerAddress}
                  aria-describedby={fieldErrors.customerAddress ? 'pod-address-error' : undefined}
                />
                {fieldErrors.customerAddress && (
                  <p id="pod-address-error" className="mt-1 text-sm text-red-600" role="alert">
                    {fieldErrors.customerAddress}
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>

              <div className="md:col-span-2">
                <label htmlFor="pod-notes" className="block mb-2 font-medium">
                  Additional Notes (Optional)
                </label>
                <textarea
                  id="pod-notes"
                  value={formData.notes}
                  onChange={(e) => handleChange('notes', e.target.value)}
                  rows={3}
                  className="w-full px-4 py-3 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-black"
                  placeholder="Any special instructions..."
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Order Summary */}
            <div className="bg-gray-50 p-6 rounded-lg border border-gray-200">
              <h3 className="font-bold text-xl mb-4">Order Summary</h3>
              <div className="space-y-2 text-sm">
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span>Product:</span>
                  <span className="font-medium">{formData.productType}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span>Size:</span>
                  <span className="font-medium">{formData.size}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span>Color:</span>
                  <span className="font-medium">{formData.color}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span>Payment:</span>
                  <span className="font-medium">Cash on Delivery</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex gap-4">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setStep(4)}
                className="btn-secondary flex-1"
              >
                ← Back
              </button>
              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={isSubmitting}
                className="btn-primary flex-1 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
              >
                {isSubmitting ? 'Submitting...' : 'Place Order (COD)'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        )}

        {/* Step 6: Success */}
        {step === 6 && submitSuccess && (
          <div className="text-center space-y-6 py-12">
            <div className="w-20 h-20 bg-green-100 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mx-auto">
              <svg
                className="w-10 h-10 text-green-600"
                fill="none"
                stroke="currentColor"
                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
              >
                <path
                  strokeLinecap="round"
                  strokeLinejoin="round"
                  strokeWidth={2}
                  d="M5 13l4 4L19 7"
                />
              </svg>
            </div>
            <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold">Order Placed Successfully!</h2>
            <p className="text-gray-600 max-w-md mx-auto">
              Thank you for your order!
              <br /><br />
              We'll contact you soon to confirm your order.
            </p>
            <div className="bg-gray-50 p-6 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 max-w-md mx-auto">
              <h3 className="font-bold mb-4">Order Details</h3>
              <div className="space-y-2 text-sm text-left">
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span>Product:</span>
                  <span className="font-medium">{formData.productType}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span>Size:</span>
                  <span className="font-medium">{formData.size}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span>Color:</span>
                  <span className="font-medium">{formData.color}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span>Payment:</span>
                  <span className="font-medium">Cash on Delivery</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="flex gap-4 justify-center">
              <button onClick={resetForm} className="btn-primary">
                Place Another Order
              </button>
              <a href="/" className="btn-secondary">
                Back to Home
              </a>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```javascriptreact
'use client';

/**
 * POD Upload Form Component
 * Complete Print-On-Demand workflow with:
 * - Product selection
 * - Size and color selection
 * - File upload with Cloudinary
 * - Live preview
 * - Shipping details form
 * - EmailJS order submission
 */

import { useState } from 'react';
import { useToast } from '@/context/ToastContext';
import { uploadToCloudinary } from '@/lib/cloudinary';
import { sendOrderEmail } from '@/lib/emailjs';
import { validateForm, commonRules } from '@/lib/validation';
import { trackPODSubmission } from '@/lib/analytics';

const PRODUCT_TYPES = ['Hoodie', 'T-shirt', 'Cap', 'Tote Bag', 'Shorts'];
const SIZES = ['S', 'M', 'L', 'XL'];
const COLORS = ['Black', 'White', 'Grey'];

export default function PodUploadForm() {
  const toast = useToast();

  // Form state
  const [step, setStep] = useState(1);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    productType: 'Hoodie',
    size: 'M',
    color: 'Black',
    designUrl: '',
    customerName: '',
    customerEmail: '',
    customerPhone: '',
    customerAddress: '',
    notes: '',
  });

  // UI state
  const [uploadedFile, setUploadedFile] = useState(null);
  const [previewUrl, setPreviewUrl] = useState('');
  const [isUploading, setIsUploading] = useState(false);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [uploadError, setUploadError] = useState('');
  const [submitSuccess, setSubmitSuccess] = useState(false);
  const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState({});

  // Handle form field changes
  const handleChange = (field, value) => {
    setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, [field]: value }));
    // Clear field error when user starts typing
    if (fieldErrors[field]) {
      setFieldErrors((prev) => {
        const newErrors = { ...prev };
        delete newErrors[field];
        return newErrors;
      });
    }
  };

  // Handle file selection
  const handleFileSelect = (e) => {
    const file = e.target.files[0];
    if (file) {
      if (!file.type.startsWith('image/')) {
        setUploadError('Please select a valid image file');
        toast.error('Please select a valid image file');
        return;
      }
      if (file.size > 10 * 1024 * 1024) {
        setUploadError('File size must be less than 10MB');
        toast.error('File size must be less than 10MB');
        return;
      }
      setUploadedFile(file);
      setPreviewUrl(URL.createObjectURL(file));
      setUploadError('');
      toast.success('Image selected successfully!');
    }
  };

  // Upload to Cloudinary
  const handleUploadToCloudinary = async () => {
    if (!uploadedFile) {
      setUploadError('Please select a file first');
      toast.error('Please select a file first');
      return;
    }

    setIsUploading(true);
    setUploadError('');

    try {
      const result = await uploadToCloudinary(uploadedFile);
      setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, designUrl: result.url }));
      toast.success('Design uploaded successfully!');
      setStep(5); // Move to shipping details
    } catch (error) {
      setUploadError('Failed to upload image. Please try again.');
      toast.error('Failed to upload image. Please try again.');
      console.error('Upload error:', error);
    } finally {
      setIsUploading(false);
    }
  };

  // Submit order
  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setFieldErrors({});
    
    if (!formData.designUrl) {
      toast.error('Please upload a design first');
      return;
    }

    // Validate form
    const validation = validateForm(formData, commonRules);
    if (!validation.isValid) {
      setFieldErrors(validation.errors);
      toast.error('Please fix the errors in the form');
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);

    try {
      await sendOrderEmail(formData);
      
      // Track POD submission in analytics
      trackPODSubmission(formData.productType);
      
      setSubmitSuccess(true);
      toast.success('Order placed successfully!');
      setStep(6); // Success screen
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error('Failed to submit order. Please try again.');
      console.error('Submit error:', error);
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  // Reset form
  const resetForm = () => {
    setStep(1);
    setFormData({
      productType: 'Hoodie',
      size: 'M',
      color: 'Black',
      designUrl: '',
      customerName: '',
      customerEmail: '',
      customerPhone: '',
      customerAddress: '',
      notes: '',
    });
    setUploadedFile(null);
    setPreviewUrl('');
    setSubmitSuccess(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto">
      {/* Progress Steps */}
      <div className="mb-12">
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
          {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((stepNum) => (
            <div key={stepNum} className="flex items-center">
              <div
                className={`w-10 h-10 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-bold ${
                  step >= stepNum
                    ? 'bg-black text-white'
                    : 'bg-gray-200 text-gray-400'
                }`}
              >
                {stepNum}
              </div>
              {stepNum < 5 && (
                <div
                  className={`w-16 h-1 mx-2 ${
                    step > stepNum ? 'bg-black' : 'bg-gray-200'
                  }`}
                ></div>
              )}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
        <div className="flex justify-between mt-2 text-xs text-gray-600">
          <span>Product</span>
          <span>Size</span>
          <span>Color</span>
          <span>Design</span>
          <span>Details</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Step Content */}
      <div className="bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-2xl p-8">
        {/* Step 1: Product Type */}
        {step === 1 && (
          <div className="space-y-6">
            <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold">Select Product Type</h2>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
              {PRODUCT_TYPES.map((product) => (
                <button
                  key={product}
                  onClick={() => {
                    handleChange('productType', product);
                    setStep(2);
                  }}
                  className={`p-6 border-2 rounded-lg font-semibold transition-all ${
                    formData.productType === product
                      ? 'border-black bg-black text-white'
                      : 'border-gray-200 hover:border-black'
                  }`}
                >
                  {product}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Step 2: Size */}
        {step === 2 && (
          <div className="space-y-6">
            <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold">Select Size</h2>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-4">
              {SIZES.map((size) => (
                <button
                  key={size}
                  onClick={() => {
                    handleChange('size', size);
                    setStep(3);
                  }}
                  className={`p-6 border-2 rounded-lg font-semibold text-xl transition-all ${
                    formData.size === size
                      ? 'border-black bg-black text-white'
                      : 'border-gray-200 hover:border-black'
                  }`}
                >
                  {size}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={() => setStep(1)}
              className="text-gray-600 hover:text-black"
            >
              ← Back
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Step 3: Color */}
        {step === 3 && (
          <div className="space-y-6">
            <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold">Select Color</h2>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4">
              {COLORS.map((color) => (
                <button
                  key={color}
                  onClick={() => {
                    handleChange('color', color);
                    setStep(4);
                  }}
                  className={`p-8 border-2 rounded-lg font-semibold transition-all ${
                    formData.color === color
                      ? 'border-black bg-black text-white'
                      : 'border-gray-200 hover:border-black'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div
                    className={`w-12 h-12 rounded-full mx-auto mb-3 border-2 ${
                      color === 'Black'
                        ? 'bg-black'
                        : color === 'White'
                        ? 'bg-white border-gray-300'
                        : 'bg-gray-400'
                    }`}
                  ></div>
                  {color}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={() => setStep(2)}
              className="text-gray-600 hover:text-black"
            >
              ← Back
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Step 4: Upload Design & Preview */}
        {step === 4 && (
          <div className="space-y-6">
            <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold">Upload Your Design</h2>
            
            {/* File Upload */}
            <div>
              <label className="block mb-2 font-medium">
                Choose your design file
              </label>
              <input
                type="file"
                accept="image/*"
                onChange={handleFileSelect}
                className="block w-full text-sm text-gray-600 file:mr-4 file:py-3 file:px-6 file:rounded-lg file:border-0 file:font-semibold file:bg-black file:text-white hover:file:bg-gray-800 cursor-pointer"
              />
              <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-gray-500">
                Supported formats: JPG, PNG, SVG (Max 10MB)
              </p>
            </div>

            {uploadError && (
              <div className="p-4 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 rounded-lg text-red-600">
                {uploadError}
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Live Preview */}
            {previewUrl && (
              <div className="space-y-4">
                <h3 className="text-xl font-bold">Preview</h3>
                <div className="relative bg-gray-100 rounded-lg p-8">
                  <div
                    className={`w-64 h-80 mx-auto rounded-lg relative ${
                      formData.color === 'Black'
                        ? 'bg-black'
                        : formData.color === 'White'
                        ? 'bg-white border-2 border-gray-300'
                        : 'bg-gray-400'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {/* Design overlay */}
                    <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center p-8">
                      <img
                        src={previewUrl}
                        alt="Design preview"
                        className="max-w-full max-h-full object-contain"
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-center mt-4 font-medium">
                    {formData.productType} - {formData.size} - {formData.color}
                  </p>
                </div>
                
                <button
                  onClick={handleUploadToCloudinary}
                  disabled={isUploading}
                  className="w-full btn-primary disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
                >
                  {isUploading ? 'Uploading...' : 'Continue to Shipping Details'}
                </button>
              </div>
            )}

            <button
              onClick={() => setStep(3)}
              className="text-gray-600 hover:text-black"
            >
              ← Back
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Step 5: Shipping Details */}
        {step === 5 && (
          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-6">
            <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold">Shipping Details</h2>
            
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
              <div>
                <label htmlFor="pod-name" className="block mb-2 font-medium">Full Name *</label>
                <input
                  id="pod-name"
                  type="text"
                  value={formData.customerName}
                  onChange={(e) => handleChange('customerName', e.target.value)}
                  className={`w-full px-4 py-3 border rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-black ${
                    fieldErrors.customerName ? 'border-red-500' : 'border-gray-300'
                  }`}
                  placeholder="John Doe"
                  aria-invalid={!!fieldErrors.customerName}
                  aria-describedby={fieldErrors.customerName ? 'pod-name-error' : undefined}
                />
                {fieldErrors.customerName && (
                  <p id="pod-name-error" className="mt-1 text-sm text-red-600" role="alert">
                    {fieldErrors.customerName}
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>

              <div>
                <label htmlFor="pod-email" className="block mb-2 font-medium">Email *</label>
                <input
                  id="pod-email"
                  type="email"
                  value={formData.customerEmail}
                  onChange={(e) => handleChange('customerEmail', e.target.value)}
                  className={`w-full px-4 py-3 border rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-black ${

              <div className="md:col-span-2">

              <div className="md:col-span-2">

                <textarea
                  id="pod-notes"

                  onChange={(e) => handleChange('notes', e.target.value)}
                  rows={3}
                  className="w-full px-4 py-3 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-black"
                  placeholder="Any special instructions..."
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Order Summary */}
            <div className="bg-gray-50 p-6 rounded-lg border border-gray-200">
              <h3 className="font-bold text-xl mb-4">Order Summary</h3>
              <div className="space-y-2 text-sm">
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span>Product:</span>
                  <span className="font-medium">{formData.productType}</span>

                <div className="flex justify-between">

            <div className="flex gap-4">
              <button
                type="button"

                ← Back
              </button>
              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={isSubmitting}
                className="btn-primary flex-1 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
              >
                {isSubmitting ? 'Submitting...' : 'Place Order (COD)'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        )}

        {/* Step 6: Success */}
        {step === 6 && submitSuccess && (
          <div className="text-center space-y-6 py-12">
            <div className="w-20 h-20 bg-green-100 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mx-auto">
              <svg
                className="w-10 h-10 text-green-600"
                fill="none"
                stroke="currentColor"
                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
              >
                <path
                  strokeLinecap="round"
                  strokeLinejoin="round"
                  strokeWidth={2}
                  d="M5 13l4 4L19 7"
                />
              </svg>
            </div>
            <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold">Order Placed Successfully!</h2>
            <p className="text-gray-600 max-w-md mx-auto">
              Thank you for your order!
              <br /><br />
              We'll contact you soon to confirm your order.
            </p>
            <div className="bg-gray-50 p-6 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 max-w-md mx-auto">
              <h3 className="font-bold mb-4">Order Details</h3>
              <div className="space-y-2 text-sm text-left">
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span>Product:</span>
                  <span className="font-medium">{formData.productType}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span>Size:</span>
                  <span className="font-medium">{formData.size}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span>Color:</span>
                  <span className="font-medium">{formData.color}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span>Payment:</span>
                  <span className="font-medium">Cash on Delivery</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="flex gap-4 justify-center">
              <button onClick={resetForm} className="btn-primary">
                Place Another Order
              </button>
              <a href="/" className="btn-secondary">
                Back to Home
              </a>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## **Step 9: Implement Customer Email Confirmations** 🟡

```javascript
/**
 * Customer Email Confirmation
 * Sends order confirmation emails to customers
 */

import emailjs from '@emailjs/browser';

/**
 * Send confirmation email to customer for regular orders
 */
export async function sendCustomerOrderConfirmation(orderData) {
  const serviceId = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_EMAILJS_SERVICE_ID;
  // You can create a separate template for customer confirmations
  const templateId = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_EMAILJS_CUSTOMER_TEMPLATE_ID || process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_EMAILJS_TEMPLATE_ID;
  const userId = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_EMAILJS_USER_ID;

  if (!serviceId || !templateId || !userId) {
    console.warn('EmailJS not configured for customer emails');
    return;
  }

  try {
    // Format cart items
    const itemsList = orderData.items
      .map((item, index) => {
        return `${index + 1}. ${item.title} (${item.selectedSize}, ${item.selectedColor}) x${item.quantity} - $${(item.price * item.quantity).toFixed(2)}`;
      })
      .join('\n');

    // Calculate totals
    const subtotal = orderData.items.reduce(
      (sum, item) => sum + item.price * item.quantity,
      0
    );
    const shipping = subtotal > 100 ? 0 : 10;
    const total = subtotal + shipping;

    const templateParams = {
      // Customer Information
      to_name: orderData.customerName,
      to_email: orderData.customerEmail,
      customer_name: orderData.customerName,
      customer_email: orderData.customerEmail,
      customer_phone: orderData.customerPhone,
      customer_address: orderData.customerAddress,
      
      // Order Items
      order_items: itemsList,
      items_count: orderData.items.length,
      
      // Order Totals
      subtotal: `$${subtotal.toFixed(2)}`,
      shipping: shipping === 0 ? 'FREE' : `$${shipping.toFixed(2)}`,
      total: `$${total.toFixed(2)}`,
      
      // Additional Information
      order_notes: orderData.notes || 'No additional notes',
      order_date: new Date().toLocaleString(),
      order_type: 'Regular Order',
      
      // Email subject
      subject: `Order Confirmation - Coobraa`,
    };

    const response = await emailjs.send(
      serviceId,
      templateId,
      templateParams,
      userId
    );

    return response.status === 200;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Customer email error:', error);
    // Don't throw error - customer email is not critical
    return false;
  }
}

/**
 * Send confirmation email to customer for POD orders
 */
export async function sendCustomerPODConfirmation(orderData) {
  const serviceId = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_EMAILJS_SERVICE_ID;
  const templateId = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_EMAILJS_CUSTOMER_TEMPLATE_ID || process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_EMAILJS_TEMPLATE_ID;
  const userId = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_EMAILJS_USER_ID;

  if (!serviceId || !templateId || !userId) {
    console.warn('EmailJS not configured for customer emails');
    return;
  }

  try {
    const templateParams = {
      // Customer Information
      to_name: orderData.customerName,
      to_email: orderData.customerEmail,
      customer_name: orderData.customerName,
      customer_email: orderData.customerEmail,
      customer_phone: orderData.customerPhone,
      customer_address: orderData.customerAddress,
      
      // POD Order Details
      product_type: orderData.productType,
      product_size: orderData.size,
      product_color: orderData.color,
      design_url: orderData.designUrl,
      
      // Additional Information
      order_notes: orderData.notes || 'No additional notes',
      order_date: new Date().toLocaleString(),
      order_type: 'Print-On-Demand Order',
      
      // Email subject
      subject: `POD Order Confirmation - Coobraa`,
    };

    const response = await emailjs.send(
      serviceId,
      templateId,
      templateParams,
      userId
    );

    return response.status === 200;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Customer email error:', error);
    // Don't throw error - customer email is not critical
    return false;
  }
}
```

```javascriptreact
'use client';

/**
 * Checkout Page
 * Order form and confirmation
 */

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useCart } from '@/context/CartContext';
import { useToast } from '@/context/ToastContext';
import CartSummary from '@/components/CartSummary';
import { sendRegularOrderEmail } from '@/lib/order-email';
import { sendCustomerOrderConfirmation } from '@/lib/customer-email';
import { validateForm, commonRules } from '@/lib/validation';
import { trackPurchase } from '@/lib/analytics';

export default function CheckoutPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { cart, clearCart, getCartTotal, getCartItemsCount } = useCart();
  const toast = useToast();
  
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    customerName: '',
    customerEmail: '',
    customerPhone: '',
    customerAddress: '',
    notes: '',
  });

  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState({});

  // Redirect if cart is empty
  useEffect(() => {
    if (cart.length === 0 && !isSubmitting) {
      router.push('/cart');
    }
  }, [cart.length, isSubmitting, router]);

  // Show loading while redirecting
  if (cart.length === 0) {
    return (
      <main className="min-h-screen bg-gray-50 flex items-center justify-center">
        <div className="text-center">
          <p className="text-gray-600">Redirecting to cart...</p>
        </div>
      </main>
    );
  }

  const handleChange = (field, value) => {
    setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, [field]: value }));
    // Clear field error when user starts typing
    if (fieldErrors[field]) {
      setFieldErrors((prev) => {
        const newErrors = { ...prev };
        delete newErrors[field];
        return newErrors;
      });
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setFieldErrors({});

    // Validate form
    const validation = validateForm(formData, commonRules);
    if (!validation.isValid) {
      setFieldErrors(validation.errors);
      toast.error('Please fix the errors in the form');
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);

    try {
      // Send order email
      await sendRegularOrderEmail({
        ...formData,
        items: cart,
      });

      // Track purchase in analytics
      const subtotal = getCartTotal();
      const shipping = subtotal > 100 ? 0 : 10;
      trackPurchase({ total: subtotal + shipping });

      // Clear cart
      clearCart();

      // Show success message
      toast.success('Order placed successfully!');

      // Redirect to success page
      setTimeout(() => {
        router.push('/checkout/success');
      }, 500);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Order submission error:', err);
      toast.error('Failed to submit order. Please try again.');
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-gray-50">
      {/* Header */}
      <section className="bg-white border-b border-gray-200">
        <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-12">
          <h1 className="text-4xl md:text-5xl font-bold">
            Checkout
          </h1>
        </div>
      </section>

      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-12">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8">
          {/* Checkout Form */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-2">
            <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-xl p-6 md:p-8">
              <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-6">Shipping Information</h2>

              <div className="space-y-6">
                {/* Full Name */}
                <div>
                  <label htmlFor="customer-name" className="block mb-2 font-medium">
                    Full Name <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                  </label>
                  <input
                    id="customer-name"
                    type="text"
                    value={formData.customerName}
                    onChange={(e) => handleChange('customerName', e.target.value)}
                    className={`w-full px-4 py-3 border rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-black ${
                      fieldErrors.customerName ? 'border-red-500' : 'border-gray-300'
                    }`}
                    placeholder="John Doe"
                    aria-invalid={!!fieldErrors.customerName}
                    aria-describedby={fieldErrors.customerName ? 'name-error' : undefined}
                  />
                  {fieldErrors.customerName && (
                    <p id="name-error" className="mt-1 text-sm text-red-600" role="alert">
                      {fieldErrors.customerName}
                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Email */}
                <div>
                  <label htmlFor="customer-email" className="block mb-2 font-medium">
                    Email Address <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                  </label>
                  <input
                    id="customer-email"
                    type="email"
                    value={formData.customerEmail}
                    onChange={(e) => handleChange('customerEmail', e.target.value)}
                    className={`w-full px-4 py-3 border rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-black ${
                      fieldErrors.customerEmail ? 'border-red-500' : 'border-gray-300'
                    }`}
                    placeholder="john@example.com"
                    aria-invalid={!!fieldErrors.customerEmail}
                    aria-describedby={fieldErrors.customerEmail ? 'email-error' : undefined}
                  />
                  {fieldErrors.customerEmail && (
                    <p id="email-error" className="mt-1 text-sm text-red-600" role="alert">
                      {fieldErrors.customerEmail}
                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Phone */}
                <div>
                  <label htmlFor="customer-phone" className="block mb-2 font-medium">
                    Phone Number <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                  </label>
                  <input
                    id="customer-phone"
                    type="tel"
                    value={formData.customerPhone}
                    onChange={(e) => handleChange('customerPhone', e.target.value)}
                    className={`w-full px-4 py-3 border rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-black ${
                      fieldErrors.customerPhone ? 'border-red-500' : 'border-gray-300'
                    }`}
                    placeholder="+1 234 567 8900"
                    aria-invalid={!!fieldErrors.customerPhone}
                    aria-describedby={fieldErrors.customerPhone ? 'phone-error' : undefined}
                  />
                  {fieldErrors.customerPhone && (
                    <p id="phone-error" className="mt-1 text-sm text-red-600" role="alert">
                      {fieldErrors.customerPhone}
                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Address */}
                <div>
                  <label htmlFor="customer-address" className="block mb-2 font-medium">
                    Shipping Address <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                  </label>
                  <textarea
                    id="customer-address"
                    value={formData.customerAddress}
                    onChange={(e) => handleChange('customerAddress', e.target.value)}
                    rows={4}
                    className={`w-full px-4 py-3 border rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-black resize-none ${
                      fieldErrors.customerAddress ? 'border-red-500' : 'border-gray-300'
                    }`}
                    placeholder="Street address, City, State, ZIP Code"
                    aria-invalid={!!fieldErrors.customerAddress}
                    aria-describedby={fieldErrors.customerAddress ? 'address-error' : undefined}
                  />
                  {fieldErrors.customerAddress && (
                    <p id="address-error" className="mt-1 text-sm text-red-600" role="alert">
                      {fieldErrors.customerAddress}
                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Notes */}
                <div>
                  <label htmlFor="order-notes" className="block mb-2 font-medium">
                    Order Notes (Optional)
                  </label>
                  <textarea
                    id="order-notes"
                    value={formData.notes}
                    onChange={(e) => handleChange('notes', e.target.value)}
                    rows={3}
                    className="w-full px-4 py-3 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-black resize-none"
                    placeholder="Any special instructions for your order..."
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Payment Method */}
              <div className="mt-8 p-6 bg-yellow-50 border border-yellow-200 rounded-lg">
                <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                  <svg
                    className="w-6 h-6 text-yellow-600 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5"
                    fill="none"
                    stroke="currentColor"
                    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                  >
                    <path
                      strokeLinecap="round"
                      strokeLinejoin="round"
                      strokeWidth={2}
                      d="M12 8c-1.657 0-3 .895-3 2s1.343 2 3 2 3 .895 3 2-1.343 2-3 2m0-8c1.11 0 2.08.402 2.599 1M12 8V7m0 1v8m0 0v1m0-1c-1.11 0-2.08-.402-2.599-1M21 12a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z"
                    />
                  </svg>
                  <div>
                    <h3 className="font-bold text-yellow-800 mb-1">
                      Payment Method: Cash on Delivery
                    </h3>
                    <p className="text-sm text-yellow-700">
                      You'll pay when you receive your order. We'll contact you to confirm delivery details.
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Submit Button */}
              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={isSubmitting}
                className="w-full mt-8 btn-primary text-lg py-4 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
              >
                {isSubmitting ? 'Processing Order...' : 'Place Order'}
              </button>
            </form>
          </div>

          {/* Order Summary */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-1">
            <CartSummary showCheckoutButton={false} />

            {/* Order Items Preview */}
            <div className="mt-6 bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-xl p-6">
              <h3 className="font-bold text-lg mb-4">Order Items ({getCartItemsCount()})</h3>
              <div className="space-y-3">
                {cart.map((item) => (
                  <div key={item.cartItemId} className="flex justify-between text-sm">
                    <div className="flex-1">
                      <p className="font-medium">{item.title}</p>
                      <p className="text-gray-600 text-xs">
                        {item.selectedSize} • {item.selectedColor} • Qty: {item.quantity}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                    <p className="font-bold">
                      ${(item.price * item.quantity).toFixed(2)}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}
```

```javascriptreact
'use client';

/**

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useCart } from '@/context/CartContext';
import { useToast } from '@/context/ToastContext';
import CartSummary from '@/components/CartSummary';
```
