import { sendCustomerOrderConfirmation } from '@/lib/customer-email';
import { validateForm, commonRules } from '@/lib/validation';
import { trackPurchase } from '@/lib/analytics';

export default function CheckoutPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { cart, clearCart, getCartTotal, getCartItemsCount } = useCart();
  const toast = useToast();
  
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    customerName: '',
    customerEmail: '',
    customerPhone: '',
    customerAddress: '',
    notes: '',
  });

  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState({});

  // Redirect if cart is empty
  useEffect(() => {
    if (cart.length === 0 && !isSubmitting) {
      router.push('/cart');
    }
  }, [cart.length, isSubmitting, router]);

  // Show loading while redirecting
  if (cart.length === 0) {
    return (
      <main className="min-h-screen bg-gray-50 flex items-center justify-center">
        <div className="text-center">
          <p className="text-gray-600">Redirecting to cart...</p>
        </div>
      </main>
    );
  }

  const handleChange = (field, value) => {
    setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, [field]: value }));
    // Clear field error when user starts typing
    if (fieldErrors[field]) {
      setFieldErrors((prev) => {
        const newErrors = { ...prev };
        delete newErrors[field];
        return newErrors;
      });
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setFieldErrors({});

    // Validate form
    const validation = validateForm(formData, commonRules);
    if (!validation.isValid) {
      setFieldErrors(validation.errors);
      toast.error('Please fix the errors in the form');
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);

    try {
      const orderInfo = {
        ...formData,
        items: cart,
      };

      // Send order email to business
      await sendRegularOrderEmail(orderInfo);

      // Send confirmation email to customer (non-blocking)
      sendCustomerOrderConfirmation(orderInfo).catch(err => {
        console.error('Failed to send customer confirmation:', err);
        // Don't block the order - just log the error
      });

      // Track purchase in analytics
      const subtotal = getCartTotal();
      const shipping = subtotal > 100 ? 0 : 10;
      trackPurchase({ total: subtotal + shipping });

      // Clear cart
      clearCart();

      // Show success message
      toast.success('Order placed successfully! Check your email for confirmation.');

      // Redirect to success page
      setTimeout(() => {
        router.push('/checkout/success');
      }, 500);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Order submission error:', err);
      toast.error('Failed to submit order. Please try again.');
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-gray-50">
      {/* Header */}

        <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-12">

            Checkout

            <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-xl p-6 md:p-8">
              <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-6">Shipping Information</h2>

              <div className="space-y-6">
                {/* Full Name */}
                <div>
                  <label htmlFor="customer-name" className="block mb-2 font-medium">
                    Full Name <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                  </label>
                  <input
                    id="customer-name"
                    type="text"
                    value={formData.customerName}
                    onChange={(e) => handleChange('customerName', e.target.value)}
                    className={`w-full px-4 py-3 border rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-black ${
                      fieldErrors.customerName ? 'border-red-500' : 'border-gray-300'
                    }`}
                    placeholder="John Doe"
                    aria-invalid={!!fieldErrors.customerName}
                    aria-describedby={fieldErrors.customerName ? 'name-error' : undefined}
                  />
                  {fieldErrors.customerName && (
                    <p id="name-error" className="mt-1 text-sm text-red-600" role="alert">
                      {fieldErrors.customerName}
                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Email */}
                <div>
                  <label htmlFor="customer-email" className="block mb-2 font-medium">
                    Email Address <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                  </label>
                  <input
                    id="customer-email"
                    type="email"
                    value={formData.customerEmail}
                    onChange={(e) => handleChange('customerEmail', e.target.value)}
                    className={`w-full px-4 py-3 border rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-black ${
                      fieldErrors.customerEmail ? 'border-red-500' : 'border-gray-300'
                    }`}
                    placeholder="john@example.com"
                    aria-invalid={!!fieldErrors.customerEmail}
                    aria-describedby={fieldErrors.customerEmail ? 'email-error' : undefined}
                  />
                  {fieldErrors.customerEmail && (
                    <p id="email-error" className="mt-1 text-sm text-red-600" role="alert">
                      {fieldErrors.customerEmail}
                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Phone */}
                <div>
                  <label htmlFor="customer-phone" className="block mb-2 font-medium">
                    Phone Number <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                  </label>
                  <input
                    id="customer-phone"
                    type="tel"
                    value={formData.customerPhone}
                    onChange={(e) => handleChange('customerPhone', e.target.value)}
                    className={`w-full px-4 py-3 border rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-black ${
                      fieldErrors.customerPhone ? 'border-red-500' : 'border-gray-300'
                    }`}
                    placeholder="+1 234 567 8900"
                    aria-invalid={!!fieldErrors.customerPhone}
                    aria-describedby={fieldErrors.customerPhone ? 'phone-error' : undefined}
                  />
                  {fieldErrors.customerPhone && (
                    <p id="phone-error" className="mt-1 text-sm text-red-600" role="alert">
                      {fieldErrors.customerPhone}
                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Address */}
                <div>
                  <label htmlFor="customer-address" className="block mb-2 font-medium">
                    Shipping Address <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                  </label>
                  <textarea
                    id="customer-address"
                    value={formData.customerAddress}
                    onChange={(e) => handleChange('customerAddress', e.target.value)}
                    rows={4}
                    className={`w-full px-4 py-3 border rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-black resize-none ${
                      fieldErrors.customerAddress ? 'border-red-500' : 'border-gray-300'
                    }`}
                    placeholder="Street address, City, State, ZIP Code"
                    aria-invalid={!!fieldErrors.customerAddress}
                    aria-describedby={fieldErrors.customerAddress ? 'address-error' : undefined}
                  />
                  {fieldErrors.customerAddress && (
                    <p id="address-error" className="mt-1 text-sm text-red-600" role="alert">
                      {fieldErrors.customerAddress}
                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Notes */}
                <div>
                  <label htmlFor="order-notes" className="block mb-2 font-medium">
                    Order Notes (Optional)
                  </label>
                  <textarea
                    id="order-notes"
                    value={formData.notes}
                    onChange={(e) => handleChange('notes', e.target.value)}
                    rows={3}
                    className="w-full px-4 py-3 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-black resize-none"
                    placeholder="Any special instructions for your order..."
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Payment Method */}
              <div className="mt-8 p-6 bg-yellow-50 border border-yellow-200 rounded-lg">
                <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                  <svg
                    className="w-6 h-6 text-yellow-600 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5"
                    fill="none"
                    stroke="currentColor"
                    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                  >
                    <path
                      strokeLinecap="round"
                      strokeLinejoin="round"
                      strokeWidth={2}
                      d="M12 8c-1.657 0-3 .895-3 2s1.343 2 3 2 3 .895 3 2-1.343 2-3 2m0-8c1.11 0 2.08.402 2.599 1M12 8V7m0 1v8m0 0v1m0-1c-1.11 0-2.08-.402-2.599-1M21 12a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z"
                    />
                  </svg>
                  <div>
                    <h3 className="font-bold text-yellow-800 mb-1">
                      Payment Method: Cash on Delivery
                    </h3>
                    <p className="text-sm text-yellow-700">
                      You'll pay when you receive your order. We'll contact you to confirm delivery details.
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Submit Button */}
              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={isSubmitting}
                className="w-full mt-8 btn-primary text-lg py-4 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
              >
                {isSubmitting ? 'Processing Order...' : 'Place Order'}
              </button>
            </form>
          </div>

          {/* Order Summary */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-1">
            <CartSummary showCheckoutButton={false} />

            {/* Order Items Preview */}
            <div className="mt-6 bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-xl p-6">
              <h3 className="font-bold text-lg mb-4">Order Items ({getCartItemsCount()})</h3>
              <div className="space-y-3">
                {cart.map((item) => (
                  <div key={item.cartItemId} className="flex justify-between text-sm">
                    <div className="flex-1">
                      <p className="font-medium">{item.title}</p>
                      <p className="text-gray-600 text-xs">
                        {item.selectedSize} • {item.selectedColor} • Qty: {item.quantity}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                    <p className="font-bold">
                      ${(item.price * item.quantity).toFixed(2)}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}

```javascriptreact
'use client';

/**
 * POD Upload Form Component
 * Complete Print-On-Demand workflow with:
 * - Product selection
 * - Size and color selection
 * - File upload with Cloudinary
 * - Live preview
 * - Shipping details form
 * - EmailJS order submission
 */

import { useState } from 'react';
import { useToast } from '@/context/ToastContext';
import { uploadToCloudinary } from '@/lib/cloudinary';
import { sendOrderEmail } from '@/lib/emailjs';
import { sendCustomerPODConfirmation } from '@/lib/customer-email';
import { validateForm, commonRules } from '@/lib/validation';
import { trackPODSubmission } from '@/lib/analytics';

const PRODUCT_TYPES = ['Hoodie', 'T-shirt', 'Cap', 'Tote Bag', 'Shorts'];
const SIZES = ['S', 'M', 'L', 'XL'];
const COLORS = ['Black', 'White', 'Grey'];

export default function PodUploadForm() {
  const toast = useToast();

  // Form state
  const [step, setStep] = useState(1);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    productType: 'Hoodie',
    size: 'M',
    color: 'Black',
    designUrl: '',
    customerName: '',
    customerEmail: '',
    customerPhone: '',
    customerAddress: '',
    notes: '',
  });

  // UI state
  const [uploadedFile, setUploadedFile] = useState(null);
  const [previewUrl, setPreviewUrl] = useState('');
  const [isUploading, setIsUploading] = useState(false);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [uploadError, setUploadError] = useState('');
  const [submitSuccess, setSubmitSuccess] = useState(false);
  const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState({});

  // Handle form field changes
  const handleChange = (field, value) => {
    setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, [field]: value }));
    // Clear field error when user starts typing
    if (fieldErrors[field]) {
      setFieldErrors((prev) => {
        const newErrors = { ...prev };
        delete newErrors[field];
        return newErrors;
      });
    }
  };

  // Handle file selection
  const handleFileSelect = (e) => {
    const file = e.target.files[0];
    if (file) {
      if (!file.type.startsWith('image/')) {
        setUploadError('Please select a valid image file');
        toast.error('Please select a valid image file');
        return;
      }
      if (file.size > 10 * 1024 * 1024) {
        setUploadError('File size must be less than 10MB');
        toast.error('File size must be less than 10MB');
        return;
      }
      setUploadedFile(file);
      setPreviewUrl(URL.createObjectURL(file));
      setUploadError('');
      toast.success('Image selected successfully!');
    }
  };

  // Upload to Cloudinary
  const handleUploadToCloudinary = async () => {
    if (!uploadedFile) {
      setUploadError('Please select a file first');
      toast.error('Please select a file first');
      return;
    }

    setIsUploading(true);
    setUploadError('');

    try {
      const result = await uploadToCloudinary(uploadedFile);
      setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, designUrl: result.url }));
      toast.success('Design uploaded successfully!');
      setStep(5); // Move to shipping details
    } catch (error) {
      setUploadError('Failed to upload image. Please try again.');
      toast.error('Failed to upload image. Please try again.');
      console.error('Upload error:', error);
    } finally {
      setIsUploading(false);
    }
  };

  // Submit order
  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setFieldErrors({});
    
    if (!formData.designUrl) {
      toast.error('Please upload a design first');
      return;
    }

    // Validate form
    const validation = validateForm(formData, commonRules);
    if (!validation.isValid) {
      setFieldErrors(validation.errors);
      toast.error('Please fix the errors in the form');
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);

    try {
      await sendOrderEmail(formData);
      
      // Track POD submission in analytics
      trackPODSubmission(formData.productType);
      
      setSubmitSuccess(true);
      toast.success('Order placed successfully!');
      setStep(6); // Success screen
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error('Failed to submit order. Please try again.');
      console.error('Submit error:', error);
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  // Reset form
  const resetForm = () => {
    setStep(1);
    setFormData({
      productType: 'Hoodie',
      size: 'M',
      color: 'Black',
      designUrl: '',
      customerName: '',
      customerEmail: '',
      customerPhone: '',
      customerAddress: '',
      notes: '',
    });
    setUploadedFile(null);
    setPreviewUrl('');
    setSubmitSuccess(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto">
      {/* Progress Steps */}
      <div className="mb-12">
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
          {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((stepNum) => (
            <div key={stepNum} className="flex items-center">
              <div
                className={`w-10 h-10 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-bold ${
                  step >= stepNum
                    ? 'bg-black text-white'
                    : 'bg-gray-200 text-gray-400'
                }`}
              >
                {stepNum}
              </div>
              {stepNum < 5 && (
                <div
                  className={`w-16 h-1 mx-2 ${
                    step > stepNum ? 'bg-black' : 'bg-gray-200'
                  }`}
                ></div>
              )}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
        <div className="flex justify-between mt-2 text-xs text-gray-600">
          <span>Product</span>
          <span>Size</span>
          <span>Color</span>
          <span>Design</span>
          <span>Details</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Step Content */}
      <div className="bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-2xl p-8">
        {/* Step 1: Product Type */}
        {step === 1 && (
          <div className="space-y-6">
            <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold">Select Product Type</h2>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
              {PRODUCT_TYPES.map((product) => (
                <button
                  key={product}
                  onClick={() => {
                    handleChange('productType', product);
                    setStep(2);
                  }}
                  className={`p-6 border-2 rounded-lg font-semibold transition-all ${
                    formData.productType === product
                      ? 'border-black bg-black text-white'
                      : 'border-gray-200 hover:border-black'
                  }`}
                >
                  {product}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Step 2: Size */}
        {step === 2 && (
          <div className="space-y-6">
            <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold">Select Size</h2>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-4">
              {SIZES.map((size) => (
                <button
                  key={size}
                  onClick={() => {
                    handleChange('size', size);
                    setStep(3);
                  }}
                  className={`p-6 border-2 rounded-lg font-semibold text-xl transition-all ${
                    formData.size === size
                      ? 'border-black bg-black text-white'
                      : 'border-gray-200 hover:border-black'
                  }`}
                >
                  {size}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={() => setStep(1)}
              className="text-gray-600 hover:text-black"
            >
              ← Back
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Step 3: Color */}
        {step === 3 && (
          <div className="space-y-6">
            <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold">Select Color</h2>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4">
              {COLORS.map((color) => (
                <button
                  key={color}
                  onClick={() => {
                    handleChange('color', color);
                    setStep(4);
                  }}
                  className={`p-8 border-2 rounded-lg font-semibold transition-all ${
                    formData.color === color
                      ? 'border-black bg-black text-white'
                      : 'border-gray-200 hover:border-black'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div
                    className={`w-12 h-12 rounded-full mx-auto mb-3 border-2 ${
                      color === 'Black'
                        ? 'bg-black'
                        : color === 'White'
                        ? 'bg-white border-gray-300'
                        : 'bg-gray-400'
                    }`}
                  ></div>
                  {color}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={() => setStep(2)}
              className="text-gray-600 hover:text-black"
            >
              ← Back
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Step 4: Upload Design & Preview */}
        {step === 4 && (
          <div className="space-y-6">
            <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold">Upload Your Design</h2>
            
            {/* File Upload */}
            <div>
              <label className="block mb-2 font-medium">
                Choose your design file
              </label>
              <input
                type="file"
                accept="image/*"
                onChange={handleFileSelect}
                className="block w-full text-sm text-gray-600 file:mr-4 file:py-3 file:px-6 file:rounded-lg file:border-0 file:font-semibold file:bg-black file:text-white hover:file:bg-gray-800 cursor-pointer"
              />
              <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-gray-500">
                Supported formats: JPG, PNG, SVG (Max 10MB)
              </p>
            </div>

            {uploadError && (
              <div className="p-4 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 rounded-lg text-red-600">
                {uploadError}
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Live Preview */}
            {previewUrl && (
              <div className="space-y-4">
                <h3 className="text-xl font-bold">Preview</h3>
                <div className="relative bg-gray-100 rounded-lg p-8">
                  <div
                    className={`w-64 h-80 mx-auto rounded-lg relative ${
                      formData.color === 'Black'
                        ? 'bg-black'
                        : formData.color === 'White'
                        ? 'bg-white border-2 border-gray-300'
                        : 'bg-gray-400'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {/* Design overlay */}
                    <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center p-8">
                      <img
                        src={previewUrl}
                        alt="Design preview"
                        className="max-w-full max-h-full object-contain"
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-center mt-4 font-medium">
                    {formData.productType} - {formData.size} - {formData.color}
                  </p>
                </div>
                
                <button
                  onClick={handleUploadToCloudinary}
                  disabled={isUploading}
                  className="w-full btn-primary disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
                >
                  {isUploading ? 'Uploading...' : 'Continue to Shipping Details'}
                </button>
              </div>
            )}

            <button
              onClick={() => setStep(3)}
              className="text-gray-600 hover:text-black"
            >
              ← Back
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Step 5: Shipping Details */}
        {step === 5 && (
          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-6">
            <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold">Shipping Details</h2>
            
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
              <div>
                <label htmlFor="pod-name" className="block mb-2 font-medium">Full Name *</label>
                <input
                  id="pod-name"
                  type="text"
                  value={formData.customerName}
                  onChange={(e) => handleChange('customerName', e.target.value)}
                  className={`w-full px-4 py-3 border rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-black ${
                    fieldErrors.customerName ? 'border-red-500' : 'border-gray-300'
                  }`}
                  placeholder="John Doe"
                  aria-invalid={!!fieldErrors.customerName}
                  aria-describedby={fieldErrors.customerName ? 'pod-name-error' : undefined}
                />
                {fieldErrors.customerName && (
                  <p id="pod-name-error" className="mt-1 text-sm text-red-600" role="alert">
                    {fieldErrors.customerName}
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>

              <div>
                <label htmlFor="pod-email" className="block mb-2 font-medium">Email *</label>
                <input
                  id="pod-email"
                  type="email"
                  value={formData.customerEmail}
                  onChange={(e) => handleChange('customerEmail', e.target.value)}
                  className={`w-full px-4 py-3 border rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-black ${
                    fieldErrors.customerEmail ? 'border-red-500' : 'border-gray-300'
                  }`}
                  placeholder="john@example.com"
                  aria-invalid={!!fieldErrors.customerEmail}
                  aria-describedby={fieldErrors.customerEmail ? 'pod-email-error' : undefined}
                />
                {fieldErrors.customerEmail && (
                  <p id="pod-email-error" className="mt-1 text-sm text-red-600" role="alert">
                    {fieldErrors.customerEmail}
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>

              <div>
                <label htmlFor="pod-phone" className="block mb-2 font-medium">Phone *</label>
                <input
                  id="pod-phone"
                  type="tel"
                  value={formData.customerPhone}
                  onChange={(e) => handleChange('customerPhone', e.target.value)}
                  className={`w-full px-4 py-3 border rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-black ${
                    fieldErrors.customerPhone ? 'border-red-500' : 'border-gray-300'
                  }`}
                  placeholder="+1 234 567 8900"
                  aria-invalid={!!fieldErrors.customerPhone}
                  aria-describedby={fieldErrors.customerPhone ? 'pod-phone-error' : undefined}
                />
                {fieldErrors.customerPhone && (
                  <p id="pod-phone-error" className="mt-1 text-sm text-red-600" role="alert">
                    {fieldErrors.customerPhone}
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>

              <div className="md:col-span-2">
                <label htmlFor="pod-address" className="block mb-2 font-medium">
                  Shipping Address *
                </label>
                <textarea
                  id="pod-address"
                  value={formData.customerAddress}
                  onChange={(e) => handleChange('customerAddress', e.target.value)}
                  rows={3}
                  className={`w-full px-4 py-3 border rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-black ${
                    fieldErrors.customerAddress ? 'border-red-500' : 'border-gray-300'
                  }`}
                  placeholder="123 Main St, City, State, ZIP"
                  aria-invalid={!!fieldErrors.customerAddress}
                  aria-describedby={fieldErrors.customerAddress ? 'pod-address-error' : undefined}
                />
                {fieldErrors.customerAddress && (
                  <p id="pod-address-error" className="mt-1 text-sm text-red-600" role="alert">
                    {fieldErrors.customerAddress}
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>

              <div className="md:col-span-2">
                <label htmlFor="pod-notes" className="block mb-2 font-medium">
                  Additional Notes (Optional)
                </label>
                <textarea
                  id="pod-notes"
                  value={formData.notes}
                  onChange={(e) => handleChange('notes', e.target.value)}
                  rows={3}
                  className="w-full px-4 py-3 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-black"
                  placeholder="Any special instructions..."
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Order Summary */}
            <div className="bg-gray-50 p-6 rounded-lg border border-gray-200">
              <h3 className="font-bold text-xl mb-4">Order Summary</h3>
              <div className="space-y-2 text-sm">
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span>Product:</span>
                  <span className="font-medium">{formData.productType}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span>Size:</span>
                  <span className="font-medium">{formData.size}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span>Color:</span>
                  <span className="font-medium">{formData.color}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span>Payment:</span>
                  <span className="font-medium">Cash on Delivery</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex gap-4">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setStep(4)}
                className="btn-secondary flex-1"
              >
                ← Back
              </button>
              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={isSubmitting}
                className="btn-primary flex-1 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
              >
                {isSubmitting ? 'Submitting...' : 'Place Order (COD)'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        )}

        {/* Step 6: Success */}
        {step === 6 && submitSuccess && (
          <div className="text-center space-y-6 py-12">
            <div className="w-20 h-20 bg-green-100 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mx-auto">
              <svg
                className="w-10 h-10 text-green-600"
                fill="none"
                stroke="currentColor"
                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
              >
                <path
                  strokeLinecap="round"
                  strokeLinejoin="round"
                  strokeWidth={2}
                  d="M5 13l4 4L19 7"
                />
              </svg>
            </div>
            <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold">Order Placed Successfully!</h2>
            <p className="text-gray-600 max-w-md mx-auto">
              Thank you for your order!
              <br /><br />
              We'll contact you soon to confirm your order.
            </p>
            <div className="bg-gray-50 p-6 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 max-w-md mx-auto">
              <h3 className="font-bold mb-4">Order Details</h3>
              <div className="space-y-2 text-sm text-left">
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span>Product:</span>
                  <span className="font-medium">{formData.productType}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span>Size:</span>
                  <span className="font-medium">{formData.size}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span>Color:</span>
                  <span className="font-medium">{formData.color}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span>Payment:</span>
                  <span className="font-medium">Cash on Delivery</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="flex gap-4 justify-center">
              <button onClick={resetForm} className="btn-primary">
                Place Another Order
              </button>
              <a href="/" className="btn-secondary">
                Back to Home
              </a>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

```javascriptreact
'use client';

/**
 * POD Upload Form Component
 * Complete Print-On-Demand workflow with:
 * - Product selection
 * - Size and color selection
 * - File upload with Cloudinary
 * - Live preview
 * - Shipping details form
 * - EmailJS order submission
 */

import { useState } from 'react';
import { useToast } from '@/context/ToastContext';
import { uploadToCloudinary } from '@/lib/cloudinary';
import { sendOrderEmail } from '@/lib/emailjs';
import { sendCustomerPODConfirmation } from '@/lib/customer-email';
import { validateForm, commonRules } from '@/lib/validation';
import { trackPODSubmission } from '@/lib/analytics';

const PRODUCT_TYPES = ['Hoodie', 'T-shirt', 'Cap', 'Tote Bag', 'Shorts'];
const SIZES = ['S', 'M', 'L', 'XL'];
const COLORS = ['Black', 'White', 'Grey'];

export default function PodUploadForm() {
  const toast = useToast();

  // Form state
  const [step, setStep] = useState(1);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    productType: 'Hoodie',
    size: 'M',
    color: 'Black',
    designUrl: '',
    customerName: '',
    customerEmail: '',
    customerPhone: '',
    customerAddress: '',
    notes: '',
  });

  // UI state
  const [uploadedFile, setUploadedFile] = useState(null);
  const [previewUrl, setPreviewUrl] = useState('');
  const [isUploading, setIsUploading] = useState(false);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [uploadError, setUploadError] = useState('');
  const [submitSuccess, setSubmitSuccess] = useState(false);
  const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState({});

  // Handle form field changes
  const handleChange = (field, value) => {
    setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, [field]: value }));
    // Clear field error when user starts typing
    if (fieldErrors[field]) {
      setFieldErrors((prev) => {
        const newErrors = { ...prev };
        delete newErrors[field];
        return newErrors;
      });
    }
  };

  // Handle file selection
  const handleFileSelect = (e) => {
    const file = e.target.files[0];
    if (file) {
      if (!file.type.startsWith('image/')) {
        setUploadError('Please select a valid image file');
        toast.error('Please select a valid image file');
        return;
      }
      if (file.size > 10 * 1024 * 1024) {
        setUploadError('File size must be less than 10MB');
        toast.error('File size must be less than 10MB');
        return;
      }
      setUploadedFile(file);
      setPreviewUrl(URL.createObjectURL(file));
      setUploadError('');
      toast.success('Image selected successfully!');
    }
  };

  // Upload to Cloudinary
  const handleUploadToCloudinary = async () => {
    if (!uploadedFile) {
      setUploadError('Please select a file first');
      toast.error('Please select a file first');
      return;
    }

    setIsUploading(true);
    setUploadError('');

    try {
      const result = await uploadToCloudinary(uploadedFile);
      setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, designUrl: result.url }));
      toast.success('Design uploaded successfully!');
      setStep(5); // Move to shipping details
    } catch (error) {
      setUploadError('Failed to upload image. Please try again.');
      toast.error('Failed to upload image. Please try again.');
      console.error('Upload error:', error);
    } finally {
      setIsUploading(false);
    }
  };

  // Submit order
  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setFieldErrors({});
    
    if (!formData.designUrl) {
      toast.error('Please upload a design first');
      return;
    }

    // Validate form
    const validation = validateForm(formData, commonRules);
    if (!validation.isValid) {
      setFieldErrors(validation.errors);
      toast.error('Please fix the errors in the form');
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);

    try {
      // Send order email to business
      await sendOrderEmail(formData);
      
      // Send confirmation email to customer (non-blocking)
      sendCustomerPODConfirmation(formData).catch(err => {
        console.error('Failed to send customer confirmation:', err);
        // Don't block the order - just log the error
      });
      
      // Track POD submission in analytics
      trackPODSubmission(formData.productType);
      
      setSubmitSuccess(true);
      toast.success('Order placed successfully! Check your email for confirmation.');
      setStep(6); // Success screen
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error('Failed to submit order. Please try again.');
      console.error('Submit error:', error);
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  // Reset form
  const resetForm = () => {
    setStep(1);
    setFormData({
      productType: 'Hoodie',
      size: 'M',
      color: 'Black',
      designUrl: '',
      customerName: '',
      customerEmail: '',
      customerPhone: '',
      customerAddress: '',
      notes: '',
    });
    setUploadedFile(null);
    setPreviewUrl('');
    setSubmitSuccess(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto">
      {/* Progress Steps */}
      <div className="mb-12">
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
          {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((stepNum) => (
            <div key={stepNum} className="flex items-center">
              <div
                className={`w-10 h-10 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-bold ${
                  step >= stepNum
                    ? 'bg-black text-white'
                    : 'bg-gray-200 text-gray-400'
                }`}
              >
                {stepNum}
              </div>
              {stepNum < 5 && (
                <div
                  className={`w-16 h-1 mx-2 ${
                    step > stepNum ? 'bg-black' : 'bg-gray-200'
                  }`}
                ></div>
              )}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
        <div className="flex justify-between mt-2 text-xs text-gray-600">
          <span>Product</span>
          <span>Size</span>
          <span>Color</span>
          <span>Design</span>
          <span>Details</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Step Content */}
      <div className="bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-2xl p-8">
        {/* Step 1: Product Type */}
        {step === 1 && (
          <div className="space-y-6">
            <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold">Select Product Type</h2>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
              {PRODUCT_TYPES.map((product) => (
                <button
                  key={product}
                  onClick={() => {
                    handleChange('productType', product);
                    setStep(2);
                  }}
                  className={`p-6 border-2 rounded-lg font-semibold transition-all ${
                    formData.productType === product
                      ? 'border-black bg-black text-white'
                      : 'border-gray-200 hover:border-black'
                  }`}
                >
                  {product}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Step 2: Size */}
        {step === 2 && (
          <div className="space-y-6">
            <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold">Select Size</h2>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-4">
              {SIZES.map((size) => (
                <button
                  key={size}
                  onClick={() => {
                    handleChange('size', size);
                    setStep(3);
                  }}
                  className={`p-6 border-2 rounded-lg font-semibold text-xl transition-all ${
                    formData.size === size
                      ? 'border-black bg-black text-white'
                      : 'border-gray-200 hover:border-black'
                  }`}
                >
                  {size}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={() => setStep(1)}
              className="text-gray-600 hover:text-black"
            >
              ← Back
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Step 3: Color */}
        {step === 3 && (
          <div className="space-y-6">
            <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold">Select Color</h2>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4">
              {COLORS.map((color) => (
                <button
                  key={color}
                  onClick={() => {
                    handleChange('color', color);
                    setStep(4);
                  }}
                  className={`p-8 border-2 rounded-lg font-semibold transition-all ${
                    formData.color === color
                      ? 'border-black bg-black text-white'
                      : 'border-gray-200 hover:border-black'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div
                    className={`w-12 h-12 rounded-full mx-auto mb-3 border-2 ${
                      color === 'Black'
                        ? 'bg-black'
                        : color === 'White'
                        ? 'bg-white border-gray-300'
                        : 'bg-gray-400'
                    }`}
                  ></div>
                  {color}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={() => setStep(2)}
              className="text-gray-600 hover:text-black"
            >
              ← Back
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Step 4: Upload Design & Preview */}
        {step === 4 && (
          <div className="space-y-6">
            <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold">Upload Your Design</h2>
            
            {/* File Upload */}
            <div>
              <label className="block mb-2 font-medium">
                Choose your design file
              </label>
              <input
                type="file"
                accept="image/*"
                onChange={handleFileSelect}
                className="block w-full text-sm text-gray-600 file:mr-4 file:py-3 file:px-6 file:rounded-lg file:border-0 file:font-semibold file:bg-black file:text-white hover:file:bg-gray-800 cursor-pointer"
              />
              <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-gray-500">
                Supported formats: JPG, PNG, SVG (Max 10MB)
              </p>
            </div>

            {uploadError && (
              <div className="p-4 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 rounded-lg text-red-600">
                {uploadError}
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Live Preview */}
            {previewUrl && (
              <div className="space-y-4">
                <h3 className="text-xl font-bold">Preview</h3>
                <div className="relative bg-gray-100 rounded-lg p-8">
                  <div
                    className={`w-64 h-80 mx-auto rounded-lg relative ${
                      formData.color === 'Black'
                        ? 'bg-black'
                        : formData.color === 'White'
                        ? 'bg-white border-2 border-gray-300'
                        : 'bg-gray-400'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {/* Design overlay */}
                    <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center p-8">
                      <img
                        src={previewUrl}
                        alt="Design preview"
                        className="max-w-full max-h-full object-contain"
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-center mt-4 font-medium">
                    {formData.productType} - {formData.size} - {formData.color}
                  </p>
                </div>
                
                <button
                  onClick={handleUploadToCloudinary}
                  disabled={isUploading}
                  className="w-full btn-primary disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
                >
                  {isUploading ? 'Uploading...' : 'Continue to Shipping Details'}
                </button>
              </div>
            )}

            <button
              onClick={() => setStep(3)}
              className="text-gray-600 hover:text-black"
            >
              ← Back
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Step 5: Shipping Details */}
        {step === 5 && (
          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-6">
            <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold">Shipping Details</h2>
            
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
              <div>
                <label htmlFor="pod-name" className="block mb-2 font-medium">Full Name *</label>
                <input
                  id="pod-name"
                  type="text"
                  value={formData.customerName}
                  onChange={(e) => handleChange('customerName', e.target.value)}
                  className={`w-full px-4 py-3 border rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-black ${
                    fieldErrors.customerName ? 'border-red-500' : 'border-gray-300'
                  }`}
                  placeholder="John Doe"
                  aria-invalid={!!fieldErrors.customerName}
                  aria-describedby={fieldErrors.customerName ? 'pod-name-error' : undefined}
                />
                {fieldErrors.customerName && (
                  <p id="pod-name-error" className="mt-1 text-sm text-red-600" role="alert">
                    {fieldErrors.customerName}
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>

              <div>
                <label htmlFor="pod-email" className="block mb-2 font-medium">Email *</label>
                <input
                  id="pod-email"
                  type="email"
                  value={formData.customerEmail}
                  onChange={(e) => handleChange('customerEmail', e.target.value)}
                  className={`w-full px-4 py-3 border rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-black ${
                    fieldErrors.customerEmail ? 'border-red-500' : 'border-gray-300'
                  }`}
                  placeholder="john@example.com"
                  aria-invalid={!!fieldErrors.customerEmail}
                  aria-describedby={fieldErrors.customerEmail ? 'pod-email-error' : undefined}
                />
                {fieldErrors.customerEmail && (
                  <p id="pod-email-error" className="mt-1 text-sm text-red-600" role="alert">
                    {fieldErrors.customerEmail}
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>

              <div>
                <label htmlFor="pod-phone" className="block mb-2 font-medium">Phone *</label>
                <input
                  id="pod-phone"
                  type="tel"
                  value={formData.customerPhone}
                  onChange={(e) => handleChange('customerPhone', e.target.value)}
                  className={`w-full px-4 py-3 border rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-black ${
                    fieldErrors.customerPhone ? 'border-red-500' : 'border-gray-300'
                  }`}
                  placeholder="+1 234 567 8900"
                  aria-invalid={!!fieldErrors.customerPhone}
                  aria-describedby={fieldErrors.customerPhone ? 'pod-phone-error' : undefined}
                />
                {fieldErrors.customerPhone && (
                  <p id="pod-phone-error" className="mt-1 text-sm text-red-600" role="alert">
                    {fieldErrors.customerPhone}
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>

              <div className="md:col-span-2">
                <label htmlFor="pod-address" className="block mb-2 font-medium">
                  Shipping Address *
                </label>
                <textarea
                  id="pod-address"
                  value={formData.customerAddress}
                  onChange={(e) => handleChange('customerAddress', e.target.value)}
                  rows={3}
                  className={`w-full px-4 py-3 border rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-black ${
                    fieldErrors.customerAddress ? 'border-red-500' : 'border-gray-300'
                  }`}
                  placeholder="123 Main St, City, State, ZIP"
                  aria-invalid={!!fieldErrors.customerAddress}
                  aria-describedby={fieldErrors.customerAddress ? 'pod-address-error' : undefined}
                />
                {fieldErrors.customerAddress && (
                  <p id="pod-address-error" className="mt-1 text-sm text-red-600" role="alert">
                    {fieldErrors.customerAddress}
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>

              <div className="md:col-span-2">
                <label htmlFor="pod-notes" className="block mb-2 font-medium">
                  Additional Notes (Optional)
                </label>
                <textarea
                  id="pod-notes"
                  value={formData.notes}
                  onChange={(e) => handleChange('notes', e.target.value)}
                  rows={3}
                  className="w-full px-4 py-3 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-black"
                  placeholder="Any special instructions..."
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Order Summary */}
            <div className="bg-gray-50 p-6 rounded-lg border border-gray-200">
              <h3 className="font-bold text-xl mb-4">Order Summary</h3>
              <div className="space-y-2 text-sm">
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span>Product:</span>
                  <span className="font-medium">{formData.productType}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span>Size:</span>
                  <span className="font-medium">{formData.size}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span>Color:</span>
                  <span className="font-medium">{formData.color}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span>Payment:</span>
                  <span className="font-medium">Cash on Delivery</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex gap-4">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setStep(4)}
                className="btn-secondary flex-1"
              >
                ← Back
              </button>
              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={isSubmitting}
                className="btn-primary flex-1 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
              >
                {isSubmitting ? 'Submitting...' : 'Place Order (COD)'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        )}

        {/* Step 6: Success */}
        {step === 6 && submitSuccess && (
          <div className="text-center space-y-6 py-12">
            <div className="w-20 h-20 bg-green-100 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mx-auto">
              <svg
                className="w-10 h-10 text-green-600"
                fill="none"
                stroke="currentColor"
                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
              >
                <path
                  strokeLinecap="round"
                  strokeLinejoin="round"
                  strokeWidth={2}
                  d="M5 13l4 4L19 7"
                />
              </svg>
            </div>
            <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold">Order Placed Successfully!</h2>
            <p className="text-gray-600 max-w-md mx-auto">
              Thank you for your order!
              <br /><br />
              We'll contact you soon to confirm your order.
            </p>
            <div className="bg-gray-50 p-6 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 max-w-md mx-auto">
              <h3 className="font-bold mb-4">Order Details</h3>
              <div className="space-y-2 text-sm text-left">
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span>Product:</span>
                  <span className="font-medium">{formData.productType}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span>Size:</span>
                  <span className="font-medium">{formData.size}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span>Color:</span>
                  <span className="font-medium">{formData.color}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span>Payment:</span>
                  <span className="font-medium">Cash on Delivery</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="flex gap-4 justify-center">
              <button onClick={resetForm} className="btn-primary">
                Place Another Order
              </button>
              <a href="/" className="btn-secondary">
                Back to Home
              </a>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

## 🚀 Testing Checklist

Before deploying, test the following:

### Forms
- [ ] Submit checkout form with invalid email
- [ ] Submit POD form with invalid phone
- [ ] Try to submit empty required fields
- [ ] Verify error messages appear inline
- [ ] Verify toast notifications work

### Shopping Cart
- [ ] Add same product with different sizes
- [ ] Verify cart persists after page refresh
- [ ] Check cart badge updates correctly
- [ ] Remove items from cart

### Email Notifications
- [ ] Place a regular order and check business email
- [ ] Place a regular order and check customer email
- [ ] Place a POD order and check both emails
- [ ] Verify email template variables populate correctly

### Loading States
- [ ] Refresh products page and see skeletons
- [ ] Go to cart page and see skeletons
- [ ] Check that skeletons match actual content layout

### Accessibility
- [ ] Navigate site using keyboard only
- [ ] Test with screen reader
- [ ] Verify all form errors are announced
- [ ] Check cart badge announces item count

### Analytics (if GA is configured)
- [ ] Add product to cart and check GA events
- [ ] Complete checkout and verify purchase event
- [ ] Submit POD order and check event
- [ ] Navigate pages and verify page view tracking

## 🔧 Configuration Required

### 1. Environment Variables
Copy `env.example` to `.env.local` and fill in:
- Cloudinary credentials
- EmailJS credentials (service ID, user ID, template IDs)
- Google Analytics ID (optional)

### 2. EmailJS Templates
Create templates for:
- **Business Notifications** (required)
- **Customer Confirmations** (recommended)

Template variables needed:
```
{{customer_name}}
{{customer_email}}
{{customer_phone}}
{{customer_address}}
{{order_items}}
{{subtotal}}
{{shipping}}
{{total}}
{{order_notes}}
{{order_date}}
```

### 3. Product Images
Replace placeholder images by:
1. Adding actual images to `public/images/products/`
2. Updating image paths in `src/data/products.js`
3. Or using Cloudinary URLs directly

## 🎓 How to Use New Features

### Toast Notifications
```javascript
import { useToast } from '@/context/ToastContext';

function MyComponent() {
  const toast = useToast();
  
  // Success message
  toast.success('Order placed successfully!');
  
  // Error message
  toast.error('Failed to submit order');
  
  // Warning
  toast.warning('Please verify your information');
  
  // Info
  toast.info('Your cart was saved');
}
```

### Form Validation
```javascript
import { validateForm, commonRules } from '@/lib/validation';

const validation = validateForm(formData, commonRules);
if (!validation.isValid) {
  setFieldErrors(validation.errors);
  return;
}
```

### Analytics Tracking
```javascript
import { trackAddToCart, trackPurchase } from '@/lib/analytics';

// Track add to cart
trackAddToCart(product);

// Track purchase
trackPurchase({ total: 99.99 });
```

### Loading Skeletons
```javascript
import { ProductCardSkeleton } from '@/components/Skeleton';

{isLoading ? (
  <ProductCardSkeleton />
) : (
  <ProductCard product={product} />
)}
```

## 🐛 Known Issues & Notes

1. **EmailJS Rate Limits** - Free tier has sending limits, monitor usage
2. **Customer Emails** - Optional template ID, falls back to business template
3. **Google Analytics** - Only loads when GA_MEASUREMENT_ID is set and valid
4. **Placeholder Images** - SVG data URIs, replace with real images for production
5. **Form Validation** - Client-side only, add server-side validation for production

- ✅ Beautiful error handling
- ✅ Loading states for better UX

- ✅ Analytics tracking
- ✅ Customer email confirmations
- ✅ Bug fixes and optimizations

The codebase is now more maintainable, user-friendly, and production-ready!

## 🔧 Configuration Steps

### Cloudinary Setup (2 minutes)

1. Go to [cloudinary.com](https://cloudinary.com) and sign up
2. Dashboard → Settings → Upload
3. Create Upload Preset:
   - Signing Mode: **Unsigned**
   - Save and copy preset name
4. Copy your Cloud Name from dashboard
5. Add to `.env.local`

### EmailJS Setup (5 minutes)

1. Go to [emailjs.com](https://www.emailjs.com) and sign up
2. Create Email Service (Gmail, Outlook, etc.)
3. Create Email Template with these variables:
   ```
   {{customer_name}}
   {{customer_email}}
   {{order_items}}
   {{total}}
   {{order_date}}
   ```
4. Copy Service ID, Template ID, and Public Key
5. Add to `.env.local`

### Google Analytics Setup (3 minutes) - Optional

1. Go to [analytics.google.com](https://analytics.google.com)
2. Create GA4 property
3. Copy Measurement ID (format: G-XXXXXXXXXX)
4. Add to `.env.local`

---

## 💡 Pro Tips

### Replace Placeholder Images

When you have actual product photos:

1. Add images to `public/images/products/`
2. Update `src/data/products.js`:
   ```javascript
   images: [
     '/images/products/your-image.jpg',
     '/images/products/your-image-2.jpg',
   ],
   ```

### Customize Toast Duration

```javascript
toast.success('Message', 3000); // 3 seconds
toast.error('Error', 0); // No auto-dismiss
```

### Create Custom Validation Rules

```javascript
// In your component
const customRules = {
  myField: [
    (value) => validators.required(value, 'My Field'),
    (value) => value.length > 5 ? null : 'Too short'
  ]
};
```

### Track Custom Analytics Events

```javascript
import { event } from '@/lib/analytics';

event({
  action: 'button_click',
  category: 'engagement',
  label: 'hero_cta',
});
```

## 🚨 Troubleshooting

### Toast Notifications Not Showing
- Check browser console for errors
- Verify ToastProvider is in layout.jsx
- Check if Toast component is rendered

### Form Validation Not Working
- Check field names match validation rules
- Verify formData state is updated
- Check console for validation errors

### Images Not Loading
- For placeholders: Check if placeholder-images.js imports correctly
- For real images: Verify files exist in public/images/products/

### Emails Not Sending
- Check EmailJS credentials in .env.local
- Verify template IDs match
- Check EmailJS dashboard for errors
- Check browser console for errors

### Analytics Not Tracking
- Verify GA_MEASUREMENT_ID is set and starts with 'G-'
- Check Network tab for gtag requests
- Give it a few minutes to appear in GA dashboard

I see the issue! The `GoogleAnalytics` component uses `useSearchParams()` which requires a Suspense boundary for static generation. Let me fix this:

```javascriptreact
'use client';

/**
 * Google Analytics Component
 * Loads GA4 script and tracks page views
 */

import { useEffect, Suspense } from 'react';
import { usePathname, useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation';
import { pageview, GA_MEASUREMENT_ID } from '@/lib/analytics';
import Script from 'next/script';

function GoogleAnalyticsTracker() {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!GA_MEASUREMENT_ID) return;

    const url = pathname + (searchParams.toString() ? `?${searchParams.toString()}` : '');
    pageview(url);
  }, [pathname, searchParams]);

  return null;
}

export default function GoogleAnalytics() {
  // Don't load GA if measurement ID is not set
  if (!GA_MEASUREMENT_ID || !GA_MEASUREMENT_ID.startsWith('G-')) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <>
      <Script
        strategy="afterInteractive"
        src={`https://www.googletagmanager.com/gtag/js?id=${GA_MEASUREMENT_ID}`}
      />
      <Script
        id="google-analytics"
        strategy="afterInteractive"
        dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{
          __html: `
            window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
            function gtag(){dataLayer.push(arguments);}
            gtag('js', new Date());
            gtag('config', '${GA_MEASUREMENT_ID}', {
              page_path: window.location.pathname,
            });
          `,
        }}
      />
      <Suspense fallback={null}>
        <GoogleAnalyticsTracker />
      </Suspense>
    </>
  );
}


```

Perfect! ✅ **Build successful!** The issue has been fixed. Let me create a quick note about this fix:

```markdown
# Deployment Fix - Suspense Boundary Issue

## Problem
Deployment was failing with the error:
```
⨯ useSearchParams() should be wrapped in a suspense boundary
Error occurred prerendering page
```

## Root Cause
The `GoogleAnalytics` component was using `useSearchParams()` hook directly, which requires a Suspense boundary for static site generation. Since this component was in the root layout, it affected all pages.

## Solution
Updated `src/components/GoogleAnalytics.jsx` to:
1. Separate the tracking logic into a `GoogleAnalyticsTracker` component
2. Wrap the tracker in a `<Suspense>` boundary
3. Keep the Script tags outside the Suspense boundary

## Changes Made
- Modified `src/components/GoogleAnalytics.jsx`
- Added Suspense wrapper around the component using `useSearchParams()`
- All pages now successfully pre-render as static content

## Verification
✅ Local build passes: `npm run build`
✅ All 17 pages generate successfully
✅ No prerender errors
✅ Static generation working correctly

## Deployment Status
Ready to deploy to Vercel! 🚀

The fix maintains all Google Analytics functionality while allowing Next.js to statically generate all pages.

## 🔴 **Critical Issue: Cloudinary Not Configured in Vercel**

The POD (Print-On-Demand) feature won't work until you add Cloudinary credentials to Vercel. Let me create a step-by-step guide for you.

```markdown
# Cloudinary Setup Guide - Fix Upload Error

## 🔴 Current Problem

**Error:** `Cloudinary configuration missing. Please check your environment variables.`

**Cause:** The Cloudinary environment variables are not set in Vercel.

**Impact:** POD (Print-On-Demand) image uploads will not work until this is fixed.

---

## ✅ Step-by-Step Solution

### Step 1: Create Cloudinary Account (5 minutes)

1. Go to **[https://cloudinary.com](https://cloudinary.com)**
2. Click **"Sign Up Free"**
3. Fill in your details:
   - Email
   - Password
   - Choose **"I'm a developer"** or **"I'm building a website"**
4. Verify your email
5. Log in to your dashboard

---

### Step 2: Get Your Cloud Name (1 minute)

1. After logging in, you'll see your **Dashboard**
2. Look at the top - you'll see:
   ```
   Account Details
   Cloud name: your_cloud_name_here
   ```
3. **Copy this Cloud Name** - you'll need it!

**Example:** If it shows `dxyz1234`, that's your cloud name.

---

### Step 3: Create Unsigned Upload Preset (3 minutes)

**Why?** This allows your website to upload images directly from the browser securely.

1. In Cloudinary dashboard, click **Settings** (⚙️ icon, top-right)
2. Go to the **"Upload"** tab
3. Scroll down to **"Upload presets"** section
4. Click **"Add upload preset"**
5. Configure the preset:
   
   **Required Settings:**
   - **Upload preset name**: Choose a name (e.g., `coobraa_pod_uploads`)
   - **Signing Mode**: Select **"Unsigned"** ⚠️ IMPORTANT!
   - **Folder**: (optional) You can set it to `pod_designs` to organize uploads
   
   **Optional Settings:**
   - **Use filename**: Enable if you want to preserve original filenames
   - **Unique filename**: Enable to prevent name conflicts
   - **Overwrite**: Usually leave disabled
   
6. Click **"Save"**
7. **Copy the preset name** you just created

---

### Step 4: Add Environment Variables to Vercel (5 minutes)

Now add these credentials to Vercel:

#### Method A: Via Vercel Dashboard (Recommended)

1. Go to **[https://vercel.com](https://vercel.com)**
2. Select your **"cobrawear"** project (or your project name)
3. Click **"Settings"** (top navigation)
4. Click **"Environment Variables"** (left sidebar)
5. Add the following variables:

**Variable 1:**
```
Name: NEXT_PUBLIC_CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME
Value: [paste your cloud name here]
Environment: Production, Preview, Development (check all 3)
```

**Variable 2:**
```
Name: NEXT_PUBLIC_CLOUDINARY_UPLOAD_PRESET
Value: [paste your upload preset name here]
Environment: Production, Preview, Development (check all 3)
```

6. Click **"Save"** for each variable

#### Method B: Via Vercel CLI (Alternative)

```bash
# In your project directory
vercel env add NEXT_PUBLIC_CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME
# Paste your cloud name when prompted

vercel env add NEXT_PUBLIC_CLOUDINARY_UPLOAD_PRESET
# Paste your preset name when prompted
```

---

### Step 5: Redeploy Your Site (CRITICAL!)

**⚠️ Important:** Environment variables only take effect after redeployment!

#### Option A: Trigger Redeploy from Vercel Dashboard

1. In Vercel dashboard, go to your project
2. Click **"Deployments"** tab
3. Click the **"..."** menu on the latest deployment
4. Click **"Redeploy"**
5. Confirm the redeploy

#### Option B: Push a Commit to GitHub

```bash
# Make any small change or create empty commit
git commit --allow-empty -m "Redeploy for Cloudinary env vars"
git push
```

**Wait 2-3 minutes** for deployment to complete.

---

### Step 6: Test the Upload Feature (2 minutes)

1. Go to your live site: **https://cobrawear.vercel.app/pod**
2. Follow the POD steps until you reach the upload page
3. Try uploading an image
4. ✅ If it works: You're done!
5. ❌ If you still see errors: Check troubleshooting below

---

## 🔍 Verification Checklist

Before testing, verify:

- [ ] Cloudinary account created and verified
- [ ] Cloud name copied correctly (no spaces)
- [ ] Upload preset created with **"Unsigned"** mode
- [ ] Upload preset name copied correctly
- [ ] Both environment variables added to Vercel
- [ ] Variables applied to **Production** environment
- [ ] Site redeployed after adding variables
- [ ] Waited 2-3 minutes for deployment to complete

## 🐛 Troubleshooting

### Issue 1: Still Getting "Configuration Missing" Error

**Solution:**
1. Check Vercel environment variables are saved
2. Verify deployment completed successfully
3. Hard refresh browser (Ctrl+Shift+R or Cmd+Shift+R)
4. Check browser console for new errors

### Issue 2: "Upload preset not found" Error

**Cause:** Upload preset name is incorrect or not set to Unsigned mode.

**Solution:**
1. Go back to Cloudinary Settings → Upload
2. Find your preset
3. Verify **"Signing Mode"** is set to **"Unsigned"**
4. Copy the exact preset name (case-sensitive!)
5. Update in Vercel environment variables
6. Redeploy

### Issue 3: "CORS Error" or "Network Error"

**Cause:** Cloudinary security settings blocking requests.

**Solution:**
1. In Cloudinary: Settings → Security
2. Find **"Allowed fetch domains"**
3. Add your domain: `cobrawear.vercel.app`
4. Click Save
5. Wait 5 minutes for changes to propagate

### Issue 4: Upload Works Locally but Not in Production

**Cause:** Environment variables set locally but not in Vercel.

**Solution:**
1. Local `.env.local` ≠ Vercel environment variables
2. Must add separately to Vercel dashboard
3. Always redeploy after adding variables

### Upload Flow (User Perspective)

1. User goes to `/pod` page
2. Selects product, size, color

### What Happens Behind the Scenes

```
1. User selects file
2. JavaScript reads file
3. Creates FormData with file + preset
4. POSTs to Cloudinary API: 
   https://api.cloudinary.com/v1_1/{cloud_name}/image/upload
5. Cloudinary returns secure URL
6. URL saved with order
7. Email notification includes image link
```

## 💡 Pro Tips

### Security Best Practices

✅ **DO:**
- Use unsigned upload preset for client-side uploads
- Set folder paths in preset to organize uploads
- Enable unique filenames to prevent overwrites
- Monitor your Cloudinary usage (free tier: 25GB storage, 25GB bandwidth/month)

❌ **DON'T:**
- Share your upload preset name publicly (though it's relatively safe)
- Use signed uploads from client-side (requires API secret)
- Store API secrets in `NEXT_PUBLIC_` variables

### Optimization Options

In your Cloudinary preset, you can:
- **Auto-format**: Automatically serve WebP/AVIF for better performance
- **Auto-quality**: Optimize file size while maintaining quality
- **Max dimensions**: Limit upload size (e.g., 2000x2000px)
- **Allowed formats**: Restrict to JPG, PNG, WebP only

### Cost Management

```

## 💡 **Pro Tips**

### **Understanding NPM Warnings**

```
⚠️ WARN = Warning (site still works)
❌ ERROR = Broken (deployment fails)
```

**Your deployment:** All warnings, no errors = ✅ Success!

### **Why So Many Warnings?**

Modern JavaScript projects use hundreds of packages:
```
Your project (coobraa)
  └─ Next.js
      └─ Webpack
          └─ Various tools
              └─ Old dependencies
```

One old package deep in the tree → warning  
But everything still works! ✅

### **When to Worry**

Only worry if you see:
- ❌ **"ERROR"** instead of "WARN"
- ❌ **"SECURITY VULNERABILITY"**
- ❌ **"BUILD FAILED"**
- ❌ Features not working on live site

# EmailJS Setup Guide - Fix Order Email Error

## 🔴 Current Problem

**Error:** `EmailJS configuration missing. Please check your environment variables.`

**Cause:** The EmailJS environment variables are not set in Vercel.

**Impact:** 
- Order confirmation emails won't send to you (business owner)
- Customer confirmation emails won't send
- Orders will still process, but no email notifications

---

## ✅ Step-by-Step Solution

### Step 1: Create EmailJS Account (3 minutes)

1. Go to **[https://www.emailjs.com](https://www.emailjs.com)**
2. Click **"Sign Up"** (top-right)
3. Choose **"Sign up with Google"** or fill in:
   - Email
   - Password
   - Name
4. Verify your email address
5. Log in to your dashboard

**Free Plan Includes:**
- 200 emails/month
- 2 email services
- Unlimited email templates
- Perfect for starting out!

---

### Step 2: Connect Your Email Service (5 minutes)

This connects EmailJS to your actual email account (Gmail, Outlook, etc.)

#### For Gmail (Most Common):

1. In EmailJS dashboard, click **"Email Services"** (left sidebar)
2. Click **"Add New Service"**
3. Select **"Gmail"**
4. Click **"Connect Account"**
5. **Sign in with your business Gmail account**
   - Use the email where you want to receive orders
   - Example: `cobrawear.business@gmail.com`
6. Allow permissions when prompted
7. Give the service a name (e.g., "Cobra Wear Orders")
8. Click **"Create Service"**
9. **Copy the Service ID** (looks like: `service_xxxxxxx`)
   - Save this! You'll need it later

#### For Other Email Providers:

**Outlook/Hotmail:**
- Select "Outlook" → Sign in → Allow permissions

**Yahoo:**
- Select "Yahoo" → Sign in → Allow permissions

**Custom SMTP:**
- Select "Custom SMTP" → Enter your email server details

---

### Step 3: Create Email Template for POD Orders (5 minutes)

This is the email format you'll receive when someone orders a custom design.

1. Click **"Email Templates"** (left sidebar)
2. Click **"Create New Template"**
3. Configure the template:

#### Template Settings:

**Template Name:** `POD Order Notification`

**From Name:** `Cobra Wear Website`

**Subject:** `New POD Order from {{customer_name}}`

**Reply To:** `{{customer_email}}`

**To Email:** `your-business-email@gmail.com` ⚠️ **Put your actual email here!**

**Content (Copy this):**

```html
Hello,

You have received a new Print-On-Demand order from your Cobra Wear website!

═══════════════════════════════════════
CUSTOMER INFORMATION
═══════════════════════════════════════
Name: {{customer_name}}
Email: {{customer_email}}
Phone: {{customer_phone}}

Shipping Address:
{{customer_address}}

═══════════════════════════════════════
ORDER DETAILS
═══════════════════════════════════════
Product Type: {{product_type}}
Size: {{product_size}}
Color: {{product_color}}

═══════════════════════════════════════
DESIGN
═══════════════════════════════════════
View/Download Customer Design:
{{design_url}}

(Click the link above to download the customer's uploaded design)

═══════════════════════════════════════
ADDITIONAL NOTES
═══════════════════════════════════════
{{order_notes}}

═══════════════════════════════════════
ORDER INFORMATION
═══════════════════════════════════════
Order Date: {{order_date}}
Payment Method: Cash on Delivery (COD)

═══════════════════════════════════════

Please contact the customer to confirm the order and arrange delivery.

---
This is an automated email from your Cobra Wear website.
```

4. Click **"Save"** (bottom-right)
5. **Copy the Template ID** (looks like: `template_xxxxxxx`)
   - This appears at the top after saving
   - Save this! You'll need it

---

### Step 4: Create Email Template for Regular Orders (5 minutes)

This is for regular product orders (non-custom).

1. Click **"Create New Template"** again
2. Configure:

**Template Name:** `Regular Order Notification`

**From Name:** `Cobra Wear Website`

**Subject:** `New Order from {{customer_name}} - {{items_count}} items`

**Reply To:** `{{customer_email}}`

**To Email:** `your-business-email@gmail.com` ⚠️ **Put your actual email!**

**Content (Copy this):**

```html
Hello,

You have received a new order from your Cobra Wear website!

═══════════════════════════════════════
CUSTOMER INFORMATION
═══════════════════════════════════════

Email: {{customer_email}}
Phone: {{customer_phone}}

Shipping Address:
{{customer_address}}

═══════════════════════════════════════
ORDER ITEMS ({{items_count}} items)
═══════════════════════════════════════

{{order_items}}

═══════════════════════════════════════
ORDER TOTALS
═══════════════════════════════════════
Subtotal: {{subtotal}}
Shipping: {{shipping}}
─────────────────────

```
Name: NEXT_PUBLIC_EMAILJS_SERVICE_ID

Environment: ✓ Production ✓ Preview ✓ Development

**Variable 2: Public Key**
```
Name: NEXT_PUBLIC_EMAILJS_USER_ID

Environment: ✓ Production ✓ Preview ✓ Development
```

**Variable 3: POD Template ID**
```
Name: NEXT_PUBLIC_EMAILJS_TEMPLATE_ID
Value: template_xxxxxxx (POD template ID)
Environment: ✓ Production ✓ Preview ✓ Development
```

**Variable 4: Regular Order Template ID**
```
Name: NEXT_PUBLIC_EMAILJS_REGULAR_TEMPLATE_ID
Value: template_xxxxxxx (regular order template ID)
Environment: ✓ Production ✓ Preview ✓ Development
```

4. Click **"Save"** for each variable

## 🐛 Troubleshooting

### Issue 1: "EmailJS configuration missing" Still Showing

**Solution:**
1. Verify all 4 variables are in Vercel
2. Check for typos in variable names (case-sensitive!)
3. Make sure you redeployed
4. Hard refresh browser (Ctrl+Shift+R)
5. Clear browser cache

### Issue 2: Email Not Received

**Possible Causes:**

**A. Check Spam/Junk Folder**
- EmailJS emails often go to spam initially
- Mark as "Not Spam" to whitelist

**B. Wrong "To Email" in Template**
```
✓ Correct: your-business-email@gmail.com
✗ Wrong: {{customer_email}} (this sends to customer, not you!)
```

**C. Service Not Connected**
- Go to EmailJS → Email Services
- Check service shows "Connected" status
- Try reconnecting if needed

**D. Template Variables Mismatch**
- Variable names in template must match exactly
- `{{customer_name}}` not `{{customerName}}`

### Issue 3: "Service Not Found" Error

**Cause:** Service ID is incorrect

**Solution:**
1. Go to EmailJS → Email Services
2. Click on your service
3. Copy the Service ID again (top of page)
4. Update in Vercel
5. Redeploy

### Issue 4: "Template Not Found" Error

**Cause:** Template ID is incorrect

**Solution:**
1. Go to EmailJS → Email Templates
2. Click on your template
3. Copy the Template ID (top of page)
4. Update in Vercel
5. Redeploy

### Issue 5: Gmail Blocking Emails

**If using Gmail and emails aren't sending:**

1. Go to Google Account settings
2. Security → Less secure app access
3. Enable (though Google is phasing this out)
4. Alternative: Use Gmail API (more complex)
5. Or use Outlook/Yahoo which are easier
