 * Navbar Component
 * Main navigation with cart badge
 */

import Link from 'next/link';
import { useCart } from '@/context/CartContext';

export default function Navbar() {
  const { getCartItemsCount } = useCart();
  const cartCount = getCartItemsCount();

  return (
    <nav className="border-b border-gray-200 bg-white sticky top-0 z-50" role="navigation" aria-label="Main navigation">
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center h-16">
          <Link 
            href="/" 
            className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight hover:opacity-80 transition-opacity"
            aria-label="Cobra Wear home"
          >
            COBRA WEAR
          </Link>
          
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-8" role="menubar">
            <Link 
              href="/products" 
              className="hover:text-gray-600 transition-colors font-medium"
              role="menuitem"
              aria-label="View all products"
            >
              Products
            </Link>
            <Link 
              href="/pod" 
              className="hover:text-gray-600 transition-colors font-medium"
              role="menuitem"
              aria-label="Print on demand custom designs"
            >
              POD
            </Link>
            
            {/* Cart Icon with Badge */}
            <Link 
              href="/cart" 
              className="relative hover:text-gray-600 transition-colors"
              role="menuitem"
              aria-label={cartCount > 0 ? `Shopping cart with ${cartCount} items` : 'Shopping cart (empty)'}
            >
              <svg
                className="w-6 h-6"
                fill="none"
                stroke="currentColor"
                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                aria-hidden="true"
              >
                <path
                  strokeLinecap="round"
                  strokeLinejoin="round"
                  strokeWidth={2}
                  d="M3 3h2l.4 2M7 13h10l4-8H5.4M7 13L5.4 5M7 13l-2.293 2.293c-.63.63-.184 1.707.707 1.707H17m0 0a2 2 0 100 4 2 2 0 000-4zm-8 2a2 2 0 11-4 0 2 2 0 014 0z"
                />
              </svg>
              
              {/* Badge */}
              {cartCount > 0 && (
                <span 
                  className="absolute -top-2 -right-2 bg-black text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-full w-5 h-5 flex items-center justify-center"
                  aria-label={`${cartCount} items in cart`}
                >
                  {cartCount > 9 ? '9+' : cartCount}
                </span>
              )}
            </Link>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </nav>
  );
}

  </div>
  
</body>
</html>

      </table>
    </div>

      <h3 style="margin: 0 0 15px 0; font-size: 18px; color: #000000;">🚚 Shipping Address</h3>
      <div style="background-color: #f9fafb; padding: 20px; border-radius: 8px; border-left: 4px solid #000000;">
        <p style="margin: 0; white-space: pre-wrap; line-height: 1.8;">{{customer_address}}</p>
      </div>

        <li>Your custom item ships to your address</li>
      </ol>

    <!-- Payment Info -->
    <div style="text-align: center; padding: 25px; background-color: #fef3c7; border-radius: 8px; margin: 30px 0;">
      <p style="margin: 0; font-size: 16px; color: #92400e;">

      </p>

        📧 <a href="mailto:{{customer_email}}" style="color: #000000; text-decoration: none; font-weight: bold;">Contact Support</a>
      </p>
    </div>
    
    <!-- Footer Message -->
    <div style="margin-top: 40px; text-align: center;">
      <p style="font-size: 16px; color: #666; margin: 0;">
        We appreciate your business! 🙏
      </p>
      <p style="font-size: 20px; font-weight: bold; color: #000000; margin: 10px 0 0 0;">
        - The Cobra Wear Team
      </p>
    </div>
    
  </div>
  
  <!-- Footer -->
  <div style="text-align: center; padding: 30px 20px; color: #999; font-size: 12px;">
    <p style="margin: 0 0 5px 0;">This is an automated confirmation email</p>
    <p style="margin: 0;">© 2025 Coobraa - Premium Clothing & Print-On-Demand</p>
  </div>
  
</body>
</html>

```javascript
/**
 * Customer Email Confirmation
 * Sends order confirmation emails to customers
 */

import emailjs from '@emailjs/browser';

/**
 * Send confirmation email to customer for regular orders
 */
export async function sendCustomerOrderConfirmation(orderData) {
  const serviceId = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_EMAILJS_SERVICE_ID;
  // Only use CUSTOMER_TEMPLATE_ID - don't fallback to avoid duplicate emails
  const templateId = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_EMAILJS_CUSTOMER_TEMPLATE_ID;
  const userId = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_EMAILJS_USER_ID;

  // If no customer template is configured, skip sending (prevents duplicates)
  if (!templateId) {
    console.log('Customer email template not configured, skipping customer confirmation');
    return;
  }

  if (!serviceId || !userId) {
    console.warn('EmailJS not configured for customer emails');
    return;
  }

  try {
    // Format cart items
    const itemsList = orderData.items
      .map((item, index) => {
        return `${index + 1}. ${item.title} (${item.selectedSize}, ${item.selectedColor}) x${item.quantity} - $${(item.price * item.quantity).toFixed(2)}`;
      })
      .join('\n');

    // Calculate totals
    const subtotal = orderData.items.reduce(
      (sum, item) => sum + item.price * item.quantity,
      0
    );
    const shipping = subtotal > 100 ? 0 : 10;
    const total = subtotal + shipping;

    const templateParams = {
      // Customer Information
      to_name: orderData.customerName,
      to_email: orderData.customerEmail,
      customer_name: orderData.customerName,
      customer_email: orderData.customerEmail,
      customer_phone: orderData.customerPhone,
      customer_address: orderData.customerAddress,
      
      // Order Items
      order_items: itemsList,
      items_count: orderData.items.length,
      
      // Order Totals
      subtotal: `$${subtotal.toFixed(2)}`,
      shipping: shipping === 0 ? 'FREE' : `$${shipping.toFixed(2)}`,
      total: `$${total.toFixed(2)}`,
      
      // Additional Information
      order_notes: orderData.notes || 'No additional notes',
      order_date: new Date().toLocaleString(),
      order_type: 'Regular Order',
      
      // Email subject
      subject: `Order Confirmation - Cobra Wear`,
    };

    const response = await emailjs.send(
      serviceId,
      templateId,
      templateParams,
      userId
    );

    return response.status === 200;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Customer email error:', error);
    // Don't throw error - customer email is not critical
    return false;
  }
}

/**
 * Send confirmation email to customer for POD orders
 */
export async function sendCustomerPODConfirmation(orderData) {
  const serviceId = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_EMAILJS_SERVICE_ID;
  // Only use CUSTOMER_TEMPLATE_ID - don't fallback to avoid duplicate emails
  const templateId = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_EMAILJS_CUSTOMER_TEMPLATE_ID;
  const userId = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_EMAILJS_USER_ID;

  // If no customer template is configured, skip sending (prevents duplicates)
  if (!templateId) {
    console.log('Customer email template not configured, skipping customer confirmation');
    return;
  }

  if (!serviceId || !userId) {
    console.warn('EmailJS not configured for customer emails');
    return;
  }

  try {
    // Format multiple design URLs properly
    let designInfo = '';
    if (orderData.designUrls && typeof orderData.designUrls === 'object') {
      // Multiple design URLs (new format)
      const designs = Object.entries(orderData.designUrls)
        .map(([area, url], index) => `${index + 1}. ${area.replace(/([A-Z])/g, ' $1').trim()}: ${url}`)
        .join('\n\n');
      designInfo = designs;
    } else if (orderData.designUrl) {
      // Single design URL (legacy format)
      designInfo = orderData.designUrl;
    }

    const templateParams = {
      // Customer Information
      to_name: orderData.customerName,
      to_email: orderData.customerEmail,
      customer_name: orderData.customerName,
      customer_email: orderData.customerEmail,
      customer_phone: orderData.customerPhone,
      customer_address: orderData.customerAddress,
      
      // POD Order Details
      product_type: orderData.productType,
      product_size: orderData.size || orderData.phoneModel || 'N/A',
      product_color: orderData.color,
      design_url: designInfo,
      
      // Additional Information
      order_notes: orderData.notes || 'No additional notes',
      order_date: new Date().toLocaleString(),
      order_type: 'Print-On-Demand Order',
      
      // Email subject
      subject: `POD Order Confirmation - Coobraa`,
    };

    const response = await emailjs.send(
      serviceId,
      templateId,
      templateParams,
      userId
    );

    return response.status === 200;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Customer email error:', error);
    // Don't throw error - customer email is not critical
    return false;
  }
}

```javascriptreact
/**
 * Product Detail Page
 * Dynamic route for individual product pages with Add to Cart
 */

import { notFound } from 'next/navigation';
import { products, getProductBySlug } from '@/data/products';
import ProductDetail from '@/components/ProductDetail';

export default function ProductDetailPage({ params }) {
  const product = getProductBySlug(params.slug);

  if (!product) {
    notFound();
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-white">
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-12">
        <ProductDetail product={product} />
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}

// Generate static params for all products
export async function generateStaticParams() {
  return products.map((product) => ({
    slug: product.slug,
  }));
}

// Generate metadata
export async function generateMetadata({ params }) {
  const product = getProductBySlug(params.slug);
  
  if (!product) {
    return {
      title: 'Product Not Found - Cobra Wear',
    };
  }

  return {
    title: `${product.title} - Cobra Wear`,
    description: product.description,
  };
}

```markdown
# Cobra Wear - Premium Clothing & Print-On-Demand

A modern Next.js 14 e-commerce website featuring both a traditional online store and a custom Print-On-Demand (POD) service.

## 🚀 Features

- **Clothing Store**: Browse and shop premium clothing products
- **Print-On-Demand Service**: Custom product design workflow
- **Cloudinary Integration**: Unsigned image uploads for user designs
- **EmailJS Integration**: Automated order confirmation emails
- **Minimal Black & White Design**: Clean, modern UI with Tailwind CSS
- **Fully Responsive**: Mobile-first design approach
- **Next.js 14 App Router**: Modern React Server Components
- **Ready for Vercel Deployment**: Optimized for production

## 📦 Tech Stack

- **Framework**: Next.js 14 (App Router)
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS
- **Image Uploads**: Cloudinary
- **Email Service**: EmailJS
- **Deployment**: Vercel-ready

## 🛠️ Installation

### Prerequisites

- Node.js 18.17 or later
- npm or yarn package manager

### Setup Steps

1. **Clone the repository**
   ```bash
   git clone <your-repo-url>
   cd coobraa
   ```

2. **Install dependencies**
   ```bash
   npm install
   # or
   yarn install
   ```

3. **Configure environment variables**
   
   Copy the example environment file:
   ```bash
   cp .env.local.example .env.local
   ```

   Then edit `.env.local` with your actual credentials (see below).

4. **Run the development server**
   ```bash
   npm run dev
   # or
   yarn dev
   ```

5. **Open your browser**
   
   Navigate to [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000)

## 🔑 Environment Variables Setup

### Cloudinary Configuration

1. **Sign up for Cloudinary** at [https://cloudinary.com](https://cloudinary.com)
2. **Create an unsigned upload preset**:
   - Go to Settings → Upload
   - Scroll to "Upload presets"
   - Click "Add upload preset"
   - Set "Signing Mode" to "Unsigned"
   - Save the preset name

3. **Add to `.env.local`**:
   ```env
   NEXT_PUBLIC_CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME=your_cloud_name
   NEXT_PUBLIC_CLOUDINARY_UPLOAD_PRESET=your_preset_name
   ```

### EmailJS Configuration

1. **Sign up for EmailJS** at [https://www.emailjs.com](https://www.emailjs.com)

2. **Create an Email Service**:
   - Go to Email Services
   - Add a new service (Gmail, Outlook, etc.)
   - Note your Service ID

3. **Create an Email Template**:
   - Go to Email Templates
   - Create a new template with these variables:
     - `{{customer_name}}`
     - `{{customer_email}}`
     - `{{customer_phone}}`
     - `{{customer_address}}`
     - `{{product_type}}`
     - `{{product_size}}`
     - `{{product_color}}`
     - `{{design_url}}`
     - `{{order_notes}}`
     - `{{order_date}}`
   - Note your Template ID

4. **Get your Public Key**:
   - Go to Account → General
   - Copy your Public Key (User ID)

5. **Add to `.env.local`**:
   ```env
   NEXT_PUBLIC_EMAILJS_SERVICE_ID=your_service_id
   NEXT_PUBLIC_EMAILJS_TEMPLATE_ID=your_template_id
   NEXT_PUBLIC_EMAILJS_USER_ID=your_public_key
   ```

6. **Update business email**:
   - Edit `src/lib/emailjs.js`
   - Change line 32: `to_email: 'your-business-email@example.com'`

## 📂 Project Structure

```
coobraa/
├── src/
│   ├── app/
│   │   ├── layout.jsx              # Root layout with navigation
│   │   ├── page.jsx                # Homepage
│   │   ├── globals.css             # Global styles
│   │   ├── pod/
│   │   │   └── page.jsx            # POD workflow page
│   │   └── products/
│   │       └── [slug]/
│   │           └── page.jsx        # Product detail pages
│   ├── components/
│   │   ├── Hero.jsx                # Hero section component
│   │   ├── ProductCard.jsx         # Product card component
│   │   └── PodUploadForm.jsx       # Complete POD form
│   └── lib/
│       ├── cloudinary.js           # Cloudinary upload utilities
│       └── emailjs.js              # EmailJS integration
├── public/                          # Static assets
├── .env.local.example              # Environment variables template
├── next.config.mjs                 # Next.js configuration
├── tailwind.config.js              # Tailwind CSS configuration
├── package.json                    # Dependencies
└── README.md                       # This file
```

## 🎨 Design System

### Color Palette
- **Primary**: Black (#000000)
- **Secondary**: White (#FFFFFF)
- **Accents**: Grey shades

### Typography
- Clean, modern sans-serif fonts
- Large spacing for readability
- Bold headings for impact

### Components
- Rounded corners (8px - 16px)
- Minimal borders and shadows
- Hover states for interactivity

## 🔄 POD Workflow

The Print-On-Demand feature includes a 5-step process:

1. **Select Product Type**: Hoodie, T-shirt, Cap, Tote Bag, or Shorts
2. **Choose Size**: S, M, L, XL options
3. **Pick Color**: Black, White, or Grey
4. **Upload Design**: Client-side upload to Cloudinary with live preview
5. **Enter Details**: Shipping information and checkout

### Payment Method
- **Cash on Delivery (COD)** only
- Order confirmation sent via EmailJS
- Manual order processing

## 🚀 Deployment

### Deploy to Vercel

1. **Push to GitHub**:
   ```bash
   git init
   git add .
   git commit -m "Initial commit"
   git remote add origin <your-repo-url>
   git push -u origin main
   ```

2. **Connect to Vercel**:
   - Go to [vercel.com](https://vercel.com)
   - Import your GitHub repository
   - Add environment variables from `.env.local`
   - Deploy!

### Environment Variables on Vercel

Make sure to add all environment variables in Vercel's project settings:
- `NEXT_PUBLIC_CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME`
- `NEXT_PUBLIC_CLOUDINARY_UPLOAD_PRESET`
- `NEXT_PUBLIC_EMAILJS_SERVICE_ID`
- `NEXT_PUBLIC_EMAILJS_TEMPLATE_ID`
- `NEXT_PUBLIC_EMAILJS_USER_ID`

## 📝 Customization

### Adding Products

Edit `src/app/page.jsx` to modify the product list:
```javascript
const SAMPLE_PRODUCTS = [
  {
    id: 1,
    title: 'Your Product Name',
    price: 49.99,
    image: '/path/to/image.jpg',
    slug: 'product-slug',
  },
  // Add more products...
];
```

### Styling Changes

- **Colors**: Edit `tailwind.config.js`
- **Global Styles**: Edit `src/app/globals.css`
- **Component Styles**: Use Tailwind classes inline

### EmailJS Template

Example template structure:
```
New Order from {{customer_name}}

Customer Details:
- Name: {{customer_name}}
- Email: {{customer_email}}
- Phone: {{customer_phone}}
- Address: {{customer_address}}

Order Details:
- Product: {{product_type}}
- Size: {{product_size}}
- Color: {{product_color}}

Design URL: {{design_url}}

Notes: {{order_notes}}
Order Date: {{order_date}}
```

## 🐛 Troubleshooting

### Cloudinary Upload Fails
- Verify your cloud name and upload preset are correct
- Ensure the upload preset is set to "Unsigned"
- Check browser console for errors

### EmailJS Not Sending
- Verify all environment variables are set correctly
- Check EmailJS dashboard for service status
- Ensure template variables match the ones in code
- Check browser console for errors

### Images Not Loading
- Verify Cloudinary domain is added to `next.config.mjs`
- Check that image URLs are valid
- Clear Next.js cache: `rm -rf .next`

**Date**: November 20, 2025

## 🎨 What Changed

Both email templates now have **identical modern design** with different content:

### **Synchronized Design Elements:**

✅ **Same Colors**: Black (#000000) + White (#FFFFFF) theme

✅ **Same Footer**: Grey background, centered text  
✅ **Same Alert Box**: Yellow warning with border  
✅ **Same Spacing**: 35px between sections, 15px padding

## 📧 Template Files Created

### 1. **Regular Order Template**
**File**: `EMAILJS_REGULAR_ORDER_TEMPLATE.html`

**Contains:**
- Customer Information
- Order Items (with count)

- Customer Notes
- Payment Method (COD)

### 2. **Print-On-Demand Template**
**File**: `EMAILJS_POD_ORDER_TEMPLATE.html`

**Contains:**
- Customer Information
- Product Details (Type, Size, Color)
- Customer Design Files (clickable links)
- Customer Notes
- Payment Method (COD)

## 🚀 How to Upload to EmailJS

### **Step 1: Regular Order Template**

1. Go to https://dashboard.emailjs.com/
2. Click **"Email Templates"**
3. Find your **Regular Order template**
4. Click **"Edit"**
5. **Delete** all existing content
6. **Open** `EMAILJS_REGULAR_ORDER_TEMPLATE.html`
7. **Copy** everything
8. **Paste** into EmailJS editor
9. Click **"Save"**

### **Step 2: POD Order Template**

1. Stay on EmailJS dashboard
2. Find your **POD template**
3. Click **"Edit"**
4. **Delete** all existing content
5. **Open** `EMAILJS_POD_ORDER_TEMPLATE.html`
6. **Copy** everything
7. **Paste** into EmailJS editor
8. Click **"Save"**

# Customer Email Templates Guide

**Date**: November 20, 2025  
**Status**: ✅ Complete

---

## 📧 Customer Templates Created

You now have **two customer-facing email templates** with synchronized design:

### 1. **Regular Order Confirmation** 
**File**: `EMAILJS_CUSTOMER_REGULAR_TEMPLATE.html`

**Sent to**: Customers who place regular orders  
**Purpose**: Confirm their order and thank them  
**Content**:
- ✅ Order confirmation message
- ✅ Order items list
- ✅ Order totals (Subtotal, Shipping, Total)
- ✅ Shipping address
- ✅ What happens next (4 steps)
- ✅ Payment method (COD)

### 2. **POD Order Confirmation**
**File**: `EMAILJS_CUSTOMER_POD_TEMPLATE.html`

**Sent to**: Customers who place Print-On-Demand orders  
**Purpose**: Confirm their custom order  
**Content**:
- ✅ Custom order confirmation message
- ✅ Product details (Type, Size, Color)
- ✅ Shipping address
- ✅ What happens next (5 steps including production)
- ✅ Payment method (COD)

---

## 🎨 Design Features

Both templates share the **same modern design** with:

✅ **Black header** with "COBRA WEAR" branding  
✅ **Friendly greeting** ("Hi {{to_name}}")  
✅ **Thank you message**  
✅ **Clear sections** with uppercase titles  
✅ **Green "What's Next" box** with step-by-step guide  
✅ **Yellow payment box** highlighting COD  
✅ **Professional footer** with contact info  

---

## 🔧 EmailJS Setup

### **Step 1: Create Customer Templates in EmailJS**

1. Login to https://dashboard.emailjs.com/
2. Go to **"Email Templates"**
3. Click **"Create New Template"**
4. Name it: **"Customer Regular Order Confirmation"**
5. Copy content from `EMAILJS_CUSTOMER_REGULAR_TEMPLATE.html`
6. Paste into EmailJS editor
7. **Save** and note the **Template ID**

8. Click **"Create New Template"** again
9. Name it: **"Customer POD Order Confirmation"**
10. Copy content from `EMAILJS_CUSTOMER_POD_TEMPLATE.html`
11. Paste into EmailJS editor
12. **Save** and note the **Template ID**

### **Step 2: Update Environment Variables**

Add the new customer template IDs to your `.env.local`:

```bash
# Customer-facing email templates
NEXT_PUBLIC_EMAILJS_CUSTOMER_REGULAR_TEMPLATE_ID=template_xxxxxxx
NEXT_PUBLIC_EMAILJS_CUSTOMER_POD_TEMPLATE_ID=template_yyyyyyy
```

**Note**: If you don't set these, customer emails won't be sent (which prevents duplicate business emails).

---

## 📋 Required Variables

### **Regular Order Customer Template:**
- `{{to_name}}` - Customer's name
- `{{order_date}}` - Date order was placed
- `{{items_count}}` - Number of items
- `{{order_items}}` - List of ordered items
- `{{subtotal}}` - Order subtotal
- `{{shipping}}` - Shipping cost
- `{{total}}` - Total amount
- `{{customer_address}}` - Delivery address
- `{{customer_email}}` - Customer's email

### **POD Customer Template:**
- `{{to_name}}` - Customer's name
- `{{order_date}}` - Date order was placed
- `{{product_type}}` - Type of custom product
- `{{product_size}}` - Selected size
- `{{product_color}}` - Selected color
- `{{customer_address}}` - Delivery address
- `{{customer_email}}` - Customer's email

---

## 🔄 How It Works

### **Regular Order Flow:**
1. Customer places order → **Business receives**: `EMAILJS_REGULAR_ORDER_TEMPLATE.html`
2. Customer receives: `EMAILJS_CUSTOMER_REGULAR_TEMPLATE.html`

### **POD Order Flow:**
1. Customer places POD order → **Business receives**: `EMAILJS_POD_ORDER_TEMPLATE.html`
2. Customer receives: `EMAILJS_CUSTOMER_POD_TEMPLATE.html`

---

## 📁 Complete Template Structure

```
Email Templates:
├── Business Emails (Internal)
│   ├── EMAILJS_REGULAR_ORDER_TEMPLATE.html    → Business notification
│   └── EMAILJS_POD_ORDER_TEMPLATE.html        → Business notification
│
└── Customer Emails (Customer-facing)
    ├── EMAILJS_CUSTOMER_REGULAR_TEMPLATE.html → Customer confirmation
    └── EMAILJS_CUSTOMER_POD_TEMPLATE.html     → Customer confirmation
```

---

## ✅ Key Differences

### **Business Templates vs Customer Templates:**

| Aspect | Business Templates | Customer Templates |
|--------|-------------------|-------------------|
| **Tone** | Professional/Technical | Friendly/Welcoming |
| **Purpose** | Notify business of order | Thank customer |
| **Header** | 🛍️/🎨 + "Order" | ✅ + "Confirmed" |
| **Action** | "Action Required" box | "What's Next" steps |
| **Greeting** | Direct to business | "Hi {{to_name}}" |
| **Design URLs** | Clickable links (POD) | Not shown to customer |
| **Footer** | Store notification | Thank you message |

---

## 🧪 Testing

1. Go to EmailJS dashboard
2. Open "Customer Regular Order Confirmation" template
3. Click **"Test It"**
4. Fill in test data
5. Send to your email

### **Test Customer POD Order:**

## 💡 Tips

4. **Professional**: Despite being friendly, still looks professional

Customer templates do **NOT** show:

```javascript
/**
 * Customer Email Confirmation
 * Sends order confirmation emails to customers
 */

import emailjs from '@emailjs/browser';

/**
 * Send confirmation email to customer for regular orders
 */
export async function sendCustomerOrderConfirmation(orderData) {
  const serviceId = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_EMAILJS_SERVICE_ID;
  // Use dedicated customer regular template
  const templateId = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_EMAILJS_CUSTOMER_REGULAR_TEMPLATE_ID;
  const userId = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_EMAILJS_USER_ID;

  // If no customer template is configured, skip sending (prevents duplicates)
  if (!templateId) {
    console.log('Customer regular email template not configured, skipping customer confirmation');
    return;
  }

  if (!serviceId || !userId) {
    console.warn('EmailJS not configured for customer emails');
    return;
  }

  try {
    // Format cart items
    const itemsList = orderData.items
      .map((item, index) => {
        return `${index + 1}. ${item.title} (${item.selectedSize}, ${item.selectedColor}) x${item.quantity} - $${(item.price * item.quantity).toFixed(2)}`;
      })
      .join('\n');

    // Calculate totals
    const subtotal = orderData.items.reduce(
      (sum, item) => sum + item.price * item.quantity,
      0
    );
    const shipping = subtotal > 100 ? 0 : 10;
    const total = subtotal + shipping;

    const templateParams = {
      // Customer Information
      to_name: orderData.customerName,
      to_email: orderData.customerEmail,
      customer_name: orderData.customerName,
      customer_email: orderData.customerEmail,
      customer_phone: orderData.customerPhone,
      customer_address: orderData.customerAddress,
      
      // Order Items
      order_items: itemsList,
      items_count: orderData.items.length,
      
      // Order Totals
      subtotal: `$${subtotal.toFixed(2)}`,
      shipping: shipping === 0 ? 'FREE' : `$${shipping.toFixed(2)}`,
      total: `$${total.toFixed(2)}`,
      
      // Additional Information
      order_notes: orderData.notes || 'No additional notes',
      order_date: new Date().toLocaleString(),
      order_type: 'Regular Order',
      
      // Email subject
      subject: `Order Confirmation - Cobra Wear`,
    };

    const response = await emailjs.send(
      serviceId,
      templateId,
      templateParams,
      userId
    );

    return response.status === 200;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Customer email error:', error);
    // Don't throw error - customer email is not critical
    return false;
  }
}

/**
 * Send confirmation email to customer for POD orders
 */
export async function sendCustomerPODConfirmation(orderData) {
  const serviceId = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_EMAILJS_SERVICE_ID;
  // Only use CUSTOMER_TEMPLATE_ID - don't fallback to avoid duplicate emails
  const templateId = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_EMAILJS_CUSTOMER_TEMPLATE_ID;
  const userId = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_EMAILJS_USER_ID;

  // If no customer template is configured, skip sending (prevents duplicates)
  if (!templateId) {
    console.log('Customer email template not configured, skipping customer confirmation');
    return;
  }

  if (!serviceId || !userId) {
    console.warn('EmailJS not configured for customer emails');
    return;
  }

  try {
    // Format multiple design URLs properly
    let designInfo = '';
    if (orderData.designUrls && typeof orderData.designUrls === 'object') {
      // Multiple design URLs (new format)
      const designs = Object.entries(orderData.designUrls)
        .map(([area, url], index) => `${index + 1}. ${area.replace(/([A-Z])/g, ' $1').trim()}: ${url}`)
        .join('\n\n');
      designInfo = designs;
    } else if (orderData.designUrl) {
      // Single design URL (legacy format)
      designInfo = orderData.designUrl;
    }

    const templateParams = {
      // Customer Information
      to_name: orderData.customerName,
      to_email: orderData.customerEmail,
      customer_name: orderData.customerName,
      customer_email: orderData.customerEmail,
      customer_phone: orderData.customerPhone,
      customer_address: orderData.customerAddress,
      
      // POD Order Details
      product_type: orderData.productType,
      product_size: orderData.size || orderData.phoneModel || 'N/A',
      product_color: orderData.color,
      design_url: designInfo,
      
      // Additional Information
      order_notes: orderData.notes || 'No additional notes',
      order_date: new Date().toLocaleString(),
      order_type: 'Print-On-Demand Order',
      
      // Email subject
      subject: `POD Order Confirmation - Cobra Wear`,
    };

    const response = await emailjs.send(
      serviceId,
      templateId,
      templateParams,
      userId
    );

    return response.status === 200;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Customer email error:', error);
    // Don't throw error - customer email is not critical
    return false;
  }
}

# Coobraa Environment Variables

# Main EmailJS credentials
NEXT_PUBLIC_EMAILJS_SERVICE_ID=your_service_id_here
NEXT_PUBLIC_EMAILJS_USER_ID=your_public_key_here

# Business email templates (internal notifications)
# Email template for POD (Print-On-Demand) orders - sent to business
NEXT_PUBLIC_EMAILJS_TEMPLATE_ID=your_pod_template_id_here

# Email template for regular orders - sent to business

# If not set, only business notifications will be sent

# Create a GA4 property and copy the Measurement ID (format: G-XXXXXXXXXX)

# Instructions
# ====================
# After filling in your values:
# 1. Save this file as .env.local (NOT env.example)
# 2. Never commit .env.local to version control

#
# For production deployment (Vercel):

```plaintext
# Cobra Wear Environment Variables
# Copy this file to .env.local and fill in your actual values

# ====================
# Cloudinary Configuration
# ====================
# Get these from: https://cloudinary.com/console
# 1. Sign up for a free account
# 2. Go to Settings > Upload
# 3. Create an unsigned upload preset
# 4. Copy your Cloud Name from the dashboard

NEXT_PUBLIC_CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME=your_cloud_name_here
NEXT_PUBLIC_CLOUDINARY_UPLOAD_PRESET=your_upload_preset_here

# ====================
# EmailJS Configuration
# ====================
# Get these from: https://www.emailjs.com/
# 1. Sign up for a free account
# 2. Create an email service (Gmail, Outlook, etc.)
# 3. Create email templates (one for POD orders, one for regular orders)
# 4. Get your Public Key from Account > General

# Main EmailJS credentials
NEXT_PUBLIC_EMAILJS_SERVICE_ID=your_service_id_here
NEXT_PUBLIC_EMAILJS_USER_ID=your_public_key_here

# Business email templates (internal notifications)
# Email template for POD (Print-On-Demand) orders - sent to business
NEXT_PUBLIC_EMAILJS_TEMPLATE_ID=your_pod_template_id_here

# Email template for regular orders - sent to business
NEXT_PUBLIC_EMAILJS_REGULAR_TEMPLATE_ID=your_regular_template_id_here

# Customer email templates (optional - for sending confirmations to customers)
# If not set, only business notifications will be sent
# Email template for customer regular order confirmations
NEXT_PUBLIC_EMAILJS_CUSTOMER_REGULAR_TEMPLATE_ID=your_customer_regular_template_id_here

# Email template for customer POD order confirmations
NEXT_PUBLIC_EMAILJS_CUSTOMER_POD_TEMPLATE_ID=your_customer_pod_template_id_here

# ====================
# Google Analytics (Optional)
# ====================
# Get this from: https://analytics.google.com/
# Create a GA4 property and copy the Measurement ID (format: G-XXXXXXXXXX)

NEXT_PUBLIC_GA_MEASUREMENT_ID=G-XXXXXXXXXX

# ====================
# Instructions
# ====================
# After filling in your values:
# 1. Save this file as .env.local (NOT env.example)
# 2. Never commit .env.local to version control
# 3. Make sure .env.local is in your .gitignore
# 4. Restart your dev server after making changes
#
# For production deployment (Vercel):
# - Add all these variables in your Vercel project settings
# - Go to: Project Settings > Environment Variables
# - Add each variable with its production value


```

                className="group bg-white p-6 sm:p-8 rounded-2xl text-center hover:shadow-xl transition-all duration-300 border border-gray-200 hover:scale-105 hover:-translate-y-1"
              >
                <div className="text-4xl sm:text-5xl mb-3 transition-transform group-hover:scale-110">{style.emoji}</div>
                <h3 className="font-semibold text-sm sm:text-base mb-2 group-hover:text-gray-600 transition-colors">{style.name}</h3>
                <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-gray-500">{style.desc}</p>
              </Link>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

## 2. **Global Styles - Animations & Smooth Scrolling**

```css
@tailwind base;
@tailwind components;
@tailwind utilities;

* {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

html {
  scroll-behavior: smooth;
}

body {
  font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Roboto', 'Oxygen',
    'Ubuntu', 'Cantarell', 'Fira Sans', 'Droid Sans', 'Helvetica Neue',
    sans-serif;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
}

@layer components {
  .btn-primary {
    @apply bg-black text-white px-8 py-4 rounded-lg font-medium hover:bg-gray-800 transition-all duration-300 hover:scale-105 hover:shadow-lg;
  }
  
  .btn-secondary {
    @apply bg-white text-black px-8 py-4 rounded-lg font-medium border-2 border-black hover:bg-black hover:text-white transition-all duration-300 hover:scale-105;
  }
}

@layer utilities {
  /* Modern Animations */
  @keyframes fadeIn {
    from {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(20px);
    }
    to {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateY(0);
    }
  }

  @keyframes slideUp {
    from {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(30px);
    }
    to {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateY(0);
    }
  }

  @keyframes float {
    0%, 100% {
      transform: translateY(0px);
    }
    50% {
      transform: translateY(-20px);
    }
  }

  @keyframes floatDelayed {
    0%, 100% {
      transform: translateY(0px);
    }
    50% {
      transform: translateY(-15px);
    }
  }

  @keyframes subtleFloat {
    0%, 100% {
      transform: translateY(0px) scale(1);
    }
    50% {
      transform: translateY(-5px) scale(1.02);
    }
  }

  @keyframes bounceSlow {
    0%, 100% {
      transform: translateY(0);
    }
    50% {
      transform: translateY(-10px);
    }
  }

  .animate-fade-in {
    animation: fadeIn 0.6s ease-out;
  }

  .animate-slide-up {
    animation: slideUp 0.8s ease-out;
  }

  .animate-float {
    animation: float 6s ease-in-out infinite;
  }

  .animate-float-delayed {
    animation: floatDelayed 6s ease-in-out infinite 1s;
  }

  .animate-subtle-float {
    animation: subtleFloat 4s ease-in-out infinite;
  }

  .animate-bounce-slow {
    animation: bounceSlow 3s ease-in-out infinite;
  }

  /* Hover Effects */
  .hover-lift {
    @apply transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-2 hover:shadow-xl;
  }

  .hover-scale {
    @apply transition-transform duration-300 hover:scale-105;
  }

  /* Focus Styles for Accessibility */
  .focus-ring {
    @apply focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-black focus:ring-offset-2;
  }

  /* Card Shadows */
  .card-shadow {
    @apply shadow-md hover:shadow-2xl transition-shadow duration-300;
  }

  /* Responsive Text */
  .text-responsive-sm {
    @apply text-sm sm:text-base;
  }

  .text-responsive-base {
    @apply text-base sm:text-lg;
  }

  .text-responsive-lg {
    @apply text-lg sm:text-xl;
  }

  .text-responsive-xl {
    @apply text-xl sm:text-2xl md:text-3xl;
  }

  .text-responsive-2xl {
    @apply text-2xl sm:text-3xl md:text-4xl;
  }

  .text-responsive-3xl {
    @apply text-3xl sm:text-4xl md:text-5xl;
  }

  /* Responsive Padding */
  .section-padding {
    @apply py-16 sm:py-20 lg:py-24;
  }

  .section-padding-sm {
    @apply py-12 sm:py-16 lg:py-20;
  }

  /* Container Responsive */
  .container-responsive {
    @apply px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8;
  }
}

/* Custom Scrollbar */
::-webkit-scrollbar {
  width: 10px;
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
  background: #f1f1f1;
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background: #888;
  border-radius: 5px;
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
  background: #555;
}

/* Loading Skeleton */
@keyframes shimmer {
  0% {
    background-position: -1000px 0;
  }
  100% {
    background-position: 1000px 0;
  }
}

.skeleton {
  animation: shimmer 2s infinite;
  background: linear-gradient(to right, #f0f0f0 4%, #e0e0e0 25%, #f0f0f0 36%);
  background-size: 1000px 100%;
}

/* Image Optimization */
img {
  max-width: 100%;
  height: auto;
}

## 3. **Mobile Navbar with Hamburger Menu**

```javascriptreact
'use client';

/**
 * Navbar Component
 * Responsive navigation with hamburger menu for mobile
 */

import Link from 'next/link';
import { useCart } from '@/context/CartContext';
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';

export default function Navbar() {
  const { getCartItemsCount } = useCart();
  const cartCount = getCartItemsCount();
  const [isMenuOpen, setIsMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const [scrolled, setScrolled] = useState(false);

  // Handle scroll effect
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleScroll = () => {
      setScrolled(window.scrollY > 10);
    };
    window.addEventListener('scroll', handleScroll);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', handleScroll);
  }, []);

  // Prevent body scroll when menu is open
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isMenuOpen) {
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    } else {
      document.body.style.overflow = 'unset';
    }
    return () => {
      document.body.style.overflow = 'unset';
    };
  }, [isMenuOpen]);

  const toggleMenu = () => setIsMenuOpen(!isMenuOpen);
  const closeMenu = () => setIsMenuOpen(false);

  const navLinks = [
    { href: '/', label: 'Home', ariaLabel: 'Go to home page' },
    { href: '/products', label: 'Shop', ariaLabel: 'View all products' },
    { href: '/products?category=tshirts', label: 'T-Shirts', ariaLabel: 'Shop t-shirts' },
    { href: '/products?category=hoodies', label: 'Hoodies', ariaLabel: 'Shop hoodies' },
    { href: '/products?category=caps', label: 'Caps', ariaLabel: 'Shop caps' },
    { href: '/pod', label: 'Custom POD', ariaLabel: 'Print on demand custom designs' },
  ];

  return (
    <nav 
      className={`border-b border-gray-200 bg-white sticky top-0 z-50 transition-shadow duration-300 ${
        scrolled ? 'shadow-md' : ''
      }`}
      role="navigation" 
      aria-label="Main navigation"
    >
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center h-16 sm:h-18">
          {/* Logo */}
          <Link 
            href="/" 
            className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight hover:opacity-80 transition-opacity z-50"
            aria-label="Cobra Wear home"
            onClick={closeMenu}
          >
            COBRA WEAR
          </Link>
          
          {/* Desktop Navigation */}
          <div className="hidden lg:flex items-center space-x-8" role="menubar">
            {navLinks.slice(0, 3).map((link) => (
              <Link 
                key={link.href}
                href={link.href} 
                className="hover:text-gray-600 transition-colors font-medium"
                role="menuitem"
                aria-label={link.ariaLabel}
              >
                {link.label}
              </Link>
            ))}
            <Link 
              href="/pod" 
              className="hover:text-gray-600 transition-colors font-medium"
              role="menuitem"
              aria-label="Print on demand custom designs"
            >
              POD
            </Link>
            
            {/* Cart Icon */}
            <Link 
              href="/cart" 
              className="relative hover:text-gray-600 transition-colors"
              role="menuitem"
              aria-label={cartCount > 0 ? `Shopping cart with ${cartCount} items` : 'Shopping cart (empty)'}
            >
              <svg
                className="w-6 h-6"
                fill="none"
                stroke="currentColor"
                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                aria-hidden="true"
              >
                <path
                  strokeLinecap="round"
                  strokeLinejoin="round"
                  strokeWidth={2}
                  d="M3 3h2l.4 2M7 13h10l4-8H5.4M7 13L5.4 5M7 13l-2.293 2.293c-.63.63-.184 1.707.707 1.707H17m0 0a2 2 0 100 4 2 2 0 000-4zm-8 2a2 2 0 11-4 0 2 2 0 014 0z"
                />
              </svg>
              
              {cartCount > 0 && (
                <span 
                  className="absolute -top-2 -right-2 bg-black text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-full w-5 h-5 flex items-center justify-center"
                  aria-label={`${cartCount} items in cart`}
                >
                  {cartCount > 9 ? '9+' : cartCount}
                </span>
              )}
            </Link>
          </div>

          {/* Mobile Menu Button & Cart */}
          <div className="flex lg:hidden items-center space-x-4 z-50">
            {/* Mobile Cart Icon */}
            <Link 
              href="/cart" 
              className="relative hover:text-gray-600 transition-colors"
              aria-label={cartCount > 0 ? `Shopping cart with ${cartCount} items` : 'Shopping cart (empty)'}
              onClick={closeMenu}
            >
              <svg
                className="w-6 h-6"
                fill="none"
                stroke="currentColor"
                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                aria-hidden="true"
              >
                <path
                  strokeLinecap="round"
                  strokeLinejoin="round"
                  strokeWidth={2}
                  d="M3 3h2l.4 2M7 13h10l4-8H5.4M7 13L5.4 5M7 13l-2.293 2.293c-.63.63-.184 1.707.707 1.707H17m0 0a2 2 0 100 4 2 2 0 000-4zm-8 2a2 2 0 11-4 0 2 2 0 014 0z"
                />
              </svg>
              
              {cartCount > 0 && (
                <span 
                  className="absolute -top-2 -right-2 bg-black text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-full w-5 h-5 flex items-center justify-center"
                  aria-label={`${cartCount} items in cart`}
                >
                  {cartCount > 9 ? '9+' : cartCount}
                </span>
              )}
            </Link>

            {/* Hamburger Button */}
            <button
              onClick={toggleMenu}
              className="p-2 hover:bg-gray-100 rounded-lg transition-colors"
              aria-label={isMenuOpen ? 'Close menu' : 'Open menu'}
              aria-expanded={isMenuOpen}
              aria-controls="mobile-menu"
            >
              <div className="w-6 h-5 flex flex-col justify-between">
                <span 
                  className={`block h-0.5 w-full bg-black transition-all duration-300 ${
                    isMenuOpen ? 'rotate-45 translate-y-2' : ''
                  }`}
                ></span>
                <span 
                  className={`block h-0.5 w-full bg-black transition-all duration-300 ${
                    isMenuOpen ? 'opacity-0' : ''
                  }`}
                ></span>
                <span 
                  className={`block h-0.5 w-full bg-black transition-all duration-300 ${
                    isMenuOpen ? '-rotate-45 -translate-y-2' : ''
                  }`}
                ></span>
              </div>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Mobile Menu Overlay */}
      {isMenuOpen && (
        <div 
          className="lg:hidden fixed inset-0 bg-black bg-opacity-50 z-40 animate-fade-in"
          onClick={closeMenu}
          aria-hidden="true"
        ></div>
      )}

      {/* Mobile Menu */}
      <div
        id="mobile-menu"
        className={`lg:hidden fixed top-16 right-0 bottom-0 w-full sm:w-80 bg-white shadow-2xl z-40 transform transition-transform duration-300 ease-in-out ${
          isMenuOpen ? 'translate-x-0' : 'translate-x-full'
        }`}
        role="menu"
      >
        <div className="flex flex-col h-full overflow-y-auto">
          {/* Menu Header */}
          <div className="border-b border-gray-200 p-6">
            <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900">Menu</h2>
          </div>

          {/* Menu Links */}
          <nav className="flex-1 p-6 space-y-1">
            {navLinks.map((link) => (
              <Link
                key={link.href}
                href={link.href}
                onClick={closeMenu}
                className="block px-4 py-3 text-base font-medium text-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-50 hover:text-black rounded-lg transition-colors"
                role="menuitem"
                aria-label={link.ariaLabel}
              >
                {link.label}
              </Link>
            ))}
          </nav>

          {/* Menu Footer */}
          <div className="border-t border-gray-200 p-6 space-y-3">
            <Link
              href="/cart"
              onClick={closeMenu}
              className="block w-full bg-black text-white text-center py-3 rounded-lg font-medium hover:bg-gray-800 transition-colors"
            >
              View Cart {cartCount > 0 && `(${cartCount})`}
            </Link>
            <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 text-center">
              © 2025 Cobra Wear
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </nav>
  );
}

```

## 4. **Product Grid - 2 Columns on Mobile**

```javascriptreact
'use client';

/**
 * Products Listing Page
 * All products with category and style filters
 */

import { useState, useEffect, Suspense } from 'react';
import { useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation';
import ProductCard from '@/components/ProductCard';
import { ProductCardSkeleton } from '@/components/Skeleton';
import { products, categories, styles, getProductsByCategory, getProductsByStyle } from '@/data/products';

function ProductsContent() {
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const [selectedCategory, setSelectedCategory] = useState('all');
  const [selectedStyle, setSelectedStyle] = useState('all');

  // Apply filters from URL parameters on page load
  useEffect(() => {
    const categoryParam = searchParams.get('category');
    const styleParam = searchParams.get('style');
    
    if (categoryParam) {
      setSelectedCategory(categoryParam);
    }
    
    if (styleParam) {
      setSelectedStyle(styleParam);
    }
  }, [searchParams]);

  // Filter products based on both category and style
  let filteredProducts = products;

  if (selectedCategory !== 'all') {
    filteredProducts = getProductsByCategory(selectedCategory);
  }

  if (selectedStyle !== 'all') {
    filteredProducts = filteredProducts.filter(product => product.style === selectedStyle);
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-white">
      {/* Header */}
      <section className="bg-gray-50 border-b border-gray-200">
        <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-12">
          <h1 className="text-4xl md:text-5xl font-bold mb-4">
            Shop All Products
          </h1>
          <p className="text-xl text-gray-600">
            Discover our complete collection of premium clothing
          </p>
        </div>
      </section>

      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-12">
        {/* Category Filters */}
        <div className="mb-8">
          <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold mb-4">Shop by Category</h2>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
            {categories.map((category) => (
              <button
                key={category.id}
                onClick={() => setSelectedCategory(category.id)}
                className={`px-6 py-3 rounded-lg font-medium transition-all ${
                  selectedCategory === category.id
                    ? 'bg-black text-white'
                    : 'bg-white border-2 border-gray-300 hover:border-black'
                }`}
              >
                {category.name}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Style Filters */}
        <div className="mb-12">
          <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold mb-4">Shop by Style</h2>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
            {styles.map((style) => (
              <button
                key={style.id}
                onClick={() => setSelectedStyle(style.id)}
                className={`px-6 py-3 rounded-lg font-medium transition-all ${
                  selectedStyle === style.id
                    ? 'bg-black text-white'
                    : 'bg-white border-2 border-gray-300 hover:border-black'
                }`}
              >
                {style.name}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Products Count */}
        <div className="mb-8">
          <p className="text-gray-600">
            Showing <span className="font-bold text-black">{filteredProducts.length}</span> {filteredProducts.length === 1 ? 'product' : 'products'}
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Products Grid - 2 columns on mobile */}
        {filteredProducts.length > 0 ? (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 sm:gap-6 lg:gap-8">
            {filteredProducts.map((product) => (
              <ProductCard key={product.id} product={product} />
            ))}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="text-center py-20">
            <svg
              className="w-24 h-24 text-gray-300 mx-auto mb-4"
              fill="none"
              stroke="currentColor"
              viewBox="0 0 24 24"
            >
              <path
                strokeLinecap="round"
                strokeLinejoin="round"
                strokeWidth={1}
                d="M20 13V6a2 2 0 00-2-2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v7m16 0v5a2 2 0 01-2 2H6a2 2 0 01-2-2v-5m16 0h-2.586a1 1 0 00-.707.293l-2.414 2.414a1 1 0 01-.707.293h-3.172a1 1 0 01-.707-.293l-2.414-2.414A1 1 0 006.586 13H4"
              />
            </svg>
            <h3 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-2">No products found</h3>
            <p className="text-gray-600">Try selecting a different category</p>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}

export default function ProductsPage() {
  return (
    <Suspense fallback={
      <main className="min-h-screen bg-white">
        <section className="bg-gray-50 border-b border-gray-200">
          <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-12">
            <div className="h-12 bg-gray-200 rounded w-1/3 mb-4 animate-pulse"></div>
            <div className="h-6 bg-gray-200 rounded w-1/2 animate-pulse"></div>
          </div>
        </section>
        <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-12">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-8">
            {[...Array(8)].map((_, i) => (
              <ProductCardSkeleton key={i} />
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </main>
    }>
      <ProductsContent />
    </Suspense>
  );
}


```

            <div className="h-6 bg-gray-200 rounded w-1/2 animate-pulse"></div>
          </div>
        </section>
        <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-12">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 sm:gap-6 lg:gap-8">
            {[...Array(8)].map((_, i) => (
              <ProductCardSkeleton key={i} />
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </main>
    }>
      <ProductsContent />
    </Suspense>
  );
}

## 5. **Improved ProductCard Component**

```javascriptreact
'use client';

/**
 * ProductCard Component
 * Modern, responsive card component for displaying products
 */

import Image from 'next/image';
import Link from 'next/link';

export default function ProductCard({ product }) {
  const { title, price, images, slug, inStock } = product;
  const image = images && images[0];

  return (
    <article 
      className="group bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-xl overflow-hidden hover:shadow-2xl transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1 flex flex-col h-full"
      aria-label={`${title} product card`}
    >
      {/* Product Image */}
      <Link href={`/products/${slug}`} aria-label={`View ${title} details`}>
        <div className="relative aspect-square bg-gray-50 overflow-hidden cursor-pointer">
          {image ? (
            <Image
              src={image}
              alt={`${title} product image`}
              fill
              className="object-cover group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform duration-500"
            />
          ) : (
            <div className="w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center" role="img" aria-label="Product image placeholder">
              <svg
                className="w-16 h-16 sm:w-20 sm:h-20 lg:w-24 lg:h-24 text-gray-300"
                fill="none"
                stroke="currentColor"
                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                aria-hidden="true"
              >
                <path
                  strokeLinecap="round"
                  strokeLinejoin="round"
                  strokeWidth={1}
                  d="M4 16l4.586-4.586a2 2 0 012.828 0L16 16m-2-2l1.586-1.586a2 2 0 012.828 0L20 14m-6-6h.01M6 20h12a2 2 0 002-2V6a2 2 0 00-2-2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v12a2 2 0 002 2z"
                />
              </svg>
            </div>
          )}
          
          {/* Out of Stock Overlay */}
          {!inStock && (
            <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black bg-opacity-60 flex items-center justify-center" role="status">
              <span className="bg-white px-3 py-2 sm:px-4 sm:py-2 rounded-lg font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm">
                OUT OF STOCK
              </span>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Hover Overlay */}
          <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black bg-opacity-0 group-hover:bg-opacity-10 transition-all duration-300 flex items-center justify-center">
            <span className="text-white font-bold text-sm sm:text-base opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transform translate-y-4 group-hover:translate-y-0 transition-all duration-300">
              View Details
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </Link>

      {/* Product Info */}
      <div className="p-3 sm:p-4 lg:p-6 flex flex-col flex-1">
        <Link href={`/products/${slug}`}>
          <h3 className="text-sm sm:text-base lg:text-lg font-semibold mb-2 group-hover:text-gray-600 transition-colors cursor-pointer line-clamp-2">
            {title}
          </h3>
        </Link>
        <p className="text-lg sm:text-xl lg:text-2xl font-bold mb-3 sm:mb-4" aria-label={`Price: ${price.toFixed(2)} dollars`}>
          ${price.toFixed(2)}
        </p>
        
        {/* Spacer to push button to bottom */}
        <div className="flex-1"></div>
        
        <Link
          href={`/products/${slug}`}
          className="block w-full bg-black text-white text-center py-2.5 sm:py-3 rounded-lg text-sm sm:text-base font-medium hover:bg-gray-800 transition-all duration-300 hover:scale-105 mt-auto"
          aria-label={`View ${title} details and purchase options`}
        >
          {inStock ? 'View Details' : 'View Product'}
        </Link>
      </div>
    </article>
  );
}

## 7. **Products Page Improvements**

```javascriptreact
'use client';

/**
 * Products Listing Page
 * Fully responsive with modern UI and filters
 */

import { useState, useEffect, Suspense } from 'react';
import { useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation';
import ProductCard from '@/components/ProductCard';
import { ProductCardSkeleton } from '@/components/Skeleton';
import { products, categories, styles, getProductsByCategory, getProductsByStyle } from '@/data/products';

function ProductsContent() {
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const [selectedCategory, setSelectedCategory] = useState('all');
  const [selectedStyle, setSelectedStyle] = useState('all');

  // Apply filters from URL parameters on page load
  useEffect(() => {
    const categoryParam = searchParams.get('category');
    const styleParam = searchParams.get('style');
    
    if (categoryParam) {
      setSelectedCategory(categoryParam);
    }
    
    if (styleParam) {
      setSelectedStyle(styleParam);
    }
  }, [searchParams]);

  // Filter products based on both category and style
  let filteredProducts = products;

  if (selectedCategory !== 'all') {
    filteredProducts = getProductsByCategory(selectedCategory);
  }

  if (selectedStyle !== 'all') {
    filteredProducts = filteredProducts.filter(product => product.style === selectedStyle);
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-white">
      {/* Header */}
      <section className="bg-gradient-to-b from-gray-50 to-white border-b border-gray-200">
        <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-12 sm:py-16 lg:py-20">
          <h1 className="text-3xl sm:text-4xl md:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold mb-4 animate-fade-in">
            Shop All Products
          </h1>
          <p className="text-base sm:text-lg lg:text-xl text-gray-600 animate-slide-up">
            Discover our complete collection of premium clothing
          </p>
        </div>
      </section>

      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8 sm:py-12">
        {/* Category Filters */}
        <div className="mb-8 sm:mb-10">
          <h2 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-semibold mb-4">Shop by Category</h2>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 sm:gap-3">
            {categories.map((category) => (
              <button
                key={category.id}
                onClick={() => setSelectedCategory(category.id)}
                className={`px-4 sm:px-6 py-2 sm:py-3 rounded-lg font-medium transition-all text-sm sm:text-base hover:scale-105 ${
                  selectedCategory === category.id
                    ? 'bg-black text-white shadow-lg'
                    : 'bg-white border-2 border-gray-300 hover:border-black'
                }`}
              >
                {category.name}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Style Filters */}
        <div className="mb-10 sm:mb-12">
          <h2 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-semibold mb-4">Shop by Style</h2>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 sm:gap-3">
            {styles.map((style) => (
              <button
                key={style.id}
                onClick={() => setSelectedStyle(style.id)}
                className={`px-4 sm:px-6 py-2 sm:py-3 rounded-lg font-medium transition-all text-sm sm:text-base hover:scale-105 ${
                  selectedStyle === style.id
                    ? 'bg-black text-white shadow-lg'
                    : 'bg-white border-2 border-gray-300 hover:border-black'
                }`}
              >
                {style.name}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Products Count */}
        <div className="mb-6 sm:mb-8">
          <p className="text-sm sm:text-base text-gray-600">
            Showing <span className="font-bold text-black">{filteredProducts.length}</span> {filteredProducts.length === 1 ? 'product' : 'products'}
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Products Grid - 2 columns on mobile */}
        {filteredProducts.length > 0 ? (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 sm:gap-6 lg:gap-8">
            {filteredProducts.map((product) => (
              <ProductCard key={product.id} product={product} />
            ))}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="text-center py-16 sm:py-20">
            <svg
              className="w-20 h-20 sm:w-24 sm:h-24 text-gray-300 mx-auto mb-4"
              fill="none"
              stroke="currentColor"
              viewBox="0 0 24 24"
            >
              <path
                strokeLinecap="round"
                strokeLinejoin="round"
                strokeWidth={1}
                d="M20 13V6a2 2 0 00-2-2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v7m16 0v5a2 2 0 01-2 2H6a2 2 0 01-2-2v-5m16 0h-2.586a1 1 0 00-.707.293l-2.414 2.414a1 1 0 01-.707.293h-3.172a1 1 0 01-.707-.293l-2.414-2.414A1 1 0 006.586 13H4"
              />
            </svg>
            <h3 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold mb-2">No products found</h3>
            <p className="text-sm sm:text-base text-gray-600">Try selecting a different category</p>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}

export default function ProductsPage() {
  return (
    <Suspense fallback={
      <main className="min-h-screen bg-white">
        <section className="bg-gradient-to-b from-gray-50 to-white border-b border-gray-200">
          <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-12 sm:py-16 lg:py-20">
            <div className="h-10 sm:h-12 bg-gray-200 rounded w-2/3 sm:w-1/3 mb-4 animate-pulse"></div>
            <div className="h-5 sm:h-6 bg-gray-200 rounded w-full sm:w-1/2 animate-pulse"></div>
          </div>
        </section>
        <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8 sm:py-12">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 sm:gap-6 lg:gap-8">
            {[...Array(8)].map((_, i) => (
              <ProductCardSkeleton key={i} />
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </main>
    }>
      <ProductsContent />
    </Suspense>
  );
}

```javascriptreact
'use client';

/**
 * Checkout Page
 * Order form and confirmation
 */

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useCart } from '@/context/CartContext';
import { useToast } from '@/context/ToastContext';
import CartSummary from '@/components/CartSummary';
import { sendRegularOrderEmail } from '@/lib/order-email';
import { sendCustomerOrderConfirmation } from '@/lib/customer-email';
import { validateForm, commonRules } from '@/lib/validation';
import { trackPurchase } from '@/lib/analytics';

export default function CheckoutPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { cart, clearCart, getCartTotal, getCartItemsCount } = useCart();
  const toast = useToast();
  
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    customerName: '',
    customerEmail: '',
    customerPhone: '',
    customerAddress: '',
    notes: '',
  });

  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState({});

  // Redirect if cart is empty
  useEffect(() => {
    if (cart.length === 0 && !isSubmitting) {
      router.push('/cart');
    }
  }, [cart.length, isSubmitting, router]);

  // Show loading while redirecting
  if (cart.length === 0) {
    return (
      <main className="min-h-screen bg-gray-50 flex items-center justify-center">
        <div className="text-center">
          <p className="text-gray-600">Redirecting to cart...</p>
        </div>
      </main>
    );
  }

  const handleChange = (field, value) => {
    setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, [field]: value }));
    // Clear field error when user starts typing
    if (fieldErrors[field]) {
      setFieldErrors((prev) => {
        const newErrors = { ...prev };
        delete newErrors[field];
        return newErrors;
      });
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setFieldErrors({});

    // Validate form
    const validation = validateForm(formData, commonRules);
    if (!validation.isValid) {
      setFieldErrors(validation.errors);
      toast.error('Please fix the errors in the form');
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);

    try {
      const orderInfo = {
        ...formData,
        items: cart,
      };

      // Send order email to business
      await sendRegularOrderEmail(orderInfo);

      // Send confirmation email to customer (non-blocking)
      sendCustomerOrderConfirmation(orderInfo).catch(err => {
        console.error('Failed to send customer confirmation:', err);
        // Don't block the order - just log the error
      });

      // Track purchase in analytics
      const subtotal = getCartTotal();
      const shipping = subtotal > 100 ? 0 : 10;
      trackPurchase({ total: subtotal + shipping });

      // Clear cart
      clearCart();

      // Show success message
      toast.success('Order placed successfully! Check your email for confirmation.');

      // Redirect to success page
      setTimeout(() => {
        router.push('/checkout/success');
      }, 500);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Order submission error:', err);
      toast.error('Failed to submit order. Please try again.');
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-gray-50">
      {/* Header */}
      <section className="bg-gradient-to-b from-gray-50 to-white border-b border-gray-200">
        <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-12 sm:py-16">
          <h1 className="text-3xl sm:text-4xl md:text-5xl font-bold animate-fade-in">
            Checkout
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm sm:text-base text-gray-600 mt-2">
            Complete your order
          </p>
        </div>
      </section>

      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8 sm:py-12">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6 lg:gap-8">
          {/* Checkout Form */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-2">
            <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-xl p-4 sm:p-6 md:p-8 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow">
              <h2 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold mb-4 sm:mb-6">Shipping Information</h2>

              <div className="space-y-6">
                {/* Full Name */}
                <div>
                  <label htmlFor="customer-name" className="block mb-2 font-medium">
                    Full Name <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                  </label>
                  <input
                    id="customer-name"
                    type="text"
                    value={formData.customerName}
                    onChange={(e) => handleChange('customerName', e.target.value)}
                    className={`w-full px-4 py-3 border rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-black ${
                      fieldErrors.customerName ? 'border-red-500' : 'border-gray-300'
                    }`}
                    placeholder="John Doe"
                    aria-invalid={!!fieldErrors.customerName}
                    aria-describedby={fieldErrors.customerName ? 'name-error' : undefined}
                  />
                  {fieldErrors.customerName && (
                    <p id="name-error" className="mt-1 text-sm text-red-600" role="alert">
                      {fieldErrors.customerName}
                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Email */}
                <div>
                  <label htmlFor="customer-email" className="block mb-2 font-medium">
                    Email Address <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                  </label>
                  <input
                    id="customer-email"
                    type="email"
                    value={formData.customerEmail}
                    onChange={(e) => handleChange('customerEmail', e.target.value)}
                    className={`w-full px-4 py-3 border rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-black ${
                      fieldErrors.customerEmail ? 'border-red-500' : 'border-gray-300'
                    }`}
                    placeholder="john@example.com"
                    aria-invalid={!!fieldErrors.customerEmail}
                    aria-describedby={fieldErrors.customerEmail ? 'email-error' : undefined}
                  />
                  {fieldErrors.customerEmail && (
                    <p id="email-error" className="mt-1 text-sm text-red-600" role="alert">
                      {fieldErrors.customerEmail}
                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Phone */}
                <div>
                  <label htmlFor="customer-phone" className="block mb-2 font-medium">
                    Phone Number <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                  </label>
                  <input
                    id="customer-phone"
                    type="tel"
                    value={formData.customerPhone}
                    onChange={(e) => handleChange('customerPhone', e.target.value)}
                    className={`w-full px-4 py-3 border rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-black ${
                      fieldErrors.customerPhone ? 'border-red-500' : 'border-gray-300'
                    }`}
                    placeholder="+1 234 567 8900"
                    aria-invalid={!!fieldErrors.customerPhone}
                    aria-describedby={fieldErrors.customerPhone ? 'phone-error' : undefined}
                  />
                  {fieldErrors.customerPhone && (
                    <p id="phone-error" className="mt-1 text-sm text-red-600" role="alert">
                      {fieldErrors.customerPhone}
                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Address */}
                <div>
                  <label htmlFor="customer-address" className="block mb-2 font-medium">
                    Shipping Address <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                  </label>
                  <textarea
                    id="customer-address"
                    value={formData.customerAddress}
                    onChange={(e) => handleChange('customerAddress', e.target.value)}
                    rows={4}
                    className={`w-full px-4 py-3 border rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-black resize-none ${
                      fieldErrors.customerAddress ? 'border-red-500' : 'border-gray-300'
                    }`}
                    placeholder="Street address, City, State, ZIP Code"
                    aria-invalid={!!fieldErrors.customerAddress}
                    aria-describedby={fieldErrors.customerAddress ? 'address-error' : undefined}
                  />
                  {fieldErrors.customerAddress && (
                    <p id="address-error" className="mt-1 text-sm text-red-600" role="alert">
                      {fieldErrors.customerAddress}
                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Notes */}
                <div>
                  <label htmlFor="order-notes" className="block mb-2 font-medium">
                    Order Notes (Optional)
                  </label>
                  <textarea
                    id="order-notes"
                    value={formData.notes}
                    onChange={(e) => handleChange('notes', e.target.value)}
                    rows={3}
                    className="w-full px-4 py-3 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-black resize-none"
                    placeholder="Any special instructions for your order..."
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Payment Method */}
              <div className="mt-8 p-6 bg-yellow-50 border border-yellow-200 rounded-lg">
                <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                  <svg
                    className="w-6 h-6 text-yellow-600 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5"
                    fill="none"
                    stroke="currentColor"
                    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                  >
                    <path
                      strokeLinecap="round"
                      strokeLinejoin="round"
                      strokeWidth={2}
                      d="M12 8c-1.657 0-3 .895-3 2s1.343 2 3 2 3 .895 3 2-1.343 2-3 2m0-8c1.11 0 2.08.402 2.599 1M12 8V7m0 1v8m0 0v1m0-1c-1.11 0-2.08-.402-2.599-1M21 12a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z"
                    />
                  </svg>
                  <div>
                    <h3 className="font-bold text-yellow-800 mb-1">
                      Payment Method: Cash on Delivery
                    </h3>
                    <p className="text-sm text-yellow-700">
                      You'll pay when you receive your order. We'll contact you to confirm delivery details.
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Submit Button */}
              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={isSubmitting}
                className="w-full mt-8 btn-primary text-lg py-4 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
              >
                {isSubmitting ? 'Processing Order...' : 'Place Order'}
              </button>
            </form>
          </div>

          {/* Order Summary */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-1">
            <CartSummary showCheckoutButton={false} />

            {/* Order Items Preview */}
            <div className="mt-6 bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-xl p-6">
              <h3 className="font-bold text-lg mb-4">Order Items ({getCartItemsCount()})</h3>
              <div className="space-y-3">
                {cart.map((item) => (
                  <div key={item.cartItemId} className="flex justify-between text-sm">
                    <div className="flex-1">
                      <p className="font-medium">{item.title}</p>
                      <p className="text-gray-600 text-xs">
                        {item.selectedSize} • {item.selectedColor} • Qty: {item.quantity}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                    <p className="font-bold">
                      ${(item.price * item.quantity).toFixed(2)}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}

# Responsive Breakpoints Guide - Cobra Wear

**Complete guide to all responsive breakpoints in your e-commerce store**

---

## 📱 **Tailwind CSS Breakpoints**

Your site uses Tailwind's default breakpoint system:

| Breakpoint | Min Width | Devices | Tailwind Prefix |
|------------|-----------|---------|-----------------|
| Mobile (default) | 0px | Small phones | *(no prefix)* |
| Small | 640px | Large phones, small tablets | `sm:` |
| Medium | 768px | Tablets | `md:` |
| Large | 1024px | Desktops | `lg:` |
| Extra Large | 1280px | Large desktops | `xl:` |
| 2X Large | 1536px | Ultra-wide screens | `2xl:` |

---

## 🎨 **Component Breakdowns**

### **1. Hero Section**

#### **Typography:**
```jsx
// Headline
text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl xl:text-8xl

// Mobile: 48px
// Small: 60px
// Large: 72px
// XL: 96px

// Description
text-lg sm:text-xl lg:text-2xl

// Mobile: 18px
// Small: 20px
// Large: 24px
```

#### **Spacing:**
```jsx
py-16 sm:py-20 lg:py-28

// Mobile: 64px
// Small: 80px
// Large: 112px
```

#### **Layout:**
```jsx
grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2

// Mobile: Single column (stacked)
// Large+: Two columns (side-by-side)
```

---

### **2. Navigation Bar**

#### **Desktop (lg+):**
```jsx
<div className="hidden lg:flex items-center space-x-8">
  {/* Shows all nav links horizontally */}
</div>
```

#### **Mobile (< lg):**
```jsx
<div className="flex lg:hidden items-center space-x-4">
  {/* Shows hamburger menu button */}
</div>
```

#### **Mobile Menu:**
```jsx
w-full sm:w-80

// Mobile: Full width
// Small+: 320px fixed width
```

---

### **3. Product Grid**

#### **Grid Columns:**
```jsx
grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4

// Mobile (< 768px): 2 columns
// Tablet (768px - 1023px): 3 columns
// Desktop (1024px+): 4 columns
```

#### **Gap Spacing:**
```jsx
gap-4 sm:gap-6 lg:gap-8

// Mobile: 16px
// Small: 24px
// Large: 32px
```

---

### **4. Product Card**

#### **Padding:**
```jsx
p-3 sm:p-4 lg:p-6

// Mobile: 12px
// Small: 16px
// Large: 24px
```

#### **Typography:**
```jsx
// Title
text-sm sm:text-base lg:text-lg

// Mobile: 14px
// Small: 16px
// Large: 18px

// Price
text-lg sm:text-xl lg:text-2xl

// Mobile: 18px
// Small: 20px
// Large: 24px
```

#### **Button:**
```jsx
py-2.5 sm:py-3
text-sm sm:text-base

// Mobile: 10px padding, 14px text
// Small: 12px padding, 16px text
```

#### **Icon Placeholder:**
```jsx
w-16 h-16 sm:w-20 sm:h-20 lg:w-24 lg:h-24

// Mobile: 64x64px
// Small: 80x80px
// Large: 96x96px
```

---

### **5. Page Headers**

#### **All Page Headers:**
```jsx
// Title
text-3xl sm:text-4xl md:text-5xl lg:text-6xl

// Mobile: 30px
// Small: 36px
// Medium: 48px
// Large: 60px

// Subtitle
text-sm sm:text-base lg:text-lg

// Padding
py-12 sm:py-16 lg:py-20

// Mobile: 48px
// Small: 64px
// Large: 80px
```

---

### **6. Category/Style Filters**

#### **Buttons:**
```jsx
px-4 sm:px-6 py-2 sm:py-3
text-sm sm:text-base

// Mobile: 16px/8px padding, 14px text
// Small: 24px/12px padding, 16px text
```

#### **Gap:**
```jsx
gap-2 sm:gap-3

// Mobile: 8px
// Small: 12px
```

---

### **7. Cart & Checkout**

#### **Grid Layout:**
```jsx
grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3

// Mobile: Single column (stacked)
// Large+: 2 columns (form) + 1 column (summary)
```

#### **Form Padding:**
```jsx
p-4 sm:p-6 md:p-8

// Mobile: 16px
// Small: 24px
// Medium: 32px
```

---

### **8. Homepage Sections**

#### **Featured Products:**
```jsx
py-16 sm:py-20 lg:py-24

// Mobile: 64px
// Small: 80px
// Large: 96px
```

#### **Features Grid:**
```jsx
grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4

// Mobile: 1 column
// Small: 2 columns
// Large: 4 columns
```

---

### **9. POD Page**

#### **Info Cards Grid:**
```jsx
grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3

// Mobile: 1 column
// Small: 2 columns
// Medium: 3 columns
```

#### **Special Case - 3rd Card:**
```jsx
sm:col-span-2 md:col-span-1

// On small screens, 3rd card spans 2 columns (centered)
// On medium+, takes 1 column
```

### **Container:**
```jsx
max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8

// - Small: 24px side padding
// - Large: 32px side padding

gap-2 sm:gap-3 lg:gap-4
```

## 📐 **Responsive Design Principles Used**

### **1. Mobile-First:**
Start with mobile, enhance for larger screens:
```jsx
// ✅ Good (mobile-first)
text-sm sm:text-base lg:text-lg

// ❌ Avoid (desktop-first)
text-lg lg:text-sm
```

### **2. Fluid Typography:**
Text scales smoothly across breakpoints:
```jsx
text-3xl sm:text-4xl md:text-5xl lg:text-6xl
```

### **3. Flexible Grids:**
Columns adapt to screen size:
```jsx
grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4
```

### **4. Progressive Enhancement:**
Add features as screen size increases:
```jsx
// Mobile: Simple
// Tablet: More features
// Desktop: Full features
```

### **5. Touch-Friendly:**
Larger tap targets on mobile:
```jsx
py-3 sm:py-2.5  // Larger on mobile, smaller on desktop
```

## 🚀 **Performance Tips**

### **Images:**
All images are responsive:
```jsx
<Image
  src={image}
  fill
  className="object-cover"
/>
```
- Mobile: Loads smaller version
- Desktop: Loads full version
- Automatic optimization by Next.js

### **Hidden Elements:**
```jsx
className="hidden lg:block"  // Only loads on desktop
className="block lg:hidden"  // Only loads on mobile
```

### **Conditional Loading:**
No unnecessary JavaScript loaded for unused breakpoints.
