Perfect! ✅ I've fixed the issue! Here's what was wrong and what I changed:

## 🐛 **The Problem:**
Both buttons were sharing the same `isAdding` state, so clicking "Add to Cart" disabled **both** buttons until the timeout finished.

## ✅ **The Fix:**

### **Separate States for Each Button:**
```javascript
const [isAddingToCart, setIsAddingToCart] = useState(false);  // For "Add to Cart"
const [isBuyingNow, setIsBuyingNow] = useState(false);        // For "Buy Now"
```

### **Now Each Button Works Independently:**

1. **🛒 Add to Cart Button:**
   - Uses `isAddingToCart` state
   - Shows spinning loader icon while adding
   - Resets after 800ms
   - Doesn't affect other buttons

2. **💳 Buy Now Button:**
   - Uses `isBuyingNow` state
   - Shows "Adding..." text
   - Navigates to cart after 500ms
   - Doesn't affect other buttons

3. **👁️ View Details Button:**
   - Always available (no state)
   - Never gets disabled

---

## 🎯 **Result:**

- ✅ Click "Add to Cart" → Only that button is temporarily disabled
- ✅ "Buy Now" and "View Details" remain clickable
- ✅ Each button has its own loading state
- ✅ Better user experience!

---

**Bonus:** I also added a spinning loader icon to the "Add to Cart" button so users get visual feedback! 🔄

Try it now - the buttons should work independently! 🚀

```javascript
const [isBuyingNow, setIsBuyingNow] = useState(false);        // For "Buy Now"
```

I see the error! The `toast` object is undefined. This is because `useToast()` returns an object with a `toast` method, but we need to destructure it correctly. Let me fix this:

```javascript
const { toast } = useToast();
```

```javascript
const { success } = useToast();
// or
const toast = useToast();
```

I found the issue! The `useToast()` hook returns an object with methods like `success`, `error`, etc., but we're trying to destructure `toast` which doesn't exist. Let me fix it:


Perfect! ✅ I've fixed the error! 

## 🐛 **The Problem:**
The code was trying to destructure `toast` from `useToast()`:
```javascript
const { toast } = useToast(); // ❌ Wrong - 'toast' doesn't exist
```

But `useToast()` returns an object with methods directly:
```javascript
{
  success: function,
  error: function,
  info: function,
  warning: function,
  ...
}
```

## ✅ **The Fix:**
Changed it to get the entire context object:
```javascript
const toast = useToast(); // ✅ Correct - get the whole object
```

Now `toast.success()` works properly! 🎉

---

**The errors should be gone now. Try clicking the buttons again and they should work perfectly!** 🚀

```javascript

```

```javascript
{
  success: function,
  error: function,
  info: function,
  warning: function,
  ...
}
```

```javascript
const toast = useToast(); // ✅ Correct - get the whole object
```

```javascriptreact
'use client';

/**
 * Wishlist Context
 * Global state management for wishlist
 * Persists to localStorage
 */

import { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect } from 'react';

const WishlistContext = createContext();

export function WishlistProvider({ children }) {
  const [wishlist, setWishlist] = useState([]);
  const [isLoaded, setIsLoaded] = useState(false);

  // Load wishlist from localStorage on mount
  useEffect(() => {
    const savedWishlist = localStorage.getItem('cobra_wear_wishlist');
    if (savedWishlist) {
      try {
        setWishlist(JSON.parse(savedWishlist));
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error loading wishlist:', error);
      }
    }
    setIsLoaded(true);
  }, []);

  // Save wishlist to localStorage whenever it changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isLoaded) {
      localStorage.setItem('cobra_wear_wishlist', JSON.stringify(wishlist));
    }
  }, [wishlist, isLoaded]);

  // Check if product is in wishlist
  const isInWishlist = (productId) => {
    return wishlist.some((item) => item.id === productId);
  };

  // Add item to wishlist
  const addToWishlist = (product) => {
    setWishlist((prev) => {
      // Check if already in wishlist
      if (prev.some((item) => item.id === product.id)) {
        return prev;
      }
      return [...prev, product];
    });
  };

  // Remove item from wishlist
  const removeFromWishlist = (productId) => {
    setWishlist((prev) => prev.filter((item) => item.id !== productId));
  };

  // Toggle item in wishlist
  const toggleWishlist = (product) => {
    if (isInWishlist(product.id)) {
      removeFromWishlist(product.id);
    } else {
      addToWishlist(product);
    }
  };

  // Clear entire wishlist
  const clearWishlist = () => {
    setWishlist([]);
  };

  // Get wishlist count
  const getWishlistCount = () => {
    return wishlist.length;
  };

  const value = {
    wishlist,
    addToWishlist,
    removeFromWishlist,
    toggleWishlist,
    clearWishlist,
    isInWishlist,
    getWishlistCount,
    isLoaded,
  };

  return <WishlistContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</WishlistContext.Provider>;
}

// Custom hook to use wishlist context
export function useWishlist() {
  const context = useContext(WishlistContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useWishlist must be used within WishlistProvider');
  }
  return context;
}
```

```javascriptreact
'use client';

/**
```
```javascriptreact
 * ProductCard Component
 * Modern, responsive card component for displaying products

import { useState } from 'react';
import Image from 'next/image';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useCart } from '@/context/CartContext';
import { useWishlist } from '@/context/WishlistContext';
import { useToast } from '@/context/ToastContext';

export default function ProductCard({ product }) {
  const { title, price, images, slug, inStock } = product;
  const image = images && images[0];
  const router = useRouter();
  const { addToCart } = useCart();
  const { toggleWishlist, isInWishlist } = useWishlist();
  const toast = useToast();
  const [isAddingToCart, setIsAddingToCart] = useState(false);
  const [isBuyingNow, setIsBuyingNow] = useState(false);
  
  const inWishlist = isInWishlist(product.id);

  return (
    <article 
      className="group bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-xl overflow-hidden hover:shadow-2xl transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1 flex flex-col h-full"
      aria-label={`${title} product card`}
    >
      {/* Product Image */}
      <Link href={`/products/${slug}`} aria-label={`View ${title} details`}>
        <div className="relative aspect-square bg-gray-50 overflow-hidden cursor-pointer">
          {image ? (
            <Image
              src={image}
              alt={`${title} product image`}
              fill
              className="object-cover group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform duration-500"
            />
          ) : (
            <div className="w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center" role="img" aria-label="Product image placeholder">
              <svg
                className="w-16 h-16 sm:w-20 sm:h-20 lg:w-24 lg:h-24 text-gray-300"
                fill="none"
                stroke="currentColor"
                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                aria-hidden="true"
              >
                <path
                  strokeLinecap="round"
                  strokeLinejoin="round"
                  strokeWidth={1}
                  d="M4 16l4.586-4.586a2 2 0 012.828 0L16 16m-2-2l1.586-1.586a2 2 0 012.828 0L20 14m-6-6h.01M6 20h12a2 2 0 002-2V6a2 2 0 00-2-2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v12a2 2 0 002 2z"
                />
              </svg>
            </div>
          )}
          
          {/* Out of Stock Overlay */}
          {!inStock && (
            <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black bg-opacity-60 flex items-center justify-center" role="status">
              <span className="bg-white px-3 py-2 sm:px-4 sm:py-2 rounded-lg font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm">
                OUT OF STOCK
              </span>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Hover Overlay */}
          <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black bg-opacity-0 group-hover:bg-opacity-10 transition-all duration-300 flex items-center justify-center">
            <span className="text-white font-bold text-sm sm:text-base opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transform translate-y-4 group-hover:translate-y-0 transition-all duration-300">
              View Details
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </Link>

      {/* Product Info */}
      <div className="p-3 sm:p-4 lg:p-6 flex flex-col flex-1">
        <Link href={`/products/${slug}`}>
          <h3 className="text-sm sm:text-base lg:text-lg font-semibold mb-2 group-hover:text-gray-600 transition-colors cursor-pointer line-clamp-2">
            {title}
          </h3>
        </Link>
        <p className="text-lg sm:text-xl lg:text-2xl font-bold mb-3 sm:mb-4" aria-label={`Price: ${price.toFixed(2)} dollars`}>
          ${price.toFixed(2)}
        </p>
        
        {/* Spacer to push buttons to bottom */}
        <div className="flex-1"></div>
        
        {/* Action Buttons */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-auto">
          {/* Add to Cart Button - Icon Only */}
          <div className="relative group/tooltip">
            <button
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                if (!inStock || isAddingToCart) return;
                
                setIsAddingToCart(true);
                // Add with default size and color (first available)
                const defaultSize = product.sizes?.[0] || 'M';
                const defaultColor = product.colors?.[0]?.name || 'Black';
                
                addToCart(product, defaultSize, defaultColor, 1);
                toast.success('Added to cart!');
                
                setTimeout(() => setIsAddingToCart(false), 800);
              }}
              disabled={!inStock || isAddingToCart}
              className={`p-2.5 sm:p-3 rounded-lg transition-all duration-300 ${
                inStock && !isAddingToCart
                  ? 'bg-black text-white hover:bg-gray-800 hover:scale-110'
                  : 'bg-gray-300 text-gray-500 cursor-not-allowed'
              }`}
              aria-label="Add to cart"
            >
              {/* Shopping Cart + Icon */}
              {isAddingToCart ? (
                <svg className="w-5 h-5 sm:w-6 sm:h-6 animate-spin" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                  <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M4 4v5h.582m15.356 2A8.001 8.001 0 004.582 9m0 0H9m11 11v-5h-.581m0 0a8.003 8.003 0 01-15.357-2m15.357 2H15" />

                  <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M3 3h2l.4 2M7 13h10l4-8H5.4M7 13L5.4 5M7 13l-2.293 2.293c-.63.63-.184 1.707.707 1.707H17m0 0a2 2 0 100 4 2 2 0 000-4zm-8 2a2 2 0 11-4 0 2 2 0 014 0z" />
                  <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M12 6v6m3-3H9" />
                </svg>
              )}
            </button>
            {/* Tooltip */}
            <div className="absolute bottom-full left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 mb-2 px-3 py-1.5 bg-gray-900 text-white text-xs rounded-lg opacity-0 group-hover/tooltip:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-200 pointer-events-none whitespace-nowrap z-10">
              Add to Cart
              <div className="absolute top-full left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -mt-1 border-4 border-transparent border-t-gray-900"></div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Buy Now Button - Text */}
          <div className="relative group/tooltip flex-1">
            <button
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                if (!inStock || isBuyingNow) return;
                
                setIsBuyingNow(true);
                const defaultSize = product.sizes?.[0] || 'M';
                const defaultColor = product.colors?.[0]?.name || 'Black';
                
                addToCart(product, defaultSize, defaultColor, 1);
                toast.success('Added to cart! Taking you to cart...');
                
                setTimeout(() => {
                  router.push('/cart');
                }, 500);
              }}
              disabled={!inStock || isBuyingNow}
              className={`w-full py-2.5 sm:py-3 rounded-lg text-sm sm:text-base font-medium transition-all duration-300 ${
                inStock && !isBuyingNow
                  ? 'bg-black text-white hover:bg-gray-800 hover:scale-105'
                  : 'bg-gray-300 text-gray-500 cursor-not-allowed'
              }`}
              aria-label="Buy now"
            >
              {isBuyingNow ? 'Adding...' : 'Buy Now'}
            </button>
            {/* Tooltip */}
            <div className="absolute bottom-full left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 mb-2 px-3 py-1.5 bg-gray-900 text-white text-xs rounded-lg opacity-0 group-hover/tooltip:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-200 pointer-events-none whitespace-nowrap z-10">
              Quick Checkout
              <div className="absolute top-full left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -mt-1 border-4 border-transparent border-t-gray-900"></div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* View Details Button - Icon Only */}
          <div className="relative group/tooltip">
            <Link
              href={`/products/${slug}`}
              className="block p-2.5 sm:p-3 bg-black text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-800 transition-all duration-300 hover:scale-110"
              aria-label="View details"
            >
              {/* Eye Icon */}
              <svg className="w-5 h-5 sm:w-6 sm:h-6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M15 12a3 3 0 11-6 0 3 3 0 016 0z" />
                <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M2.458 12C3.732 7.943 7.523 5 12 5c4.478 0 8.268 2.943 9.542 7-1.274 4.057-5.064 7-9.542 7-4.477 0-8.268-2.943-9.542-7z" />
              </svg>
            </Link>
            {/* Tooltip */}
            <div className="absolute bottom-full left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 mb-2 px-3 py-1.5 bg-gray-900 text-white text-xs rounded-lg opacity-0 group-hover/tooltip:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-200 pointer-events-none whitespace-nowrap z-10">
              View Details
              <div className="absolute top-full left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -mt-1 border-4 border-transparent border-t-gray-900"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </article>
  );
}
```

```javascriptreact
'use client';

/**
 * Wishlist Page
 * Display all wishlist items with ability to add to cart or remove
 */

import { useWishlist } from '@/context/WishlistContext';
import { useCart } from '@/context/CartContext';
import { useToast } from '@/context/ToastContext';
import Image from 'next/image';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';

export default function WishlistPage() {
  const { wishlist, removeFromWishlist, isLoaded } = useWishlist();
  const { addToCart } = useCart();
  const toast = useToast();
  const router = useRouter();

  if (!isLoaded) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center">
        <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-12 w-12 border-b-2 border-black"></div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (wishlist.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center px-4">
        <div className="text-center max-w-md">
          <svg className="w-24 h-24 mx-auto mb-6 text-gray-300" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
```

```javascriptreact
'use client';

/**
 * Wishlist Page
 * Display all products in the user's wishlist
 */

import { useWishlist } from '@/context/WishlistContext';
import { useCart } from '@/context/CartContext';
import { useToast } from '@/context/ToastContext';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import Image from 'next/image';
import Link from 'next/link';

export default function WishlistPage() {
  const { wishlist, removeFromWishlist, clearWishlist } = useWishlist();
  const { addToCart } = useCart();
  const toast = useToast();
  const router = useRouter();

  const handleAddToCart = (product) => {
    const defaultSize = product.sizes?.[0] || 'M';
    const defaultColor = product.colors?.[0]?.name || 'Black';
    
    addToCart(product, defaultSize, defaultColor, 1);
    toast.success('Added to cart!');
  };

  const handleBuyNow = (product) => {
    const defaultSize = product.sizes?.[0] || 'M';
    const defaultColor = product.colors?.[0]?.name || 'Black';
    
    addToCart(product, defaultSize, defaultColor, 1);
    toast.success('Added to cart! Taking you to cart...');
    
    setTimeout(() => {
      router.push('/cart');
    }, 500);
  };

  if (wishlist.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-white pt-24 pb-20">
        <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
          {/* Header */}
          <div className="text-center mb-12">
            <h1 className="text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold mb-4">My Wishlist</h1>
            <p className="text-gray-600 text-lg">Save your favorite products for later</p>
          </div>

          {/* Empty State */}
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-16">
            <svg className="w-24 h-24 text-gray-300 mb-6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
              <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={1.5} d="M4.318 6.318a4.5 4.5 0 000 6.364L12 20.364l7.682-7.682a4.5 4.5 0 00-6.364-6.364L12 7.636l-1.318-1.318a4.5 4.5 0 00-6.364 0z" />
            </svg>
            <h2 className="text-2xl font-semibold mb-2">Your wishlist is empty</h2>
            <p className="text-gray-600 mb-8">Start adding products you love!</p>
            <Link
              href="/products"
              className="px-8 py-3 bg-black text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-800 transition-all duration-300 hover:scale-105 font-medium"
            >
              Browse Products
            </Link>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-white pt-24 pb-20">
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between mb-12 gap-4">
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold mb-2">My Wishlist</h1>
            <p className="text-gray-600 text-lg">{wishlist.length} {wishlist.length === 1 ? 'item' : 'items'}</p>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={() => {
              if (confirm('Are you sure you want to clear your entire wishlist?')) {
                clearWishlist();
                toast.success('Wishlist cleared!');
              }
            }}
            className="px-6 py-2.5 border border-red-500 text-red-500 rounded-lg hover:bg-red-500 hover:text-white transition-all duration-300 font-medium"
          >
            Clear All
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Wishlist Grid */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-6">
          {wishlist.map((product) => (
            <article
              key={product.id}
              className="group bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-xl overflow-hidden hover:shadow-2xl transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1 flex flex-col"
            >
              {/* Product Image */}
              <div className="relative">
                <Link href={`/products/${product.slug}`}>
                  <div className="relative aspect-square bg-gray-50 overflow-hidden cursor-pointer">
                    {product.images && product.images[0] ? (
                      <Image
                        src={product.images[0]}
                        alt={product.title}
                        fill
                        className="object-cover group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform duration-500"
                      />
                    ) : (
                      <div className="w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center">
                        <svg className="w-20 h-20 text-gray-300" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                          <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={1} d="M4 16l4.586-4.586a2 2 0 012.828 0L16 16m-2-2l1.586-1.586a2 2 0 012.828 0L20 14m-6-6h.01M6 20h12a2 2 0 002-2V6a2 2 0 00-2-2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v12a2 2 0 002 2z" />
                        </svg>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </Link>

                {/* Remove Button */}
                <button
                  onClick={() => {
                    removeFromWishlist(product.id);
                    toast.success('Removed from wishlist');
                  }}
                  className="absolute top-3 right-3 w-9 h-9 flex items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-white text-black border border-black hover:bg-red-500 hover:text-white hover:border-red-500 transition-all duration-300 hover:scale-110 z-10"
                  aria-label="Remove from wishlist"
                >
                  <svg className="w-5 h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                    <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12" />
                  </svg>
                </button>
              </div>

              {/* Product Info */}
              <div className="p-4 flex flex-col flex-1">
                <Link href={`/products/${product.slug}`}>
                  <h3 className="text-base font-semibold mb-2 hover:text-gray-600 transition-colors cursor-pointer line-clamp-2">
                    {product.title}
                  </h3>
                </Link>
                <p className="text-xl font-bold mb-4">${product.price.toFixed(2)}</p>

                {/* Spacer */}
                <div className="flex-1"></div>

                {/* Action Buttons */}
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <button
                    onClick={() => handleAddToCart(product)}
                    disabled={!product.inStock}
                    className={`flex-1 py-2.5 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium transition-all duration-300 ${
                      product.inStock
                        ? 'bg-black text-white hover:bg-gray-800 hover:scale-105'
                        : 'bg-gray-300 text-gray-500 cursor-not-allowed'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {product.inStock ? 'Add to Cart' : 'Out of Stock'}
                  </button>
                  
                  {product.inStock && (
                    <button
                      onClick={() => handleBuyNow(product)}
                      className="p-2.5 bg-black text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-800 transition-all duration-300 hover:scale-110"
                      aria-label="Buy now"
                    >
                      <svg className="w-5 h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                        <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M13 7l5 5m0 0l-5 5m5-5H6" />
                      </svg>
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            </article>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```javascriptreact
};

export default function Hero() {

  const [isAddingToCart, setIsAddingToCart] = useState(false);
  const isProcessingRef = useRef(false); // Use ref for immediate check
  const [timeLeft, setTimeLeft] = useState({
    days: 0,
    hours: 0,
    minutes: 0,
    seconds: 0
  });

    setIsVisible(true);
    // Reset processing state when component mounts
    isProcessingRef.current = false;
    setIsAddingToCart(false);
  }, []);

  // Countdown Timer
  useEffect(() => {
    const endDate = new Date('2025-11-23T17:00:00'); // 11/23/2025 5pm

    const calculateTimeLeft = () => {
      const now = new Date();
      const difference = endDate - now;

      if (difference > 0) {
        return {
          days: Math.floor(difference / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)),
          hours: Math.floor((difference / (1000 * 60 * 60)) % 24),
          minutes: Math.floor((difference / 1000 / 60) % 60),
          seconds: Math.floor((difference / 1000) % 60)
        };
      }
      return { days: 0, hours: 0, minutes: 0, seconds: 0 };
    };

    setTimeLeft(calculateTimeLeft());

    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      setTimeLeft(calculateTimeLeft());
    }, 1000);

    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, []);
```

```javascriptreact
'use client';

/**
 * Hero Component
 * Modern premium hero section with animations and high-quality design
 */

import Link from 'next/link';
import Image from 'next/image';
import { useEffect, useState, useRef, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useCart } from '@/context/CartContext';
import { useToast } from '@/context/ToastContext';

// Featured Product - Define OUTSIDE component to prevent recreation
const FEATURED_PRODUCT = {
  id: 'hero-featured',
  title: 'Premium T-Shirt Collection',
  price: 129, // 129 DH
  images: ['/images/hero-product.png'],
  slug: 'featured-tshirt',
  category: 'tshirts',
  inStock: true,
  sizes: ['S', 'M', 'L', 'XL', 'XXL'],
  colors: [
    { name: 'Black', hex: '#000000' },
    { name: 'White', hex: '#FFFFFF' },
  ],
};

export default function Hero() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { addToCart } = useCart();
  const toast = useToast();
  
  const [isVisible, setIsVisible] = useState(false);
  const [isAddingToCart, setIsAddingToCart] = useState(false);
  const isProcessingRef = useRef(false); // Use ref for immediate check
  const [timeLeft, setTimeLeft] = useState({
    days: 0,
    hours: 0,
    minutes: 0,
    seconds: 0
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    setIsVisible(true);
    // Reset processing state when component mounts
    isProcessingRef.current = false;
    setIsAddingToCart(false);
  }, []);

  // Countdown Timer
  useEffect(() => {
    const endDate = new Date('2025-11-23T17:00:00'); // 11/23/2025 5pm

    const calculateTimeLeft = () => {
      const now = new Date();
      const difference = endDate - now;

      if (difference > 0) {
        return {
          days: Math.floor(difference / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)),
          hours: Math.floor((difference / (1000 * 60 * 60)) % 24),
          minutes: Math.floor((difference / 1000 / 60) % 60),
          seconds: Math.floor((difference / 1000) % 60)
        };
      }
      return { days: 0, hours: 0, minutes: 0, seconds: 0 };
    };

    setTimeLeft(calculateTimeLeft());

    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      setTimeLeft(calculateTimeLeft());
    }, 1000);

    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, []);

  return (
    <section className="relative bg-white overflow-hidden">
      {/* Background Decorative Elements */}
      <div className="absolute inset-0 overflow-hidden pointer-events-none">
        <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-96 h-96 bg-gray-50 rounded-full -translate-y-1/2 translate-x-1/2"></div>
        <div className="absolute bottom-0 left-0 w-64 h-64 bg-gray-50 rounded-full translate-y-1/2 -translate-x-1/2"></div>
      </div>

      <div className="relative max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-16 sm:py-20 lg:py-6">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-12 lg:gap-16 items-center">
          {/* Left Content */}
          <div 
            className={`space-y-6 sm:space-y-8 transition-all duration-1000 ${
              isVisible ? 'opacity-100 translate-y-0' : 'opacity-0 translate-y-10'
            }`}
          >
            {/* Headline */}
            <h1 className="text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl xl:text-8xl font-bold leading-none tracking-tight">
              <span className="block">Premium</span>
              <span className="block">Style.</span>
              <span className="block text-gray-400">Your Design.</span>
            </h1>

            {/* Description */}
            <p className="text-lg sm:text-xl lg:text-2xl text-gray-600 leading-relaxed max-w-xl">
              Discover our exclusive collection of premium clothing or create your own custom designs with our Print-On-Demand service.
            </p>

            {/* CTAs */}
            <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-4 pt-4">
              <Link 
                href="/products" 
                className="group relative inline-flex items-center justify-center px-8 py-4 text-lg font-bold text-white bg-black rounded-xl overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300 hover:scale-105 hover:shadow-2xl"
              >
                <span className="relative z-10">Shop Now</span>
                <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-gray-900 to-black opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity"></div>
              </Link>
              
              <Link 
                href="/pod" 
                className="group inline-flex items-center justify-center px-8 py-4 text-lg font-bold text-black bg-white border-3 border-black rounded-xl transition-all duration-300 hover:scale-105 hover:bg-black hover:text-white"
              >
                Print-On-Demand
                <svg 
                  className="ml-2 w-5 h-5 transition-transform group-hover:translate-x-1" 
                  fill="none" 
                  stroke="currentColor" 
                  viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                >
                  <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M17 8l4 4m0 0l-4 4m4-4H3" />
                </svg>
              </Link>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Right Content - Product Showcase */}
          <div 
            className={`relative transition-all duration-1000 delay-300 ${
              isVisible ? 'opacity-100 translate-y-0' : 'opacity-0 translate-y-10'
            }`}
          >
            <div className="relative">
              {/* Main Product Showcase */}
              <div className="relative group">
                {/* Product Image Container */}
                <div className="relative aspect-square bg-white rounded-3xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl border-4 border-gray-100 transition-transform duration-500 group-hover:scale-[1.02]">
                  <Image
                    src="/images/hero-product.png"
                    alt="Premium Cobra Wear T-Shirts"
                    fill
                    className="object-cover"
                    priority
                  />
                  
                  {/* Red Promo Badge - Top Left with Rotation */}
                  <div className="absolute top-8 left-0 z-10">
                    <div 
                      className="bg-red-600 text-white px-6 py-3 rounded-full shadow-2xl font-bold text-base sm:text-lg animate-pulse"
                      style={{ transform: 'rotate(-45deg)' }}
                    >
                      50% OFF
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Price Tag with Countdown - Bottom */}
                  <div className="absolute bottom-6 left-6 right-6 z-10">
                    <div className="bg-black/90 backdrop-blur-sm text-white px-4 sm:px-6 py-4 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl">
                      {/* Countdown Timer */}
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 sm:gap-4 mb-3">
                        <div className="text-center">
                          <div className="bg-white/20 backdrop-blur-sm px-2 sm:px-3 py-1 sm:py-2 rounded-lg min-w-[40px] sm:min-w-[50px]">
                            <span className="text-base sm:text-xl font-bold">{timeLeft.days}</span>
                          </div>
                          <p className="text-[10px] sm:text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1">Days</p>
                        </div>
                        <span className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold">:</span>
                        <div className="text-center">
                          <div className="bg-white/20 backdrop-blur-sm px-2 sm:px-3 py-1 sm:py-2 rounded-lg min-w-[40px] sm:min-w-[50px]">
                            <span className="text-base sm:text-xl font-bold">{String(timeLeft.hours).padStart(2, '0')}</span>
                          </div>
                          <p className="text-[10px] sm:text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1">Hours</p>
                        </div>
                        <span className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold">:</span>
                        <div className="text-center">
                          <div className="bg-white/20 backdrop-blur-sm px-2 sm:px-3 py-1 sm:py-2 rounded-lg min-w-[40px] sm:min-w-[50px]">
                            <span className="text-base sm:text-xl font-bold">{String(timeLeft.minutes).padStart(2, '0')}</span>
                          </div>
                          <p className="text-[10px] sm:text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1">Mins</p>
                        </div>
                        <span className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold">:</span>
                        <div className="text-center">
                          <div className="bg-white/20 backdrop-blur-sm px-2 sm:px-3 py-1 sm:py-2 rounded-lg min-w-[40px] sm:min-w-[50px]">
                            <span className="text-base sm:text-xl font-bold">{String(timeLeft.seconds).padStart(2, '0')}</span>
                          </div>
                          <p className="text-[10px] sm:text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1">Secs</p>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {/* Price Display */}
                      <div className="border-t border-white/20 pt-3 space-y-3">
                        {/* Prices */}
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 sm:gap-3">
                            <span className="text-base sm:text-lg lg:text-xl line-through text-gray-400 font-medium">258 DH</span>
                            <span className="text-xl sm:text-2xl lg:text-3xl font-bold text-white">129 DH</span>
                          </div>
                          <div className="bg-yellow-400 px-3 sm:px-4 py-1.5 sm:py-2 rounded-full shadow-lg animate-bounce-slow">
                            <span className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold text-black">SAVE 129 DH</span>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        
                        {/* Buy Now Button - Add to Cart */}
                        <button 
                          onClick={(e) => {
                            e.preventDefault();
                            e.stopPropagation();
                            
                            // Simple double-click prevention
                            if (isProcessingRef.current) {
                              return;
                            }
                            
                            isProcessingRef.current = true;
                            setIsAddingToCart(true);
                            
                            console.log('Adding to cart - quantity: 1');
                            
                            // Add product to cart (CartContext handles deduplication)
                            addToCart(FEATURED_PRODUCT, 'M', 'Black', 1);
                            
                            // Show success message and navigate
                            toast.success('Added to cart! Taking you to cart...');
                            
                            setTimeout(() => {

                              // Reset after navigation
                              setTimeout(() => {
                                isProcessingRef.current = false;
                                setIsAddingToCart(false);
                              }, 300);
                            }, 500);
                          }}
                          disabled={isAddingToCart}
                          className={`w-full text-center py-3 sm:py-4 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm sm:text-base transition-all duration-300 shadow-lg ${

            </div>
```

```javascriptreact
            </p>

            {/* CTAs */}
            <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-4 pt-4">
              <Link 
                href="/products" 
                className="group relative inline-flex items-center justify-center px-8 py-4 text-lg font-bold text-white bg-black rounded-xl overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300 hover:scale-105 hover:shadow-2xl"
              >
                <span className="relative z-10">Shop Now</span>
                <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-gray-900 to-black opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity"></div>
              </Link>
              
              <Link 
                href="/pod" 
                className="group relative inline-flex items-center justify-center px-8 py-4 text-lg font-bold text-white bg-black rounded-xl overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300 hover:scale-105 hover:shadow-2xl"
              >
                <span className="relative z-10 flex items-center">
                  Print-On-Demand
                  <svg 
                    className="ml-2 w-5 h-5 transition-transform group-hover:translate-x-1" 
                    fill="none" 
                    stroke="currentColor" 
                    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                  >
                    <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M17 8l4 4m0 0l-4 4m4-4H3" />
                  </svg>
                </span>
                <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-gray-900 to-black opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity"></div>
              </Link>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Right Content - Product Showcase */}
          <div 
            className={`relative transition-all duration-1000 delay-300 ${
              isVisible ? 'opacity-100 translate-y-0' : 'opacity-0 translate-y-10'
            }`}
          >
            <div className="relative">
              {/* Main Product Showcase */}
              <div className="relative group">
                {/* Product Image Container */}
                <div className="relative aspect-square bg-white rounded-3xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl border-4 border-gray-100 transition-transform duration-500 group-hover:scale-[1.02]">
                  <Image
                    src="/images/hero-product.png"
                    alt="Premium Cobra Wear T-Shirts"
                    fill
                    className="object-cover"
                    priority
                  />
                  
                  {/* Red Promo Badge - Top Left with Rotation */}
                  <div className="absolute top-8 left-0 z-10">
                    <div 
                      className="bg-red-600 text-white px-6 py-3 rounded-full shadow-2xl font-bold text-base sm:text-lg animate-pulse"
                      style={{ transform: 'rotate(-45deg)' }}
                    >
                      50% OFF
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Price Tag with Countdown - Bottom */}
                  <div className="absolute bottom-6 left-6 right-6 z-10">
                    <div className="bg-black/90 backdrop-blur-sm text-white px-4 sm:px-6 py-4 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl">
                      {/* Countdown Timer */}
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 sm:gap-4 mb-3">
                        <div className="text-center">
                          <div className="bg-white/20 backdrop-blur-sm px-2 sm:px-3 py-1 sm:py-2 rounded-lg min-w-[40px] sm:min-w-[50px]">
                            <span className="text-base sm:text-xl font-bold">{timeLeft.days}</span>
                          </div>
                          <p className="text-[10px] sm:text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1">Days</p>
                        </div>
                        <span className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold">:</span>
                        <div className="text-center">
                          <div className="bg-white/20 backdrop-blur-sm px-2 sm:px-3 py-1 sm:py-2 rounded-lg min-w-[40px] sm:min-w-[50px]">
                            <span className="text-base sm:text-xl font-bold">{String(timeLeft.hours).padStart(2, '0')}</span>
                          </div>
                          <p className="text-[10px] sm:text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1">Hours</p>
                        </div>
                        <span className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold">:</span>
                        <div className="text-center">
                          <div className="bg-white/20 backdrop-blur-sm px-2 sm:px-3 py-1 sm:py-2 rounded-lg min-w-[40px] sm:min-w-[50px]">
                            <span className="text-base sm:text-xl font-bold">{String(timeLeft.minutes).padStart(2, '0')}</span>
                          </div>
                          <p className="text-[10px] sm:text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1">Mins</p>
                        </div>
                        <span className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold">:</span>
                        <div className="text-center">
                          <div className="bg-white/20 backdrop-blur-sm px-2 sm:px-3 py-1 sm:py-2 rounded-lg min-w-[40px] sm:min-w-[50px]">
                            <span className="text-base sm:text-xl font-bold">{String(timeLeft.seconds).padStart(2, '0')}</span>
                          </div>
                          <p className="text-[10px] sm:text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1">Secs</p>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {/* Price Display */}
                      <div className="border-t border-white/20 pt-3 space-y-3">
                        {/* Prices */}
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 sm:gap-3">
                            <span className="text-base sm:text-lg lg:text-xl line-through text-gray-400 font-medium">258 DH</span>
                            <span className="text-xl sm:text-2xl lg:text-3xl font-bold text-white">129 DH</span>
                          </div>
                          <div className="bg-yellow-400 px-3 sm:px-4 py-1.5 sm:py-2 rounded-full shadow-lg animate-bounce-slow">
                            <span className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold text-black">SAVE 129 DH</span>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        
                        {/* Buy Now Button - Add to Cart */}
                        <button 
                          onClick={(e) => {
                            e.preventDefault();
                            e.stopPropagation();
                            
                            // Simple double-click prevention
                            if (isProcessingRef.current) {
                              return;
                            }
                            
                            isProcessingRef.current = true;
                            setIsAddingToCart(true);
                            
                            console.log('Adding to cart - quantity: 1');
                            
                            // Add product to cart (CartContext handles deduplication)
                            addToCart(FEATURED_PRODUCT, 'M', 'Black', 1);
                            
                            // Show success message and navigate
                            toast.success('Added to cart! Taking you to cart...');
                            
                            setTimeout(() => {
                              router.push('/cart');
                              // Reset after navigation
                              setTimeout(() => {
                                isProcessingRef.current = false;
                                setIsAddingToCart(false);
                              }, 300);
                            }, 500);
                          }}
                          disabled={isAddingToCart}
                          className={`w-full text-center py-3 sm:py-4 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm sm:text-base transition-all duration-300 shadow-lg ${
                            isAddingToCart 
                              ? 'bg-gray-300 text-gray-600 cursor-not-allowed' 
                              : 'bg-green-400 text-white hover:bg-green-500 hover:scale-[1.03] cursor-pointer'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {isAddingToCart ? 'Adding...' : 'Buy Now 🛒'}
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Gradient Overlay for better text visibility */}
                  <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/20 via-transparent to-transparent pointer-events-none"></div>
                </div>

                {/* Floating Decorative Elements */}
                <div className="absolute -top-4 -left-4 w-20 h-20 bg-red-600 rounded-full opacity-20 blur-2xl animate-float"></div>
                <div className="absolute -bottom-4 -right-4 w-16 h-16 border-4 border-black rounded-full animate-float-delayed"></div>
                
                {/* Corner Accent */}
                <div className="absolute top-0 left-0 w-24 h-24 border-t-4 border-l-4 border-black rounded-tl-3xl -translate-x-2 -translate-y-2 opacity-30"></div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Bottom Wave Divider */}
      <div className="absolute bottom-0 left-0 right-0">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 1440 48" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" className="w-full">
          <path d="M0 48h1440V0c-240 48-480 48-720 24C480 0 240 0 0 24v24z" fill="#fafafa"/>
        </svg>
      </div>

      {/* Trust Badges Section */}
      <div className="bg-gray-50 border-t border-gray-200">
        <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8 sm:py-12">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-3 sm:gap-4">
            <div className="inline-flex items-center space-x-2 bg-black text-white px-4 sm:px-5 py-2.5 sm:py-3 rounded-full text-sm sm:text-base font-medium shadow-lg hover:scale-105 transition-transform">
              <span>⭐</span>
              <span>4.9/5 Rating</span>
            </div>

            <div className="inline-flex items-center space-x-2 bg-black text-white px-4 sm:px-5 py-2.5 sm:py-3 rounded-full text-sm sm:text-base font-medium shadow-lg hover:scale-105 transition-transform">
              <svg className="w-4 h-4 sm:w-5 sm:h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M5 13l4 4L19 7" />
              </svg>
              <span>Free Shipping</span>
            </div>

            <div className="inline-flex items-center space-x-2 bg-black text-white px-4 sm:px-5 py-2.5 sm:py-3 rounded-full text-sm sm:text-base font-medium shadow-lg hover:scale-105 transition-transform">
              <svg className="w-4 h-4 sm:w-5 sm:h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M12 8v4l3 3m6-3a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z" />
              </svg>
              <span>Fast Delivery</span>
            </div>

            <div className="inline-flex items-center space-x-2 bg-black text-white px-4 sm:px-5 py-2.5 sm:py-3 rounded-full text-sm sm:text-base font-medium shadow-lg hover:scale-105 transition-transform">
              <span className="w-2 h-2 bg-white rounded-full animate-pulse"></span>
              <span>Premium Quality</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Categories Section */}
      <div className="bg-gray-50 border-b border-gray-200">
        <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-16 sm:py-20">
          <h2 className="text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-bold text-center mb-12">
            Shop by Category
          </h2>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-5 gap-4 sm:gap-6 mb-16">
            {[
              { name: 'T-Shirts', emoji: '👕', category: 'tshirts' },
              { name: 'Hoodies', emoji: '🧥', category: 'hoodies' },
              { name: 'Shorts', emoji: '🩳', category: 'shorts' },
              { name: 'Caps', emoji: '🧢', category: 'caps' },
              { name: 'Tote Bags', emoji: '👜', category: 'bags' }
            ].map((category) => (
              <Link
                key={category.name}
                href={`/products?category=${category.category}`}
                className="group bg-white p-6 sm:p-8 rounded-2xl text-center hover:shadow-xl transition-all duration-300 border border-gray-200 hover:scale-105 hover:-translate-y-1"
              >
                <div className="text-4xl sm:text-5xl mb-3 transition-transform group-hover:scale-110">{category.emoji}</div>
                <h3 className="font-semibold text-sm sm:text-base group-hover:text-gray-600 transition-colors">{category.name}</h3>
              </Link>
            ))}
          </div>

          <h2 className="text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-bold text-center mb-12 mt-16 sm:mt-20">
            Shop by Style
          </h2>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4 sm:gap-6">
            {[
              { name: 'Anime', emoji: '🎌', desc: 'Japanese inspired', style: 'anime' },
              { name: 'Gang', emoji: '🔥', desc: 'Street style', style: 'gang' },
              { name: 'Gaming', emoji: '🎮', desc: 'Gamer vibes', style: 'gaming' },
              { name: 'Classic', emoji: '⭐', desc: 'Timeless pieces', style: 'classic' }
            ].map((style) => (
              <Link
                key={style.name}
                href={`/products?style=${style.style}`}
                className="group bg-white p-6 sm:p-8 rounded-2xl text-center hover:shadow-xl transition-all duration-300 border border-gray-200 hover:scale-105 hover:-translate-y-1"
              >
                <div className="text-4xl sm:text-5xl mb-3 transition-transform group-hover:scale-110">{style.emoji}</div>
                <h3 className="font-semibold text-sm sm:text-base mb-2 group-hover:text-gray-600 transition-colors">{style.name}</h3>
                <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-gray-500">{style.desc}</p>
              </Link>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
```

```javascriptreact
'use client';

/**
 * Navbar Component
 * Responsive navigation with hamburger menu for mobile
 */

import Link from 'next/link';
import { useCart } from '@/context/CartContext';
import { useWishlist } from '@/context/WishlistContext';
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';

export default function Navbar() {
  const { getCartItemsCount } = useCart();
  const { getWishlistCount } = useWishlist();
  const cartCount = getCartItemsCount();
  const wishlistCount = getWishlistCount();
  const [isMenuOpen, setIsMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const [scrolled, setScrolled] = useState(false);

  // Handle scroll effect
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleScroll = () => {
      setScrolled(window.scrollY > 10);
    };
    window.addEventListener('scroll', handleScroll);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', handleScroll);
  }, []);

  // Prevent body scroll when menu is open
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isMenuOpen) {
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    } else {
      document.body.style.overflow = 'unset';
    }
    return () => {
      document.body.style.overflow = 'unset';
    };
  }, [isMenuOpen]);

  const toggleMenu = () => setIsMenuOpen(!isMenuOpen);
  const closeMenu = () => setIsMenuOpen(false);

  const navLinks = [
    { href: '/', label: 'Home', ariaLabel: 'Go to home page' },
    { href: '/products', label: 'Shop', ariaLabel: 'View all products' },
    { href: '/products?category=tshirts', label: 'T-Shirts', ariaLabel: 'Shop t-shirts' },
    { href: '/products?category=hoodies', label: 'Hoodies', ariaLabel: 'Shop hoodies' },
    { href: '/products?category=caps', label: 'Caps', ariaLabel: 'Shop caps' },
    { href: '/pod', label: 'Custom POD', ariaLabel: 'Print on demand custom designs' },
  ];

  return (
    <nav 
      className={`border-b border-gray-200 bg-white sticky top-0 z-50 transition-shadow duration-300 ${
        scrolled ? 'shadow-md' : ''
      }`}
      role="navigation" 
      aria-label="Main navigation"
    >
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center h-16 sm:h-18">
          {/* Logo */}
          <Link 
            href="/" 
            className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight hover:opacity-80 transition-opacity z-50"
            aria-label="Cobra Wear home"
            onClick={closeMenu}
          >
            COBRA WEAR
          </Link>
          
          {/* Desktop Navigation */}
          <div className="hidden lg:flex items-center space-x-8" role="menubar">
            {navLinks.slice(0, 3).map((link) => (
              <Link 
                key={link.href}
                href={link.href} 
                className="hover:text-gray-600 transition-colors font-medium"
                role="menuitem"
                aria-label={link.ariaLabel}
              >
                {link.label}
              </Link>
            ))}
            <Link 
              href="/pod" 
              className="hover:text-gray-600 transition-colors font-medium"
              role="menuitem"
              aria-label="Print on demand custom designs"
            >
              POD
            </Link>
            
            {/* Cart Icon */}
            <Link 
              href="/cart" 
              className="relative hover:text-gray-600 transition-colors"
              role="menuitem"
              aria-label={cartCount > 0 ? `Shopping cart with ${cartCount} items` : 'Shopping cart (empty)'}
            >
              <svg
                className="w-6 h-6"
                fill="none"
                stroke="currentColor"
                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                aria-hidden="true"
              >
                <path
                  strokeLinecap="round"
                  strokeLinejoin="round"
                  strokeWidth={2}
                  d="M3 3h2l.4 2M7 13h10l4-8H5.4M7 13L5.4 5M7 13l-2.293 2.293c-.63.63-.184 1.707.707 1.707H17m0 0a2 2 0 100 4 2 2 0 000-4zm-8 2a2 2 0 11-4 0 2 2 0 014 0z"
                />
              </svg>
              
              {cartCount > 0 && (
                <span 
                  className="absolute -top-2 -right-2 bg-black text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-full w-5 h-5 flex items-center justify-center"
                  aria-label={`${cartCount} items in cart`}
                >
                  {cartCount > 9 ? '9+' : cartCount}
                </span>
              )}
            </Link>
          </div>

          {/* Mobile Menu Button & Cart */}
          <div className="flex lg:hidden items-center space-x-4 z-50">
            {/* Mobile Cart Icon */}
            <Link 
              href="/cart" 
              className="relative hover:text-gray-600 transition-colors"
              aria-label={cartCount > 0 ? `Shopping cart with ${cartCount} items` : 'Shopping cart (empty)'}
              onClick={closeMenu}
            >
              <svg
                className="w-6 h-6"
                fill="none"
                stroke="currentColor"
                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                aria-hidden="true"
              >
                <path
                  strokeLinecap="round"
                  strokeLinejoin="round"
                  strokeWidth={2}
                  d="M3 3h2l.4 2M7 13h10l4-8H5.4M7 13L5.4 5M7 13l-2.293 2.293c-.63.63-.184 1.707.707 1.707H17m0 0a2 2 0 100 4 2 2 0 000-4zm-8 2a2 2 0 11-4 0 2 2 0 014 0z"
                />
              </svg>
              
              {cartCount > 0 && (
                <span 
                  className="absolute -top-2 -right-2 bg-black text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-full w-5 h-5 flex items-center justify-center"
                  aria-label={`${cartCount} items in cart`}
                >
                  {cartCount > 9 ? '9+' : cartCount}
                </span>
              )}
            </Link>

            {/* Hamburger Button */}
            <button
              onClick={toggleMenu}
              className="p-2 hover:bg-gray-100 rounded-lg transition-colors"
              aria-label={isMenuOpen ? 'Close menu' : 'Open menu'}
              aria-expanded={isMenuOpen}
              aria-controls="mobile-menu"
            >
              <div className="w-6 h-5 flex flex-col justify-between">
                <span 
                  className={`block h-0.5 w-full bg-black transition-all duration-300 ${
                    isMenuOpen ? 'rotate-45 translate-y-2' : ''
                  }`}
                ></span>
                <span 
                  className={`block h-0.5 w-full bg-black transition-all duration-300 ${
                    isMenuOpen ? 'opacity-0' : ''
                  }`}
                ></span>
                <span 
                  className={`block h-0.5 w-full bg-black transition-all duration-300 ${
                    isMenuOpen ? '-rotate-45 -translate-y-2' : ''
                  }`}
                ></span>
              </div>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Mobile Menu Overlay */}
      {isMenuOpen && (
        <div 
          className="lg:hidden fixed inset-0 bg-black bg-opacity-50 z-40 animate-fade-in"
          onClick={closeMenu}
          aria-hidden="true"
        ></div>
      )}

      {/* Mobile Menu */}
      <div
        id="mobile-menu"
        className={`lg:hidden fixed top-16 right-0 bottom-0 w-full sm:w-80 bg-white shadow-2xl z-40 transform transition-transform duration-300 ease-in-out ${
          isMenuOpen ? 'translate-x-0' : 'translate-x-full'
        }`}
        role="menu"
      >
        <div className="flex flex-col h-full overflow-y-auto">
          {/* Menu Header */}
          <div className="border-b border-gray-200 p-6">
            <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900">Menu</h2>
          </div>

          {/* Menu Links */}
          <nav className="flex-1 p-6 space-y-1">
            {navLinks.map((link) => (
              <Link
                key={link.href}
                href={link.href}
                onClick={closeMenu}
                className="block px-4 py-3 text-base font-medium text-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-50 hover:text-black rounded-lg transition-colors"
                role="menuitem"
                aria-label={link.ariaLabel}
              >
                {link.label}
              </Link>
            ))}
          </nav>

          {/* Menu Footer */}
          <div className="border-t border-gray-200 p-6 space-y-3">
            <Link
              href="/cart"
              onClick={closeMenu}
              className="block w-full bg-black text-white text-center py-3 rounded-lg font-medium hover:bg-gray-800 transition-colors"
            >
              View Cart {cartCount > 0 && `(${cartCount})`}
            </Link>
            <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 text-center">
              © 2025 Cobra Wear
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </nav>
  );
}
```

```javascriptreact
'use client';

/**

import Link from 'next/link';

import { useWishlist } from '@/context/WishlistContext';

  const { getCartItemsCount } = useCart();
  const { getWishlistCount } = useWishlist();
  const cartCount = getCartItemsCount();
  const wishlistCount = getWishlistCount();
  const [isMenuOpen, setIsMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const [scrolled, setScrolled] = useState(false);

  // Handle scroll effect
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleScroll = () => {
      setScrolled(window.scrollY > 10);
    };
    window.addEventListener('scroll', handleScroll);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', handleScroll);
  }, []);

  // Prevent body scroll when menu is open
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isMenuOpen) {
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    } else {
      document.body.style.overflow = 'unset';
    }
    return () => {
      document.body.style.overflow = 'unset';
    };
  }, [isMenuOpen]);

  const toggleMenu = () => setIsMenuOpen(!isMenuOpen);
  const closeMenu = () => setIsMenuOpen(false);

  const navLinks = [
    { href: '/', label: 'Home', ariaLabel: 'Go to home page' },
    { href: '/products', label: 'Shop', ariaLabel: 'View all products' },
    { href: '/products?category=tshirts', label: 'T-Shirts', ariaLabel: 'Shop t-shirts' },

    { href: '/pod', label: 'Print-On-Demand', ariaLabel: 'Print on demand custom designs' },
  ];

  return (
    <nav

              role="menuitem"
              aria-label="Print on demand custom designs"
            >
```
```javascriptreact
              Print-On-Demand
            </Link>
            <Link 
              href="/products?category=tshirts" 
              className="hover:text-gray-600 transition-colors font-medium"
              role="menuitem"
              aria-label="Shop t-shirts"

            </Link>

            </Link>
            
            {/* Icon Links */}
            <div className="flex items-center space-x-4">
              {/* Wishlist Icon */}
              <Link 
                href="/wishlist" 
                className="relative hover:text-gray-600 transition-all duration-300 hover:scale-110"
                role="menuitem"
                aria-label={wishlistCount > 0 ? `Wishlist with ${wishlistCount} items` : 'Wishlist (empty)'}
              >
                <svg className="w-6 h-6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
```

```javascriptreact
                <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M3 5h12M9 3v2m1.048 9.5A18.022 18.022 0 016.412 9m6.088 9h7M11 21l5-10 5 10M12.751 5C11.783 10.77 8.07 15.61 3 18.129" />
              </svg>
            </button>

            {/* Hamburger Button */}
            <button
              onClick={toggleMenu}
              className="p-2 hover:bg-gray-100 rounded-lg transition-all duration-300 active:scale-95 ml-1"
              aria-label={isMenuOpen ? 'Close menu' : 'Open menu'}
              aria-expanded={isMenuOpen}
              aria-controls="mobile-menu"
            >
              <div className="w-6 h-5 flex flex-col justify-between">
                <span 
                  className={`block h-0.5 w-full bg-black transition-all duration-300 ${
                    isMenuOpen ? 'rotate-45 translate-y-2' : ''
                  }`}
                ></span>
                <span 
                  className={`block h-0.5 w-full bg-black transition-all duration-300 ${
                    isMenuOpen ? 'opacity-0' : ''
                  }`}
                ></span>
                <span 
                  className={`block h-0.5 w-full bg-black transition-all duration-300 ${
                    isMenuOpen ? '-rotate-45 -translate-y-2' : ''
                  }`}
                ></span>
              </div>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Mobile Menu Overlay */}
      {isMenuOpen && (
        <div 
          className="lg:hidden fixed inset-0 bg-black bg-opacity-50 z-40 animate-fade-in"
          onClick={closeMenu}
          aria-hidden="true"
        ></div>
      )}

      {/* Mobile Menu */}
      <div
        id="mobile-menu"
        className={`lg:hidden fixed top-16 right-0 bottom-0 w-full sm:w-80 bg-white shadow-2xl z-40 transform transition-transform duration-300 ease-in-out ${
          isMenuOpen ? 'translate-x-0' : 'translate-x-full'
        }`}
        role="menu"
      >
        <div className="flex flex-col h-full overflow-y-auto">
          {/* Menu Header */}
          <div className="border-b border-gray-200 p-6">
            <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900">Menu</h2>
          </div>

          {/* Menu Links */}
          <nav className="flex-1 p-6 space-y-1">
            {navLinks.map((link) => (
              <Link
                key={link.href}
                href={link.href}
                onClick={closeMenu}
                className="block px-4 py-3 text-base font-medium text-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-50 hover:text-black rounded-lg transition-colors"
                role="menuitem"
                aria-label={link.ariaLabel}
              >
                {link.label}
              </Link>
            ))}
          </nav>

          {/* Menu Footer */}
          <div className="border-t border-gray-200 p-6 space-y-3">
            <Link
              href="/cart"
              onClick={closeMenu}
              className="block w-full bg-black text-white text-center py-3 rounded-lg font-medium hover:bg-gray-800 transition-colors"
            >

            <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 text-center">
              © 2025 Cobra Wear
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </nav>
```

```javascriptreact
'use client';

/**
 * Navbar Component
 * Responsive navigation with hamburger menu for mobile
 */

import Link from 'next/link';
import { useCart } from '@/context/CartContext';
import { useWishlist } from '@/context/WishlistContext';
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';

export default function Navbar() {
  const { getCartItemsCount } = useCart();
  const { getWishlistCount } = useWishlist();
  const cartCount = getCartItemsCount();
  const wishlistCount = getWishlistCount();
  const [isMenuOpen, setIsMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const [scrolled, setScrolled] = useState(false);

  // Handle scroll effect
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleScroll = () => {
      setScrolled(window.scrollY > 10);
    };
    window.addEventListener('scroll', handleScroll);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', handleScroll);
  }, []);

  // Prevent body scroll when menu is open
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isMenuOpen) {
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    } else {
      document.body.style.overflow = 'unset';
    }
    return () => {
      document.body.style.overflow = 'unset';
    };
  }, [isMenuOpen]);

  const toggleMenu = () => setIsMenuOpen(!isMenuOpen);
  const closeMenu = () => setIsMenuOpen(false);

  const navLinks = [
    { href: '/', label: 'Home', ariaLabel: 'Go to home page' },
    { href: '/products', label: 'Shop', ariaLabel: 'View all products' },
    { href: '/products?category=tshirts', label: 'T-Shirts', ariaLabel: 'Shop t-shirts' },
    { href: '/products?category=hoodies', label: 'Hoodies', ariaLabel: 'Shop hoodies' },
    { href: '/pod', label: 'Print-On-Demand', ariaLabel: 'Print on demand custom designs' },
  ];

  return (
    <nav 
      className={`border-b border-gray-200 bg-white sticky top-0 z-50 transition-shadow duration-300 ${
        scrolled ? 'shadow-md' : ''
      }`}
      role="navigation" 
      aria-label="Main navigation"
    >
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center h-16 sm:h-18">
          {/* Logo */}
          <Link 
            href="/" 
            className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight hover:opacity-80 transition-opacity z-50"
            aria-label="Cobra Wear home"
            onClick={closeMenu}
          >
            COBRA WEAR
          </Link>
          
          {/* Desktop Navigation */}
          <div className="hidden lg:flex items-center space-x-8" role="menubar">
            {/* Text Links */}
            <Link 
              href="/pod" 
              className="hover:text-gray-600 transition-colors font-medium"
              role="menuitem"
              aria-label="Print on demand custom designs"
            >
              Print-On-Demand
            </Link>
            <Link 
              href="/products?category=tshirts" 
              className="hover:text-gray-600 transition-colors font-medium"
              role="menuitem"
              aria-label="Shop t-shirts"
            >
              T-Shirts
            </Link>
            <Link 
              href="/products?category=hoodies" 
              className="hover:text-gray-600 transition-colors font-medium"
              role="menuitem"
              aria-label="Shop hoodies"
            >
              Hoodies
            </Link>
            
            {/* Icon Links */}
            <div className="flex items-center space-x-4">
              {/* Wishlist Icon */}
              <Link 
                href="/wishlist" 
                className="relative hover:text-gray-600 transition-all duration-300 hover:scale-110"
                role="menuitem"
                aria-label={wishlistCount > 0 ? `Wishlist with ${wishlistCount} items` : 'Wishlist (empty)'}
              >
                <svg className="w-6 h-6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                  <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M4.318 6.318a4.5 4.5 0 000 6.364L12 20.364l7.682-7.682a4.5 4.5 0 00-6.364-6.364L12 7.636l-1.318-1.318a4.5 4.5 0 00-6.364 0z" />
                </svg>
                {wishlistCount > 0 && (
                  <span className="absolute -top-2 -right-2 bg-red-500 text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-full w-5 h-5 flex items-center justify-center">
                    {wishlistCount > 9 ? '9+' : wishlistCount}
                  </span>
                )}
              </Link>

              {/* Cart Icon */}
              <Link 
                href="/cart" 
                className="relative hover:text-gray-600 transition-all duration-300 hover:scale-110"
                role="menuitem"
                aria-label={cartCount > 0 ? `Shopping cart with ${cartCount} items` : 'Shopping cart (empty)'}
              >
                <svg className="w-6 h-6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">

                  {wishlistCount > 9 ? '9+' : wishlistCount}
                </span>
              )}
            </Link>

            {/* Mobile Cart Icon */}
            <Link

            <button

            >
              <svg className="w-6 h-6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M3 5h12M9 3v2m1.048 9.5A18.022 18.022 0 016.412 9m6.088 9h7M11 21l5-10 5 10M12.751 5C11.783 10.77 8.07 15.61 3 18.129" />
              </svg>
            </button>

            {/* Hamburger Button */}
            <button

              aria-label={isMenuOpen ? 'Close menu' : 'Open menu'}
              aria-expanded={isMenuOpen}

            >
              <div className="w-6 h-5 flex flex-col justify-between">

                <span

                  }`}
                ></span>

                  }`}
                ></span>
              </div>
            </button>
          </div>

      </div>

      {/* Mobile Menu Overlay */}
      {isMenuOpen && (

        ></div>
      )}
```

```css
@tailwind base;
@tailwind components;
@tailwind utilities;

* {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

html {
  scroll-behavior: smooth;
}

body {
  font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Roboto', 'Oxygen',
    'Ubuntu', 'Cantarell', 'Fira Sans', 'Droid Sans', 'Helvetica Neue',
    sans-serif;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
}

@layer components {
  .btn-primary {
    @apply bg-black text-white px-8 py-4 rounded-lg font-medium hover:bg-gray-800 transition-all duration-300 hover:scale-105 hover:shadow-lg;
  }
  
  .btn-secondary {
    @apply bg-white text-black px-8 py-4 rounded-lg font-medium border-2 border-black hover:bg-black hover:text-white transition-all duration-300 hover:scale-105;
  }
}

@layer utilities {
  /* Modern Animations */
  @keyframes fadeIn {
    from {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(20px);
    }
    to {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateY(0);
    }
  }

  @keyframes slideUp {
    from {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(30px);
    }
    to {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateY(0);
    }
  }

  @keyframes float {
    0%, 100% {
      transform: translateY(0px);
    }
    50% {
      transform: translateY(-20px);
    }
  }

  @keyframes floatDelayed {
    0%, 100% {
      transform: translateY(0px);
    }
    50% {
      transform: translateY(-15px);
    }
  }

  @keyframes subtleFloat {
    0%, 100% {
      transform: translateY(0px) scale(1);
    }
    50% {
      transform: translateY(-5px) scale(1.02);
    }
  }

  @keyframes bounceSlow {
    0%, 100% {
      transform: translateY(0);
    }
    50% {
      transform: translateY(-10px);
    }
  }

  .animate-fade-in {
    animation: fadeIn 0.6s ease-out;
  }

  .animate-slide-up {
    animation: slideUp 0.8s ease-out;
  }

  .animate-float {
    animation: float 6s ease-in-out infinite;
  }

  .animate-float-delayed {
    animation: floatDelayed 6s ease-in-out infinite 1s;
  }

  .animate-subtle-float {
    animation: subtleFloat 4s ease-in-out infinite;
  }

  .animate-bounce-slow {
    animation: bounceSlow 3s ease-in-out infinite;
  }

  /* Hover Effects */
  .hover-lift {
    @apply transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-2 hover:shadow-xl;
  }

  .hover-scale {
    @apply transition-transform duration-300 hover:scale-105;
  }

  /* Focus Styles for Accessibility */
  .focus-ring {
    @apply focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-black focus:ring-offset-2;
  }

  /* Card Shadows */
  .card-shadow {
    @apply shadow-md hover:shadow-2xl transition-shadow duration-300;
  }

  /* Responsive Text */
  .text-responsive-sm {
    @apply text-sm sm:text-base;
  }

  .text-responsive-base {
    @apply text-base sm:text-lg;
  }

  .text-responsive-lg {
    @apply text-lg sm:text-xl;
  }

  .text-responsive-xl {
    @apply text-xl sm:text-2xl md:text-3xl;
  }

  .text-responsive-2xl {
    @apply text-2xl sm:text-3xl md:text-4xl;
  }

  .text-responsive-3xl {
    @apply text-3xl sm:text-4xl md:text-5xl;
  }

  /* Responsive Padding - Modern 2025 Standards */
  .section-padding {
    @apply py-20 sm:py-24 lg:py-32;
  }

  .section-padding-md {
    @apply py-16 sm:py-20 lg:py-24;
  }

  .section-padding-sm {
    @apply py-12 sm:py-16 lg:py-20;
  }

  .section-padding-xs {
    @apply py-8 sm:py-12 lg:py-16;
  }

  /* Container Responsive */
  .container-responsive {
    @apply px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8;
  }

  /* Modern Card Shadows - Subtle & Layered */
  .shadow-card {
    box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1), 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
  }

  .shadow-card-hover {
    box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1), 0 4px 6px -2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
  }

  .shadow-card-active {
    box-shadow: 0 20px 25px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1), 0 10px 10px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04);
  }

  /* Smooth Universal Transitions */
  .transition-smooth {
    @apply transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out;
  }

  .transition-smooth-fast {
    @apply transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out;
  }

  .transition-smooth-slow {
    @apply transition-all duration-500 ease-in-out;
  }

  /* Modern Button Base */
  .btn-modern {
    @apply px-6 py-3 rounded-lg font-medium transition-all duration-300 hover:scale-[1.03] focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2;
  }

  /* Typography Hierarchy */
  .heading-1 {
    @apply text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold leading-tight tracking-tight;
  }

  .heading-2 {
    @apply text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold leading-tight;
  }

  .heading-3 {
    @apply text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold leading-snug;
  }

  .heading-4 {
    @apply text-xl sm:text-2xl lg:text-3xl font-semibold;
  }

  .body-large {
    @apply text-lg sm:text-xl leading-relaxed;
  }

  .body-base {
    @apply text-base sm:text-lg leading-relaxed;
  }

  /* Interactive Elements - Universal Hover */
  button, 
  a[href], 
  [role="button"] {
    @apply transition-all duration-300;
  }

  /* Focus Visible for Better Accessibility */
  *:focus-visible {
    @apply outline-none ring-2 ring-black ring-offset-2;
  }
}

/* Custom Scrollbar */
::-webkit-scrollbar {
  width: 10px;
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
  background: #f1f1f1;
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background: #888;
  border-radius: 5px;
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
  background: #555;
}

/* Loading Skeleton */
@keyframes shimmer {
  0% {
    background-position: -1000px 0;
  }
  100% {
    background-position: 1000px 0;
  }
}

.skeleton {
  animation: shimmer 2s infinite;
  background: linear-gradient(to right, #f0f0f0 4%, #e0e0e0 25%, #f0f0f0 36%);
  background-size: 1000px 100%;
}

/* Image Optimization */
img {
  max-width: 100%;
  height: auto;
}
```
