```javascriptreact
'use client';

/**
 * Improved POD Upload Form Component
 * Enhanced Print-On-Demand workflow with:
 * - Product icons and better UI
 * - Multi-file upload system
 * - Smart size/color logic per product
 * - Phone model selector
 * - Drag-and-drop upload
 * - Image validation
 * - Better step flow
 */

import { useState } from 'react';
import { useToast } from '@/context/ToastContext';
import { uploadToCloudinary } from '@/lib/cloudinary';
import { sendOrderEmail } from '@/lib/emailjs';
import { sendCustomerPODConfirmation } from '@/lib/customer-email';
import { validateForm, commonRules } from '@/lib/validation';
import { trackPODSubmission } from '@/lib/analytics';
import { POD_PRODUCTS, getProductById, getUploadAreas, getRequiredUploadAreas } from '@/lib/pod-products';
import { ProductIconLarge, ProductIconSmall } from '@/components/ProductIcons';
import MultiFileUpload from '@/components/MultiFileUpload';

export default function ImprovedPodUploadForm() {
  const toast = useToast();

  // Form state
  const [step, setStep] = useState(1);
  const [selectedProduct, setSelectedProduct] = useState(null);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    productType: '',
    size: '',
    phoneModel: '',
    color: '',
    designs: {},
    designUrls: {},
    customerName: '',
    customerEmail: '',
    customerPhone: '',
    customerAddress: '',
    notes: '',
  });

  // UI state
  const [uploadedFiles, setUploadedFiles] = useState({});
  const [isUploading, setIsUploading] = useState(false);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [uploadError, setUploadError] = useState('');
  const [submitSuccess, setSubmitSuccess] = useState(false);
  const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState({});

  // Get current product config
  const currentProduct = selectedProduct ? getProductById(selectedProduct) : null;
  const uploadAreas = currentProduct ? getUploadAreas(selectedProduct) : [];
  const requiredAreas = currentProduct ? getRequiredUploadAreas(selectedProduct) : [];

  // Handle product selection
  const handleProductSelect = (productId) => {
    const product = getProductById(productId);
    setSelectedProduct(productId);
    setFormData((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      productType: product.name,
      size: product.requiresSize ? product.sizes[0] : '',
      color: product.colors[0],
      phoneModel: product.requiresPhoneModel ? product.phoneModels[0] : '',
    }));
    setStep(2);
  };

  // Handle form field changes
  const handleChange = (field, value) => {
    setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, [field]: value }));
    if (fieldErrors[field]) {
      setFieldErrors((prev) => {
        const newErrors = { ...prev };
        delete newErrors[field];
        return newErrors;
      });
    }
  };

  // Handle files change from MultiFileUpload
  const handleFilesChange = (files) => {
    setUploadedFiles(files);
    setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, designs: files }));
  };

  // Upload all designs to Cloudinary
  const handleUploadDesigns = async () => {
    // Check if required files are uploaded
    const missingRequired = requiredAreas.filter((area) => !uploadedFiles[area.id]);
    if (missingRequired.length > 0) {
      toast.error(`Please upload required designs: ${missingRequired.map((a) => a.name).join(', ')}`);
      return;
    }

    setIsUploading(true);
    setUploadError('');

    try {
      const uploadPromises = Object.entries(uploadedFiles).map(async ([areaId, file]) => {
        const result = await uploadToCloudinary(file);
        return [areaId, result.url];
      });

      const uploadResults = await Promise.all(uploadPromises);
      const designUrls = Object.fromEntries(uploadResults);

      setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, designUrls }));
      toast.success('All designs uploaded successfully!');
      setStep(step + 1);
    } catch (error) {
      setUploadError('Failed to upload designs. Please try again.');
      toast.error('Failed to upload designs. Please try again.');
      console.error('Upload error:', error);
    } finally {
      setIsUploading(false);
    }
  };

  // Submit order
  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setFieldErrors({});

    // Validate form
    const validation = validateForm(formData, commonRules);
    if (!validation.isValid) {
      setFieldErrors(validation.errors);
      toast.error('Please fix the errors in the form');
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);

    try {
      // Prepare order data
      const orderData = {
        ...formData,
        // Keep designUrls object for proper email formatting
        // designUrl will be generated in emailjs.js from designUrls
      };

      // Send order email to business
      await sendOrderEmail(orderData);

      // Send confirmation email to customer (non-blocking)
      sendCustomerPODConfirmation(orderData).catch((err) => {
        console.error('Failed to send customer confirmation:', err);
      });

      // Track POD submission in analytics
      trackPODSubmission(formData.productType);

      setSubmitSuccess(true);
      toast.success('Order placed successfully! Check your email for confirmation.');
      setStep(7); // Success screen
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error('Failed to submit order. Please try again.');
      console.error('Submit error:', error);
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  // Reset form
  const resetForm = () => {
    setStep(1);
    setSelectedProduct(null);
    setFormData({
      productType: '',
      size: '',
      phoneModel: '',
      color: '',
      designs: {},
      designUrls: {},
      customerName: '',
      customerEmail: '',
      customerPhone: '',
      customerAddress: '',
      notes: '',
    });
    setUploadedFiles({});
    setSubmitSuccess(false);
  };

  const stepLabels = ['Product', 'Color', 'Size', 'Design', 'Preview', 'Details'];

  return (
    <div className="max-w-6xl mx-auto">
      {/* Progress Steps - Compact Mobile Design */}
      <div className="mb-8 sm:mb-12">
        {/* Mobile: Current Step Indicator */}
        <div className="block sm:hidden mb-4">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
            <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900">
              Step {step} of 6
            </span>
            <span className="text-xs text-gray-500 font-medium">
              {stepLabels[step - 1]}
            </span>
          </div>
          {/* Progress Bar */}
          <div className="w-full bg-gray-200 rounded-full h-2">
            <div
              className="bg-black h-2 rounded-full transition-all duration-300"
              style={{ width: `${(step / 6) * 100}%` }}
            ></div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Desktop: Full Stepper */}
        <div className="hidden sm:block">
          <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
            {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6].map((stepNum) => (
              <div key={stepNum} className="flex items-center">
                <div
                  className={`w-10 h-10 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-bold border-2 transition-all ${
                    step >= stepNum
                      ? 'bg-black text-white border-black'
                      : 'bg-white text-gray-400 border-gray-300'
                  }`}
                >
                  {stepNum}
                </div>
                {stepNum < 6 && (
                  <div
                    className={`w-8 lg:w-16 h-1 mx-1 lg:mx-2 transition-all ${
                      step > stepNum ? 'bg-black' : 'bg-gray-300'
                    }`}
                  ></div>
                )}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
          <div className="flex justify-between mt-3 text-xs text-gray-600 font-medium">
            {stepLabels.map((label, index) => (
              <span key={index} className="text-center" style={{ width: '40px' }}>
                {label}
              </span>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Step Content */}
      <div className="bg-white border-2 border-gray-200 rounded-2xl p-8 shadow-sm">
        {/* Step 1: Product Selection */}
        {step === 1 && (
          <div className="space-y-6">
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-2">Choose Your Product</h2>
              <p className="text-gray-600">Select the product you want to customize</p>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
              {POD_PRODUCTS.map((product) => (
                <button
                  key={product.id}
                  onClick={() => handleProductSelect(product.id)}
                  className="group relative border-2 border-gray-200 rounded-xl p-6 hover:border-black hover:shadow-lg transition-all"
                >
                  {product.recommended && (
                    <div className="absolute top-2 right-2 bg-black text-white text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded-full font-semibold">
                      Recommended
                    </div>
                  )}
                  <ProductIconLarge type={product.icon} className="mx-auto mb-4" />
                  <h3 className="font-semibold text-center">{product.name}</h3>
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Step 2: Color Selection */}
        {step === 2 && currentProduct && (
          <div className="space-y-6">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-4 mb-6">
              <button
                onClick={() => setStep(1)}
                className="text-gray-600 hover:text-black flex items-center gap-2"
              >
                ← Back
              </button>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <ProductIconSmall type={currentProduct.icon} />
                <span className="font-semibold">{currentProduct.name}</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div>
              <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-2">Choose Color</h2>
              <p className="text-gray-600">Select your preferred color</p>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-5 gap-4">
              {currentProduct.colors.map((color) => (
                <button
                  key={color}
                  onClick={() => {
                    handleChange('color', color);
                    setStep(3);
                  }}
                  className={`p-6 border-2 rounded-xl font-semibold transition-all flex flex-col items-center gap-3 ${
                    formData.color === color
                      ? 'border-black bg-black text-white'
                      : 'border-gray-200 hover:border-black'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div
                    className={`w-16 h-16 rounded-full border-2 ${
                      color === 'White' || color === 'Natural' || color === 'Beige' || color === 'Clear'
                        ? 'border-gray-300'
                        : 'border-transparent'
                    }`}
                    style={{
                      backgroundColor:
                        color === 'Black'
                          ? '#000000'
                          : color === 'White'
                          ? '#FFFFFF'
                          : color === 'Grey' || color === 'Gray'
                          ? '#9CA3AF'
                          : color === 'Navy'
                          ? '#1E3A8A'
                          : color === 'Beige'
                          ? '#F5F5DC'
                          : color === 'Burgundy'
                          ? '#800020'
                          : color === 'Olive'
                          ? '#808000'
                          : color === 'Natural'
                          ? '#F5F5DC'
                          : color === 'Clear'
                          ? 'transparent'
                          : '#CCCCCC',
                    }}
                  ></div>
                  <span>{color}</span>
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Step 3: Size / Phone Model Selection */}
        {step === 3 && currentProduct && (
          <div className="space-y-6">
            <button
              onClick={() => setStep(2)}
              className="text-gray-600 hover:text-black flex items-center gap-2 mb-6"
            >
              ← Back
            </button>

            {currentProduct.requiresSize && (
              <div>
                <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-2">Choose Size</h2>
                <p className="text-gray-600">Select your size</p>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-5 gap-4 mt-6">
                  {currentProduct.sizes.map((size) => (
                    <button
                      key={size}
                      onClick={() => {
                        handleChange('size', size);
                        setStep(4);
                      }}
                      className={`p-6 border-2 rounded-xl font-semibold text-xl transition-all flex items-center justify-center ${
                        formData.size === size
                          ? 'border-black bg-black text-white'
                          : 'border-gray-200 hover:border-black'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {size}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {currentProduct.requiresPhoneModel && (
              <div>
                <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-2">Choose Phone Model</h2>
                <p className="text-gray-600">Select your device</p>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4 mt-6">
                  {currentProduct.phoneModels.map((model) => (
                    <button
                      key={model}
                      onClick={() => {
                        handleChange('phoneModel', model);
                        setStep(4);
                      }}
                      className={`p-4 border-2 rounded-xl font-medium transition-all text-left ${
                        formData.phoneModel === model
                          ? 'border-black bg-black text-white'
                          : 'border-gray-200 hover:border-black'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {model}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {!currentProduct.requiresSize && !currentProduct.requiresPhoneModel && (
              <div>
                <p className="text-center text-gray-600 mb-6">This product doesn't require size selection</p>
                <button
                  onClick={() => setStep(4)}
                  className="w-full btn-primary"
                >
                  Continue to Design Upload
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Step 4: Upload Designs */}
        {step === 4 && currentProduct && (
          <div className="space-y-6">
            <button
              onClick={() => setStep(3)}
              className="text-gray-600 hover:text-black flex items-center gap-2 mb-6"
            >
              ← Back
            </button>

            <div>
              <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-2">Upload Your Designs</h2>
              <p className="text-gray-600">
                Upload your design files for each placement area
              </p>
            </div>

            <MultiFileUpload
              uploadAreas={uploadAreas}
              onFilesChange={handleFilesChange}
              disabled={isUploading}
            />

            {uploadError && (
              <div className="p-4 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 rounded-lg text-red-600">
                {uploadError}
              </div>
            )}

            <button
              onClick={handleUploadDesigns}
              disabled={isUploading || Object.keys(uploadedFiles).length === 0}
              className="w-full btn-primary disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
            >
              {isUploading ? 'Uploading Designs...' : 'Continue to Preview'}
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Step 5: Preview */}
        {step === 5 && currentProduct && (
          <div className="space-y-6">
            <button
              onClick={() => setStep(4)}
              className="text-gray-600 hover:text-black flex items-center gap-2 mb-6"
            >
              ← Back
            </button>

            <div>
              <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-2">Preview Your Design</h2>
              <p className="text-gray-600">Review your customization before checkout</p>
            </div>

            {/* Order Summary */}
            <div className="bg-gray-50 p-6 rounded-xl border border-gray-200">
              <h3 className="font-bold text-xl mb-4">Order Summary</h3>
              <div className="space-y-3">
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span className="text-gray-600">Product:</span>
                  <span className="font-semibold">{formData.productType}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span className="text-gray-600">Color:</span>
                  <span className="font-semibold">{formData.color}</span>
                </div>
                {formData.size && (
                  <div className="flex justify-between">
                    <span className="text-gray-600">Size:</span>
                    <span className="font-semibold">{formData.size}</span>
                  </div>
                )}
                {formData.phoneModel && (
                  <div className="flex justify-between">
                    <span className="text-gray-600">Phone Model:</span>
                    <span className="font-semibold">{formData.phoneModel}</span>
                  </div>
                )}
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span className="text-gray-600">Design Areas:</span>
                  <span className="font-semibold">{Object.keys(formData.designUrls).length}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between pt-3 border-t border-gray-300">
                  <span className="text-gray-600">Payment:</span>
                  <span className="font-semibold">Cash on Delivery</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Design Previews */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              {Object.entries(formData.designUrls).map(([areaId, url]) => {
                const area = uploadAreas.find((a) => a.id === areaId);
                return (
                  <div key={areaId} className="border-2 border-gray-200 rounded-lg p-4">
                    <h4 className="font-semibold mb-2">{area?.name}</h4>
                    <img
                      src={url}
                      alt={area?.name}
                      className="w-full h-48 object-contain bg-gray-50 rounded"
                    />
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>

            <button
              onClick={() => setStep(6)}
              className="w-full btn-primary"
            >
              Continue to Shipping Details
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Step 6: Shipping Details */}
        {step === 6 && (
          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-6">
            <button
              onClick={() => setStep(5)}
              className="text-gray-600 hover:text-black flex items-center gap-2 mb-6"
            >
              ← Back
            </button>

            <div>
              <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-2">Shipping Details</h2>
              <p className="text-gray-600">Enter your delivery information</p>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
              <div>
                <label htmlFor="pod-name" className="block mb-2 font-medium">
                  Full Name <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                </label>
                <input
                  id="pod-name"
                  type="text"
                  value={formData.customerName}
                  onChange={(e) => handleChange('customerName', e.target.value)}
                  className={`w-full px-4 py-3 border-2 rounded-xl focus:outline-none focus:border-black transition-colors ${
                    fieldErrors.customerName ? 'border-red-500' : 'border-gray-200'
                  }`}
                  placeholder="John Doe"
                />
                {fieldErrors.customerName && (
                  <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-red-600">{fieldErrors.customerName}</p>
                )}
              </div>

              <div>
                <label htmlFor="pod-email" className="block mb-2 font-medium">
                  Email <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                </label>
                <input
                  id="pod-email"
                  type="email"
                  value={formData.customerEmail}
                  onChange={(e) => handleChange('customerEmail', e.target.value)}
                  className={`w-full px-4 py-3 border-2 rounded-xl focus:outline-none focus:border-black transition-colors ${
                    fieldErrors.customerEmail ? 'border-red-500' : 'border-gray-200'
                  }`}
                  placeholder="john@example.com"
                />
                {fieldErrors.customerEmail && (
                  <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-red-600">{fieldErrors.customerEmail}</p>
                )}
              </div>

              <div>
                <label htmlFor="pod-phone" className="block mb-2 font-medium">
                  Phone <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                </label>
                <input
                  id="pod-phone"
                  type="tel"
                  value={formData.customerPhone}
                  onChange={(e) => handleChange('customerPhone', e.target.value)}
                  className={`w-full px-4 py-3 border-2 rounded-xl focus:outline-none focus:border-black transition-colors ${
                    fieldErrors.customerPhone ? 'border-red-500' : 'border-gray-200'
                  }`}
                  placeholder="+1 234 567 8900"
                />
                {fieldErrors.customerPhone && (
                  <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-red-600">{fieldErrors.customerPhone}</p>
                )}
              </div>

              <div className="md:col-span-2">
                <label htmlFor="pod-address" className="block mb-2 font-medium">
                  Shipping Address <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                </label>
                <textarea
                  id="pod-address"
                  value={formData.customerAddress}
                  onChange={(e) => handleChange('customerAddress', e.target.value)}
                  rows={3}
                  className={`w-full px-4 py-3 border-2 rounded-xl focus:outline-none focus:border-black transition-colors resize-none ${
                    fieldErrors.customerAddress ? 'border-red-500' : 'border-gray-200'
                  }`}
                  placeholder="123 Main St, City, State, ZIP"
                />
                {fieldErrors.customerAddress && (
                  <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-red-600">{fieldErrors.customerAddress}</p>
                )}
              </div>

              <div className="md:col-span-2">
                <label htmlFor="pod-notes" className="block mb-2 font-medium">
                  Additional Notes (Optional)
                </label>
                <textarea
                  id="pod-notes"
                  value={formData.notes}
                  onChange={(e) => handleChange('notes', e.target.value)}
                  rows={3}
                  className="w-full px-4 py-3 border-2 border-gray-200 rounded-xl focus:outline-none focus:border-black transition-colors resize-none"
                  placeholder="Any special instructions..."
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={isSubmitting}
              className="w-full btn-primary text-lg py-4 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
            >
              {isSubmitting ? 'Placing Order...' : 'Place Order (COD)'}
            </button>
          </form>
        )}

        {/* Step 7: Success */}
        {step === 7 && submitSuccess && (
          <div className="text-center space-y-6 py-12">
            <div className="w-20 h-20 bg-black rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mx-auto">
              <svg
                className="w-10 h-10 text-white"
                fill="none"
                stroke="currentColor"
                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
              >
                <path
                  strokeLinecap="round"
                  strokeLinejoin="round"
                  strokeWidth={3}
                  d="M5 13l4 4L19 7"
                />
              </svg>
            </div>
            <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold">Order Placed Successfully!</h2>
            <p className="text-gray-600 max-w-md mx-auto text-lg">
              Thank you for your custom order! We'll contact you soon to confirm the details and
              arrange delivery.
            </p>
            <div className="flex gap-4 justify-center pt-6">
              <button onClick={resetForm} className="btn-primary">
                Create Another Design
              </button>
              <a href="/" className="btn-secondary">
                Back to Home
              </a>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


```

Perfect! ✅ I've fixed the centering issue for the size buttons. Here's what was wrong and how I fixed it:

---

## 🐛 **The Problem:**

The size buttons (S, M, L, XL, XXL) didn't have explicit centering classes, so the text was aligned to the left by default.

**Before:**
```jsx
className={`p-6 border-2 rounded-xl font-semibold text-xl transition-all ${...}`}
```

---

## ✅ **The Solution:**

I added `flex items-center justify-center` to properly center the text both horizontally and vertically:

**After:**
```jsx
className={`p-6 border-2 rounded-xl font-semibold text-xl transition-all flex items-center justify-center ${...}`}
```

---

## 📐 **What These Classes Do:**

- `flex` - Makes the button a flex container
- `items-center` - Centers content vertically
- `justify-center` - Centers content horizontally

---

**Now all size buttons (S, M, L, XL, XXL) will have perfectly centered text!** 🎯

```javascriptreact
className={`p-6 border-2 rounded-xl font-semibold text-xl transition-all ${...}`}
```

```javascriptreact
className={`p-6 border-2 rounded-xl font-semibold text-xl transition-all flex items-center justify-center ${...}`}
```

```javascriptreact
'use client';

/**
 * ProductCard Component
 * Modern, responsive card component for displaying products
 */

import { useState } from 'react';
import Image from 'next/image';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useCart } from '@/context/CartContext';
import { useWishlist } from '@/context/WishlistContext';
import { useToast } from '@/context/ToastContext';

export default function ProductCard({ product }) {
  const { title, price, images, slug, inStock } = product;
  const image = images && images[0];
  const router = useRouter();
  const { addToCart } = useCart();
  const { toggleWishlist, isInWishlist } = useWishlist();
  const toast = useToast();
  const [isAddingToCart, setIsAddingToCart] = useState(false);
  const [isBuyingNow, setIsBuyingNow] = useState(false);
  
  const inWishlist = isInWishlist(product.id);

  return (
    <article 
      className="group bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-xl overflow-hidden hover:shadow-2xl transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1 flex flex-col h-full"
      aria-label={`${title} product card`}
    >
      {/* Product Image */}
      <div className="relative">
        <Link href={`/products/${slug}`} aria-label={`View ${title} details`}>
          <div className="relative aspect-square bg-gray-50 overflow-hidden cursor-pointer">
            {image ? (
              <Image
                src={image}
                alt={`${title} product image`}
                fill
                className="object-cover group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform duration-500"
              />
            ) : (
              <div className="w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center" role="img" aria-label="Product image placeholder">
                <svg
                  className="w-16 h-16 sm:w-20 sm:h-20 lg:w-24 lg:h-24 text-gray-300"
                  fill="none"
                  stroke="currentColor"
                  viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                  aria-hidden="true"
                >
                  <path
                    strokeLinecap="round"
                    strokeLinejoin="round"
                    strokeWidth={1}
                    d="M4 16l4.586-4.586a2 2 0 012.828 0L16 16m-2-2l1.586-1.586a2 2 0 012.828 0L20 14m-6-6h.01M6 20h12a2 2 0 002-2V6a2 2 0 00-2-2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v12a2 2 0 002 2z"
                  />
                </svg>
              </div>
            )}
            
            {/* Out of Stock Overlay */}
            {!inStock && (
              <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black bg-opacity-60 flex items-center justify-center" role="status">
                <span className="bg-white px-3 py-2 sm:px-4 sm:py-2 rounded-lg font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm">
                  OUT OF STOCK
                </span>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Hover Overlay */}
            <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black bg-opacity-0 group-hover:bg-opacity-10 transition-all duration-300 flex items-center justify-center">
              <span className="text-white font-bold text-sm sm:text-base opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transform translate-y-4 group-hover:translate-y-0 transition-all duration-300">
                View Details
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </Link>

        {/* Wishlist Heart Button */}
        <button
          onClick={(e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
            toggleWishlist(product);
            toast.success(inWishlist ? 'Removed from wishlist' : 'Added to wishlist!');
          }}
          className={`absolute top-3 right-3 z-10 w-9 h-9 sm:w-10 sm:h-10 flex items-center justify-center rounded-full transition-all duration-300 hover:scale-110 ${
            inWishlist
              ? 'bg-red-500 text-white border-none shadow-lg'
              : 'bg-white text-black border border-black hover:bg-gray-50'
          }`}
          aria-label={inWishlist ? 'Remove from wishlist' : 'Add to wishlist'}
        >
          {inWishlist ? (
            // Filled Heart
            <svg className="w-5 h-5" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 20 20">
              <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M3.172 5.172a4 4 0 015.656 0L10 6.343l1.172-1.171a4 4 0 115.656 5.656L10 17.657l-6.828-6.829a4 4 0 010-5.656z" clipRule="evenodd" />
            </svg>
          ) : (
            // Heart Outline
            <svg className="w-5 h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
              <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M4.318 6.318a4.5 4.5 0 000 6.364L12 20.364l7.682-7.682a4.5 4.5 0 00-6.364-6.364L12 7.636l-1.318-1.318a4.5 4.5 0 00-6.364 0z" />
            </svg>
          )}
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Product Info */}
      <div className="p-3 sm:p-4 lg:p-6 flex flex-col flex-1">
        <Link href={`/products/${slug}`}>
          <h3 className="text-sm sm:text-base lg:text-lg font-semibold mb-2 group-hover:text-gray-600 transition-colors cursor-pointer line-clamp-2">
            {title}
          </h3>
        </Link>
        <p className="text-lg sm:text-xl lg:text-2xl font-bold mb-3 sm:mb-4" aria-label={`Price: ${price.toFixed(2)} dollars`}>
          ${price.toFixed(2)}
        </p>
        
        {/* Spacer to push buttons to bottom */}
        <div className="flex-1"></div>
        
        {/* Action Buttons */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-auto">
          {/* Add to Cart Button - Icon Only */}
          <div className="relative group/tooltip">
            <button
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                if (!inStock || isAddingToCart) return;
                
                setIsAddingToCart(true);
                // Add with default size and color (first available)
                const defaultSize = product.sizes?.[0] || 'M';
                const defaultColor = product.colors?.[0]?.name || 'Black';
                
                addToCart(product, defaultSize, defaultColor, 1);
                toast.success('Added to cart!');
                
                setTimeout(() => setIsAddingToCart(false), 800);
              }}
              disabled={!inStock || isAddingToCart}
              className={`p-2.5 sm:p-3 rounded-lg transition-all duration-300 ${
                inStock && !isAddingToCart
                  ? 'bg-black text-white hover:bg-gray-800 hover:scale-110'
                  : 'bg-gray-300 text-gray-500 cursor-not-allowed'
              }`}
              aria-label="Add to cart"
            >
              {/* Shopping Cart + Icon */}
              {isAddingToCart ? (
                <svg className="w-5 h-5 sm:w-6 sm:h-6 animate-spin" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                  <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M4 4v5h.582m15.356 2A8.001 8.001 0 004.582 9m0 0H9m11 11v-5h-.581m0 0a8.003 8.003 0 01-15.357-2m15.357 2H15" />
                </svg>
              ) : (
                <svg className="w-5 h-5 sm:w-6 sm:h-6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                  <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M3 3h2l.4 2M7 13h10l4-8H5.4M7 13L5.4 5M7 13l-2.293 2.293c-.63.63-.184 1.707.707 1.707H17m0 0a2 2 0 100 4 2 2 0 000-4zm-8 2a2 2 0 11-4 0 2 2 0 014 0z" />
                  <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M12 6v6m3-3H9" />
                </svg>
              )}
            </button>
            {/* Tooltip */}
            <div className="absolute bottom-full left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 mb-2 px-3 py-1.5 bg-gray-900 text-white text-xs rounded-lg opacity-0 group-hover/tooltip:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-200 pointer-events-none whitespace-nowrap z-10">
              Add to Cart
              <div className="absolute top-full left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -mt-1 border-4 border-transparent border-t-gray-900"></div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Buy Button - Text */}
          <div className="relative group/tooltip flex-1">
            <button
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                if (!inStock || isBuyingNow) return;
                
                setIsBuyingNow(true);
                const defaultSize = product.sizes?.[0] || 'M';
                const defaultColor = product.colors?.[0]?.name || 'Black';
                
                addToCart(product, defaultSize, defaultColor, 1);
                toast.success('Added to cart! Taking you to cart...');
                
                setTimeout(() => {
                  router.push('/cart');
                }, 500);
              }}
              disabled={!inStock || isBuyingNow}
              className={`w-full py-2.5 sm:py-3 rounded-lg text-xs sm:text-sm font-medium transition-all duration-300 ${
                inStock && !isBuyingNow
                  ? 'bg-black text-white hover:bg-gray-800 hover:scale-[1.02]'
                  : 'bg-gray-300 text-gray-500 cursor-not-allowed'
              }`}
              aria-label="Buy now"
            >
              {isBuyingNow ? 'Adding...' : 'Buy'}
            </button>
            {/* Tooltip */}
            <div className="absolute bottom-full left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 mb-2 px-3 py-1.5 bg-gray-900 text-white text-xs rounded-lg opacity-0 group-hover/tooltip:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-200 pointer-events-none whitespace-nowrap z-10">
              Quick Checkout
              <div className="absolute top-full left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -mt-1 border-4 border-transparent border-t-gray-900"></div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* View Details Button - Icon Only */}
          <div className="relative group/tooltip">
            <Link
              href={`/products/${slug}`}
              className="block p-2.5 sm:p-3 bg-black text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-800 transition-all duration-300 hover:scale-110"
              aria-label="View details"
            >
              {/* Eye Icon */}
              <svg className="w-5 h-5 sm:w-6 sm:h-6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M15 12a3 3 0 11-6 0 3 3 0 016 0z" />
                <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M2.458 12C3.732 7.943 7.523 5 12 5c4.478 0 8.268 2.943 9.542 7-1.274 4.057-5.064 7-9.542 7-4.477 0-8.268-2.943-9.542-7z" />
              </svg>
            </Link>
            {/* Tooltip */}
            <div className="absolute bottom-full left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 mb-2 px-3 py-1.5 bg-gray-900 text-white text-xs rounded-lg opacity-0 group-hover/tooltip:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-200 pointer-events-none whitespace-nowrap z-10">
              View Details
              <div className="absolute top-full left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -mt-1 border-4 border-transparent border-t-gray-900"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </article>
  );
}
```

|--------|-----------------|-------------------|

| 💳 Buy | `2.5` (10px) | `3` (12px) |
| 👁️ View Details | `2.5` (10px) | `3` (12px) |

```javascriptreact
                  />

            {!inStock && (
```

```javascriptreact
import { useState } from 'react';
import Image from 'next/image';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useCart } from '@/context/CartContext';
import { useWishlist } from '@/context/WishlistContext';

export default function ProductCard({ product }) {
  const { title, price, images, slug, inStock } = product;
  const image = images && images[0];
  const router = useRouter();
  const { addToCart } = useCart();
  const { toggleWishlist, isInWishlist } = useWishlist();
  const [isAddingToCart, setIsAddingToCart] = useState(false);
  const [isBuyingNow, setIsBuyingNow] = useState(false);
  
  const inWishlist = isInWishlist(product.id);

  return (
    <article 
      className="group bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-xl overflow-hidden hover:shadow-2xl transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1 flex flex-col h-full"
      aria-label={`${title} product card`}
    >
      {/* Product Image */}
      <div className="relative">
        <Link href={`/products/${slug}`} aria-label={`View ${title} details`}>
          <div className="relative aspect-square bg-gray-50 overflow-hidden cursor-pointer">
            {image ? (
              <Image
                src={image}
                alt={`${title} product image`}
                fill
                className="object-cover group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform duration-500"
              />
            ) : (
              <div className="w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center" role="img" aria-label="Product image placeholder">
                <svg
                  className="w-16 h-16 sm:w-20 sm:h-20 lg:w-24 lg:h-24 text-gray-300"
                  fill="none"
                  stroke="currentColor"
                  viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                  aria-hidden="true"
                >
                  <path
                    strokeLinecap="round"
                    strokeLinejoin="round"
                    strokeWidth={1}
                    d="M4 16l4.586-4.586a2 2 0 012.828 0L16 16m-2-2l1.586-1.586a2 2 0 012.828 0L20 14m-6-6h.01M6 20h12a2 2 0 002-2V6a2 2 0 00-2-2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v12a2 2 0 002 2z"
                  />
                </svg>
              </div>
            )}
            
            {/* Out of Stock Overlay */}
            {!inStock && (
              <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black bg-opacity-60 flex items-center justify-center" role="status">
                <span className="bg-white px-3 py-2 sm:px-4 sm:py-2 rounded-lg font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm">
                  OUT OF STOCK
                </span>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Hover Overlay */}
            <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black bg-opacity-0 group-hover:bg-opacity-10 transition-all duration-300 flex items-center justify-center">
              <span className="text-white font-bold text-sm sm:text-base opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transform translate-y-4 group-hover:translate-y-0 transition-all duration-300">
                View Details
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </Link>

        {/* Wishlist Heart Button */}
        <button
          onClick={(e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
            toggleWishlist(product);
          }}
          className={`absolute top-3 right-3 z-10 w-9 h-9 sm:w-10 sm:h-10 flex items-center justify-center rounded-full transition-all duration-300 hover:scale-110 ${
            inWishlist
              ? 'bg-red-500 text-white border-none shadow-lg'
              : 'bg-white text-black border border-black hover:bg-gray-50'
          }`}
          aria-label={inWishlist ? 'Remove from wishlist' : 'Add to wishlist'}
        >
          {inWishlist ? (
            // Filled Heart
            <svg className="w-5 h-5" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 20 20">
              <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M3.172 5.172a4 4 0 015.656 0L10 6.343l1.172-1.171a4 4 0 115.656 5.656L10 17.657l-6.828-6.829a4 4 0 010-5.656z" clipRule="evenodd" />
            </svg>
          ) : (
            // Heart Outline
            <svg className="w-5 h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
              <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M4.318 6.318a4.5 4.5 0 000 6.364L12 20.364l7.682-7.682a4.5 4.5 0 00-6.364-6.364L12 7.636l-1.318-1.318a4.5 4.5 0 00-6.364 0z" />
            </svg>
          )}
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Product Info */}
      <div className="p-3 sm:p-4 lg:p-6 flex flex-col flex-1">
        <Link href={`/products/${slug}`}>
          <h3 className="text-sm sm:text-base lg:text-lg font-semibold mb-2 group-hover:text-gray-600 transition-colors cursor-pointer line-clamp-2">
            {title}
          </h3>
        </Link>
        <p className="text-lg sm:text-xl lg:text-2xl font-bold mb-3 sm:mb-4" aria-label={`Price: ${price.toFixed(2)} dollars`}>
          ${price.toFixed(2)}
        </p>
        
        {/* Spacer to push buttons to bottom */}
        <div className="flex-1"></div>
        
        {/* Action Buttons */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-auto">
          {/* Add to Cart Button - Icon Only */}
          <div className="relative group/tooltip">
            <button
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                if (!inStock || isAddingToCart) return;
                
                setIsAddingToCart(true);
                // Add with default size and color (first available)
                const defaultSize = product.sizes?.[0] || 'M';
                const defaultColor = product.colors?.[0]?.name || 'Black';
                
                addToCart(product, defaultSize, defaultColor, 1);
                
                setTimeout(() => setIsAddingToCart(false), 800);
              }}
              disabled={!inStock || isAddingToCart}
              className={`p-2.5 sm:p-3 rounded-lg transition-all duration-300 ${
                inStock && !isAddingToCart
                  ? 'bg-black text-white hover:bg-gray-800 hover:scale-110'
                  : 'bg-gray-300 text-gray-500 cursor-not-allowed'
              }`}
              aria-label="Add to cart"
            >
              {/* Shopping Cart + Icon */}
              {isAddingToCart ? (
                <svg className="w-5 h-5 sm:w-6 sm:h-6 animate-spin" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                  <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M4 4v5h.582m15.356 2A8.001 8.001 0 004.582 9m0 0H9m11 11v-5h-.581m0 0a8.003 8.003 0 01-15.357-2m15.357 2H15" />
                </svg>
              ) : (
                <svg className="w-5 h-5 sm:w-6 sm:h-6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                  <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M3 3h2l.4 2M7 13h10l4-8H5.4M7 13L5.4 5M7 13l-2.293 2.293c-.63.63-.184 1.707.707 1.707H17m0 0a2 2 0 100 4 2 2 0 000-4zm-8 2a2 2 0 11-4 0 2 2 0 014 0z" />
                  <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M12 6v6m3-3H9" />
                </svg>
              )}
            </button>
            {/* Tooltip */}
            <div className="absolute bottom-full left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 mb-2 px-3 py-1.5 bg-gray-900 text-white text-xs rounded-lg opacity-0 group-hover/tooltip:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-200 pointer-events-none whitespace-nowrap z-10">
              Add to Cart
              <div className="absolute top-full left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -mt-1 border-4 border-transparent border-t-gray-900"></div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Buy Now Button - Text */}
          <div className="relative group/tooltip flex-1">
            <button
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                if (!inStock || isBuyingNow) return;
                
                setIsBuyingNow(true);
                const defaultSize = product.sizes?.[0] || 'M';
                const defaultColor = product.colors?.[0]?.name || 'Black';
                
                addToCart(product, defaultSize, defaultColor, 1);
                
                setTimeout(() => {
                  router.push('/cart');
                }, 500);
              }}
              disabled={!inStock || isBuyingNow}
              className={`w-full py-2.5 sm:py-3 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium transition-all duration-300 ${
                inStock && !isBuyingNow
                  ? 'bg-black text-white hover:bg-gray-800 hover:scale-[1.02]'
                  : 'bg-gray-300 text-gray-500 cursor-not-allowed'
              }`}
              aria-label="Buy now"
            >
              {isBuyingNow ? 'Adding...' : 'Buy Now'}
            </button>
            {/* Tooltip */}
            <div className="absolute bottom-full left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 mb-2 px-3 py-1.5 bg-gray-900 text-white text-xs rounded-lg opacity-0 group-hover/tooltip:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-200 pointer-events-none whitespace-nowrap z-10">
              Quick Checkout
              <div className="absolute top-full left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -mt-1 border-4 border-transparent border-t-gray-900"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </article>
  );
}
```

```javascriptreact
'use client';

/**
 * Hero Component
 * Modern premium hero section with animations and high-quality design
 */

import Link from 'next/link';
import Image from 'next/image';
import { useEffect, useState, useRef, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useCart } from '@/context/CartContext';

// Featured Product - Define OUTSIDE component to prevent recreation
const FEATURED_PRODUCT = {
  id: 'hero-featured',
  title: 'Premium T-Shirt Collection',
  price: 129, // 129 DH
  images: ['/images/hero-product.png'],
  slug: 'featured-tshirt',
  category: 'tshirts',
  inStock: true,
  sizes: ['S', 'M', 'L', 'XL', 'XXL'],
  colors: [
    { name: 'Black', hex: '#000000' },
    { name: 'White', hex: '#FFFFFF' },
  ],
};

export default function Hero() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { addToCart } = useCart();
  const toast = useToast();
  
  const [isVisible, setIsVisible] = useState(false);
  const [isAddingToCart, setIsAddingToCart] = useState(false);
  const isProcessingRef = useRef(false); // Use ref for immediate check
  const [timeLeft, setTimeLeft] = useState({
    days: 0,
    hours: 0,
    minutes: 0,
    seconds: 0
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    setIsVisible(true);
    // Reset processing state when component mounts
    isProcessingRef.current = false;
    setIsAddingToCart(false);
  }, []);

  // Countdown Timer
  useEffect(() => {
    const endDate = new Date('2025-11-23T17:00:00'); // 11/23/2025 5pm

    const calculateTimeLeft = () => {
      const now = new Date();
      const difference = endDate - now;

      if (difference > 0) {
        return {
          days: Math.floor(difference / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)),
          hours: Math.floor((difference / (1000 * 60 * 60)) % 24),
          minutes: Math.floor((difference / 1000 / 60) % 60),
          seconds: Math.floor((difference / 1000) % 60)
        };
      }
      return { days: 0, hours: 0, minutes: 0, seconds: 0 };
    };

    setTimeLeft(calculateTimeLeft());

    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      setTimeLeft(calculateTimeLeft());
    }, 1000);

    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, []);

  return (
    <section className="relative bg-white overflow-hidden">
      {/* Background Decorative Elements */}
      <div className="absolute inset-0 overflow-hidden pointer-events-none">
        <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-96 h-96 bg-gray-50 rounded-full -translate-y-1/2 translate-x-1/2"></div>
        <div className="absolute bottom-0 left-0 w-64 h-64 bg-gray-50 rounded-full translate-y-1/2 -translate-x-1/2"></div>
      </div>

      <div className="relative max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-16 sm:py-20 lg:py-6">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-12 lg:gap-16 items-center">
          {/* Left Content */}
          <div 
            className={`space-y-6 sm:space-y-8 transition-all duration-1000 ${
              isVisible ? 'opacity-100 translate-y-0' : 'opacity-0 translate-y-10'
            }`}
          >
            {/* Headline */}
            <h1 className="text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl xl:text-8xl font-bold leading-none tracking-tight">
              <span className="block">Premium</span>
              <span className="block">Style.</span>
              <span className="block text-gray-400">Your Design.</span>
            </h1>

            {/* Description */}
            <p className="text-lg sm:text-xl lg:text-2xl text-gray-600 leading-relaxed max-w-xl">
              Discover our exclusive collection of premium clothing or create your own custom designs with our Print-On-Demand service.
            </p>

            {/* CTAs */}
            <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-4 pt-4">
              <Link 
                href="/products" 
                className="group relative inline-flex items-center justify-center px-8 py-4 text-lg font-bold text-white bg-black rounded-xl overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300 hover:scale-105 hover:shadow-2xl"
              >
                <span className="relative z-10">Shop Now</span>
                <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-gray-900 to-black opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity"></div>
              </Link>
              
              <Link 
                href="/pod" 
                className="group relative inline-flex items-center justify-center px-8 py-4 text-lg font-bold text-black bg-white border-2 border-black rounded-xl overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300 hover:scale-105 hover:shadow-2xl hover:text-white"
              >
                <span className="relative z-10 flex items-center">
                  Print-On-Demand
                  <svg 
                    className="ml-2 w-5 h-5 transition-transform group-hover:translate-x-1" 
                    fill="none" 
                    stroke="currentColor" 
                    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                  >
                    <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M17 8l4 4m0 0l-4 4m4-4H3" />
                  </svg>
                </span>
                <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity"></div>
              </Link>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Right Content - Product Showcase */}
          <div 
            className={`relative transition-all duration-1000 delay-300 ${
              isVisible ? 'opacity-100 translate-y-0' : 'opacity-0 translate-y-10'
            }`}
          >
            <div className="relative">
              {/* Main Product Showcase */}
              <div className="relative group">
                {/* Product Image Container */}
                <div className="relative aspect-square bg-white rounded-3xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl border-4 border-gray-100 transition-transform duration-500 group-hover:scale-[1.02]">
                  <Image
                    src="/images/hero-product.png"
                    alt="Premium Cobra Wear T-Shirts"
                    fill
                    className="object-cover"
                    priority
                  />
                  
                  {/* Red Promo Badge - Top Left with Rotation */}
                  <div className="absolute top-8 left-0 z-10">
                    <div 
                      className="bg-red-600 text-white px-6 py-3 rounded-full shadow-2xl font-bold text-base sm:text-lg animate-pulse"
                      style={{ transform: 'rotate(-45deg)' }}
                    >
                      50% OFF
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Price Tag with Countdown - Bottom */}
                  <div className="absolute bottom-6 left-6 right-6 z-10">
                    <div className="bg-black/90 backdrop-blur-sm text-white px-4 sm:px-6 py-4 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl">
                      {/* Countdown Timer */}
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 sm:gap-4 mb-3">
                        <div className="text-center">
                          <div className="bg-white/20 backdrop-blur-sm px-2 sm:px-3 py-1 sm:py-2 rounded-lg min-w-[40px] sm:min-w-[50px]">
                            <span className="text-base sm:text-xl font-bold">{timeLeft.days}</span>
                          </div>
                          <p className="text-[10px] sm:text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1">Days</p>
                        </div>
                        <span className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold">:</span>
                        <div className="text-center">
                          <div className="bg-white/20 backdrop-blur-sm px-2 sm:px-3 py-1 sm:py-2 rounded-lg min-w-[40px] sm:min-w-[50px]">
                            <span className="text-base sm:text-xl font-bold">{String(timeLeft.hours).padStart(2, '0')}</span>
                          </div>
                          <p className="text-[10px] sm:text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1">Hours</p>
                        </div>
                        <span className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold">:</span>
                        <div className="text-center">
                          <div className="bg-white/20 backdrop-blur-sm px-2 sm:px-3 py-1 sm:py-2 rounded-lg min-w-[40px] sm:min-w-[50px]">
                            <span className="text-base sm:text-xl font-bold">{String(timeLeft.minutes).padStart(2, '0')}</span>
                          </div>
                          <p className="text-[10px] sm:text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1">Mins</p>
                        </div>
                        <span className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold">:</span>
                        <div className="text-center">
                          <div className="bg-white/20 backdrop-blur-sm px-2 sm:px-3 py-1 sm:py-2 rounded-lg min-w-[40px] sm:min-w-[50px]">
                            <span className="text-base sm:text-xl font-bold">{String(timeLeft.seconds).padStart(2, '0')}</span>
                          </div>
                          <p className="text-[10px] sm:text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1">Secs</p>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {/* Price Display */}
                      <div className="border-t border-white/20 pt-3 space-y-3">
                        {/* Prices */}
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 sm:gap-3">
                            <span className="text-base sm:text-lg lg:text-xl line-through text-gray-400 font-medium">258 DH</span>
                            <span className="text-xl sm:text-2xl lg:text-3xl font-bold text-white">129 DH</span>
                          </div>
                          <div className="bg-yellow-400 px-3 sm:px-4 py-1.5 sm:py-2 rounded-full shadow-lg animate-bounce-slow">
                            <span className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold text-black">SAVE 129 DH</span>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        
                        {/* Buy Now Button - Add to Cart */}
                        <button 
                          onClick={(e) => {
                            e.preventDefault();
                            e.stopPropagation();
                            
                            // Simple double-click prevention
                            if (isProcessingRef.current) {
                              return;
                            }
                            
                            isProcessingRef.current = true;
                            setIsAddingToCart(true);
                            
                            console.log('Adding to cart - quantity: 1');
                            
                            // Add product to cart (CartContext handles deduplication)
                            addToCart(FEATURED_PRODUCT, 'M', 'Black', 1);
                            
                            // Show success message and navigate
                            toast.success('Added to cart! Taking you to cart...');
                            
                            setTimeout(() => {
                              router.push('/cart');
                              // Reset after navigation
                              setTimeout(() => {
                                isProcessingRef.current = false;
                                setIsAddingToCart(false);
                              }, 300);
                            }, 500);
                          }}
                          disabled={isAddingToCart}
                          className={`w-full text-center py-3 sm:py-4 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm sm:text-base transition-all duration-300 shadow-lg ${
                            isAddingToCart 
                              ? 'bg-gray-300 text-gray-600 cursor-not-allowed' 
                              : 'bg-green-400 text-black hover:bg-green-500 hover:scale-[1.03] cursor-pointer'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {isAddingToCart ? 'Adding...' : 'Buy Now 🛒'}
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Gradient Overlay for better text visibility */}
                  <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/20 via-transparent to-transparent pointer-events-none"></div>
                </div>

                {/* Floating Decorative Elements */}
                <div className="absolute -top-4 -left-4 w-20 h-20 bg-red-600 rounded-full opacity-20 blur-2xl animate-float"></div>
                <div className="absolute -bottom-4 -right-4 w-16 h-16 border-4 border-black rounded-full animate-float-delayed"></div>
                
                {/* Corner Accent */}
                <div className="absolute top-0 left-0 w-24 h-24 border-t-4 border-l-4 border-black rounded-tl-3xl -translate-x-2 -translate-y-2 opacity-30"></div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Bottom Wave Divider */}
      <div className="absolute bottom-0 left-0 right-0">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 1440 48" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" className="w-full">
          <path d="M0 48h1440V0c-240 48-480 48-720 24C480 0 240 0 0 24v24z" fill="#fafafa"/>
        </svg>
      </div>

      {/* Trust Badges Section */}
      <div className="bg-gray-50 border-t border-gray-200">
        <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8 sm:py-12">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-3 sm:gap-4">
            <div className="inline-flex items-center space-x-2 bg-black text-white px-4 sm:px-5 py-2.5 sm:py-3 rounded-full text-sm sm:text-base font-medium shadow-lg hover:scale-105 transition-transform">
              <span>⭐</span>
              <span>4.9/5 Rating</span>
            </div>

            <div className="inline-flex items-center space-x-2 bg-black text-white px-4 sm:px-5 py-2.5 sm:py-3 rounded-full text-sm sm:text-base font-medium shadow-lg hover:scale-105 transition-transform">
              <svg className="w-4 h-4 sm:w-5 sm:h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M5 13l4 4L19 7" />
              </svg>
              <span>Free Shipping</span>
            </div>

            <div className="inline-flex items-center space-x-2 bg-black text-white px-4 sm:px-5 py-2.5 sm:py-3 rounded-full text-sm sm:text-base font-medium shadow-lg hover:scale-105 transition-transform">
              <svg className="w-4 h-4 sm:w-5 sm:h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M12 8v4l3 3m6-3a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z" />
              </svg>
              <span>Fast Delivery</span>
            </div>

            <div className="inline-flex items-center space-x-2 bg-black text-white px-4 sm:px-5 py-2.5 sm:py-3 rounded-full text-sm sm:text-base font-medium shadow-lg hover:scale-105 transition-transform">
              <span className="w-2 h-2 bg-white rounded-full animate-pulse"></span>
              <span>Premium Quality</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Categories Section */}
      <div className="bg-gray-50 border-b border-gray-200">
        <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-16 sm:py-20">
          <h2 className="text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-bold text-center mb-12">
            Shop by Category
          </h2>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-5 gap-4 sm:gap-6 mb-16">
            {[
              { name: 'T-Shirts', emoji: '👕', category: 'tshirts' },
              { name: 'Hoodies', emoji: '🧥', category: 'hoodies' },
              { name: 'Shorts', emoji: '🩳', category: 'shorts' },
              { name: 'Caps', emoji: '🧢', category: 'caps' },
              { name: 'Tote Bags', emoji: '👜', category: 'bags' }
            ].map((category) => (
              <Link
                key={category.name}
                href={`/products?category=${category.category}`}
                className="group bg-white p-6 sm:p-8 rounded-2xl text-center hover:shadow-xl transition-all duration-300 border border-gray-200 hover:scale-105 hover:-translate-y-1"
              >
                <div className="text-4xl sm:text-5xl mb-3 transition-transform group-hover:scale-110">{category.emoji}</div>
                <h3 className="font-semibold text-sm sm:text-base group-hover:text-gray-600 transition-colors">{category.name}</h3>
              </Link>
            ))}
          </div>

          <h2 className="text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-bold text-center mb-12 mt-16 sm:mt-20">
            Shop by Style
          </h2>
```

```javascriptreact
                          <p className="text-[10px] sm:text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1">Days</p>
                        </div>
                        <span className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold">:</span>
                        <div className="text-center">
                          <div className="bg-white/20 backdrop-blur-sm px-2 sm:px-3 py-1 sm:py-2 rounded-lg min-w-[40px] sm:min-w-[50px]">
                            <span className="text-base sm:text-xl font-bold">{String(timeLeft.hours).padStart(2, '0')}</span>
                          </div>
                          <p className="text-[10px] sm:text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1">Hours</p>
                        </div>
                        <span className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold">:</span>
                        <div className="text-center">
                          <div className="bg-white/20 backdrop-blur-sm px-2 sm:px-3 py-1 sm:py-2 rounded-lg min-w-[40px] sm:min-w-[50px]">
                            <span className="text-base sm:text-xl font-bold">{String(timeLeft.minutes).padStart(2, '0')}</span>
                          </div>
                          <p className="text-[10px] sm:text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1">Mins</p>
                        </div>
                        <span className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold">:</span>
                        <div className="text-center">
                          <div className="bg-white/20 backdrop-blur-sm px-2 sm:px-3 py-1 sm:py-2 rounded-lg min-w-[40px] sm:min-w-[50px]">
                            <span className="text-base sm:text-xl font-bold">{String(timeLeft.seconds).padStart(2, '0')}</span>
                          </div>
                          <p className="text-[10px] sm:text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1">Secs</p>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {/* Price Display */}
                      <div className="border-t border-white/20 pt-3 space-y-3">
                        {/* Prices */}
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 sm:gap-3">
                            <span className="text-base sm:text-lg lg:text-xl line-through text-gray-400 font-medium">258 DH</span>
                            <span className="text-xl sm:text-2xl lg:text-3xl font-bold text-white">129 DH</span>
                          </div>
                          <div className="bg-yellow-400 px-3 sm:px-4 py-1.5 sm:py-2 rounded-full shadow-lg animate-bounce-slow">
                            <span className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold text-black">SAVE 129 DH</span>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        
                        {/* Buy Now Button - Add to Cart */}
                        <button 
                          onClick={(e) => {
                            e.preventDefault();
                            e.stopPropagation();
                            
                            // Simple double-click prevention
                            if (isProcessingRef.current) {
                              return;
                            }
                            
                            isProcessingRef.current = true;
                            setIsAddingToCart(true);
                            
                            console.log('Adding to cart - quantity: 1');
                            
                            // Add product to cart (CartContext handles deduplication)
                            addToCart(FEATURED_PRODUCT, 'M', 'Black', 1);
                            
                            // Navigate to cart
                            setTimeout(() => {
                              router.push('/cart');
                              // Reset after navigation
                              setTimeout(() => {
                                isProcessingRef.current = false;
                                setIsAddingToCart(false);
                              }, 300);
                            }, 500);
                          }}
                          disabled={isAddingToCart}
                          className={`w-full text-center py-3 sm:py-4 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm sm:text-base transition-all duration-300 shadow-lg ${
                            isAddingToCart 
                              ? 'bg-gray-300 text-gray-600 cursor-not-allowed' 
                              : 'bg-green-400 text-black hover:bg-green-500 hover:scale-[1.03] cursor-pointer'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {isAddingToCart ? 'Adding...' : 'Buy Now 🛒'}
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Gradient Overlay for better text visibility */}
                  <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/20 via-transparent to-transparent pointer-events-none"></div>
                </div>

                {/* Floating Decorative Elements */}
                <div className="absolute -top-4 -left-4 w-20 h-20 bg-red-600 rounded-full opacity-20 blur-2xl animate-float"></div>
                <div className="absolute -bottom-4 -right-4 w-16 h-16 border-4 border-black rounded-full animate-float-delayed"></div>
                
                {/* Corner Accent */}
                <div className="absolute top-0 left-0 w-24 h-24 border-t-4 border-l-4 border-black rounded-tl-3xl -translate-x-2 -translate-y-2 opacity-30"></div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Bottom Wave Divider */}
      <div className="absolute bottom-0 left-0 right-0">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 1440 48" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" className="w-full">
          <path d="M0 48h1440V0c-240 48-480 48-720 24C480 0 240 0 0 24v24z" fill="#fafafa"/>
        </svg>
      </div>

      {/* Trust Badges Section */}
      <div className="bg-gray-50 border-t border-gray-200">
        <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8 sm:py-12">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-3 sm:gap-4">
            <div className="inline-flex items-center space-x-2 bg-black text-white px-4 sm:px-5 py-2.5 sm:py-3 rounded-full text-sm sm:text-base font-medium shadow-lg hover:scale-105 transition-transform">
              <span>⭐</span>
              <span>4.9/5 Rating</span>
            </div>

            <div className="inline-flex items-center space-x-2 bg-black text-white px-4 sm:px-5 py-2.5 sm:py-3 rounded-full text-sm sm:text-base font-medium shadow-lg hover:scale-105 transition-transform">
              <svg className="w-4 h-4 sm:w-5 sm:h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M5 13l4 4L19 7" />
              </svg>
              <span>Free Shipping</span>
            </div>

            <div className="inline-flex items-center space-x-2 bg-black text-white px-4 sm:px-5 py-2.5 sm:py-3 rounded-full text-sm sm:text-base font-medium shadow-lg hover:scale-105 transition-transform">
              <svg className="w-4 h-4 sm:w-5 sm:h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M12 8v4l3 3m6-3a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z" />
              </svg>
              <span>Fast Delivery</span>
            </div>

            <div className="inline-flex items-center space-x-2 bg-black text-white px-4 sm:px-5 py-2.5 sm:py-3 rounded-full text-sm sm:text-base font-medium shadow-lg hover:scale-105 transition-transform">
              <span className="w-2 h-2 bg-white rounded-full animate-pulse"></span>
              <span>Premium Quality</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Categories Section */}
      <div className="bg-gray-50 border-b border-gray-200">
        <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-16 sm:py-20">
          <h2 className="text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-bold text-center mb-12">
            Shop by Category
          </h2>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-5 gap-4 sm:gap-6 mb-16">
            {[
              { name: 'T-Shirts', emoji: '👕', category: 'tshirts' },
              { name: 'Hoodies', emoji: '🧥', category: 'hoodies' },
              { name: 'Shorts', emoji: '🩳', category: 'shorts' },

              { name: 'Tote Bags', emoji: '👜', category: 'bags' }

              <Link

              </Link>
            ))}
          </div>

          <h2 className="text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-bold text-center mb-12 mt-16 sm:mt-20">
            Shop by Style
          </h2>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4 sm:gap-6">
            {[
              { name: 'Anime', emoji: '🎌', desc: 'Japanese inspired', style: 'anime' },
              { name: 'Gang', emoji: '🔥', desc: 'Street style', style: 'gang' },
              { name: 'Gaming', emoji: '🎮', desc: 'Gamer vibes', style: 'gaming' },
              { name: 'Classic', emoji: '⭐', desc: 'Timeless pieces', style: 'classic' }
            ].map((style) => (

                <h3 className="font-semibold text-sm sm:text-base mb-2 group-hover:text-gray-600 transition-colors">{style.name}</h3>

              </Link>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
```
