```javascriptreact
'use client';

/**
 * Improved POD Upload Form Component
 * Enhanced Print-On-Demand workflow with:
 * - Product icons and better UI
 * - Multi-file upload system
 * - Smart size/color logic per product
 * - Phone model selector
 * - Drag-and-drop upload
 * - Image validation
 * - Better step flow
 */

import { useState } from 'react';
import { uploadToCloudinary } from '@/lib/cloudinary';
import { sendOrderEmail } from '@/lib/emailjs';
import { sendCustomerPODConfirmation } from '@/lib/customer-email';
import { validateForm, commonRules } from '@/lib/validation';
import { trackPODSubmission } from '@/lib/analytics';
import { POD_PRODUCTS, getProductById, getUploadAreas, getRequiredUploadAreas } from '@/lib/pod-products';
import { ProductIconLarge, ProductIconSmall } from '@/components/ProductIcons';
import MultiFileUpload from '@/components/MultiFileUpload';

export default function ImprovedPodUploadForm() {

  // Form state
  const [step, setStep] = useState(1);
  const [selectedProduct, setSelectedProduct] = useState(null);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    productType: '',
    size: '',
    phoneModel: '',
    color: '',
    designs: {},
    designUrls: {},
    customerName: '',
    customerEmail: '',
    customerPhone: '',
    customerAddress: '',
    notes: '',
  });

  // UI state
  const [uploadedFiles, setUploadedFiles] = useState({});
  const [isUploading, setIsUploading] = useState(false);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [uploadError, setUploadError] = useState('');
  const [submitSuccess, setSubmitSuccess] = useState(false);
  const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState({});

  // Get current product config
  const currentProduct = selectedProduct ? getProductById(selectedProduct) : null;
  const uploadAreas = currentProduct ? getUploadAreas(selectedProduct) : [];
  const requiredAreas = currentProduct ? getRequiredUploadAreas(selectedProduct) : [];

  // Handle product selection
  const handleProductSelect = (productId) => {
    const product = getProductById(productId);
    setSelectedProduct(productId);
    setFormData((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      productType: product.name,
      size: product.requiresSize ? product.sizes[0] : '',
      color: product.colors[0],
      phoneModel: product.requiresPhoneModel ? product.phoneModels[0] : '',
    }));
    setStep(2);
  };

  // Handle form field changes
  const handleChange = (field, value) => {
    setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, [field]: value }));
    if (fieldErrors[field]) {
      setFieldErrors((prev) => {
        const newErrors = { ...prev };
        delete newErrors[field];
        return newErrors;
      });
    }
  };

  // Handle files change from MultiFileUpload
  const handleFilesChange = (files) => {
    setUploadedFiles(files);
    setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, designs: files }));
  };

  // Upload all designs to Cloudinary
  const handleUploadDesigns = async () => {
    // Check if required files are uploaded
    const missingRequired = requiredAreas.filter((area) => !uploadedFiles[area.id]);
    if (missingRequired.length > 0) {
      setUploadError(`Please upload required designs: ${missingRequired.map((a) => a.name).join(', ')}`);
      return;
    }

    setIsUploading(true);
    setUploadError('');

    try {
      const uploadPromises = Object.entries(uploadedFiles).map(async ([areaId, file]) => {
        const result = await uploadToCloudinary(file);
        return [areaId, result.url];
      });

      const uploadResults = await Promise.all(uploadPromises);
      const designUrls = Object.fromEntries(uploadResults);

      setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, designUrls }));
      setStep(step + 1);
    } catch (error) {
      setUploadError('Failed to upload designs. Please try again.');
      console.error('Upload error:', error);
    } finally {
      setIsUploading(false);
    }
  };

  // Submit order
  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setFieldErrors({});

    // Validate form
    const validation = validateForm(formData, commonRules);
    if (!validation.isValid) {
      setFieldErrors(validation.errors);
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);

    try {
      // Prepare order data
      const orderData = {
        ...formData,
        // Keep designUrls object for proper email formatting
        // designUrl will be generated in emailjs.js from designUrls
      };

      // Send order email to business
      await sendOrderEmail(orderData);

      // Send confirmation email to customer (non-blocking)
      sendCustomerPODConfirmation(orderData).catch((err) => {
        console.error('Failed to send customer confirmation:', err);
      });

      // Track POD submission in analytics
      trackPODSubmission(formData.productType);

      setSubmitSuccess(true);
      setStep(7); // Success screen
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Submit error:', error);
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  // Reset form
  const resetForm = () => {
    setStep(1);
    setSelectedProduct(null);
    setFormData({
      productType: '',
      size: '',
      phoneModel: '',
      color: '',
      designs: {},
      designUrls: {},
      customerName: '',
      customerEmail: '',
      customerPhone: '',
      customerAddress: '',
      notes: '',
    });
    setUploadedFiles({});
    setSubmitSuccess(false);
  };

  const stepLabels = ['Product', 'Color', 'Size', 'Design', 'Preview', 'Details'];

  return (
    <div className="max-w-6xl mx-auto">
      {/* Progress Steps - Compact Mobile Design */}
      <div className="mb-8 sm:mb-12">
        {/* Mobile: Current Step Indicator */}
        <div className="block sm:hidden mb-4">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
            <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900">
              Step {step} of 6
            </span>
            <span className="text-xs text-gray-500 font-medium">
              {stepLabels[step - 1]}
            </span>
          </div>
          {/* Progress Bar */}
          <div className="w-full bg-gray-200 rounded-full h-2">
            <div
              className="bg-black h-2 rounded-full transition-all duration-300"
              style={{ width: `${(step / 6) * 100}%` }}
            ></div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Desktop: Full Stepper */}
        <div className="hidden sm:block">
          <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
            {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6].map((stepNum) => (
              <div key={stepNum} className="flex items-center">
                <div
                  className={`w-10 h-10 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-bold border-2 transition-all ${
                    step >= stepNum
                      ? 'bg-black text-white border-black'
                      : 'bg-white text-gray-400 border-gray-300'
                  }`}
                >
                  {stepNum}
                </div>
                {stepNum < 6 && (
                  <div
                    className={`w-8 lg:w-16 h-1 mx-1 lg:mx-2 transition-all ${
                      step > stepNum ? 'bg-black' : 'bg-gray-300'
                    }`}
                  ></div>
                )}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
          <div className="flex justify-between mt-3 text-xs text-gray-600 font-medium">
            {stepLabels.map((label, index) => (
              <span key={index} className="text-center" style={{ width: '40px' }}>
                {label}
              </span>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Step Content */}
      <div className="bg-white border-2 border-gray-200 rounded-2xl p-8 shadow-sm">
        {/* Step 1: Product Selection */}
        {step === 1 && (
          <div className="space-y-6">
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-2">Choose Your Product</h2>
              <p className="text-gray-600">Select the product you want to customize</p>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
              {POD_PRODUCTS.map((product) => (
                <button
                  key={product.id}
                  onClick={() => handleProductSelect(product.id)}
                  className="group relative border-2 border-gray-200 rounded-xl p-6 hover:border-black hover:shadow-lg transition-all"
                >
                  {product.recommended && (
                    <div className="absolute top-2 right-2 bg-black text-white text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded-full font-semibold">
                      Recommended
                    </div>
                  )}
                  <ProductIconLarge type={product.icon} className="mx-auto mb-4" />
                  <h3 className="font-semibold text-center">{product.name}</h3>
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Step 2: Color Selection */}
        {step === 2 && currentProduct && (
          <div className="space-y-6">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-4 mb-6">
              <button
                onClick={() => setStep(1)}
                className="text-gray-600 hover:text-black flex items-center gap-2"
              >
                ← Back
              </button>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <ProductIconSmall type={currentProduct.icon} />
                <span className="font-semibold">{currentProduct.name}</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div>
              <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-2">Choose Color</h2>
              <p className="text-gray-600">Select your preferred color</p>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-5 gap-4">
              {currentProduct.colors.map((color) => (
                <button
                  key={color}
                  onClick={() => {
                    handleChange('color', color);
                    setStep(3);
                  }}
                  className={`p-6 border-2 rounded-xl font-semibold transition-all flex flex-col items-center gap-3 ${
                    formData.color === color
                      ? 'border-black bg-black text-white'
                      : 'border-gray-200 hover:border-black'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div
                    className={`w-16 h-16 rounded-full border-2 ${
                      color === 'White' || color === 'Natural' || color === 'Beige' || color === 'Clear'
                        ? 'border-gray-300'
                        : 'border-transparent'
                    }`}
                    style={{
                      backgroundColor:
                        color === 'Black'
                          ? '#000000'
                          : color === 'White'
                          ? '#FFFFFF'
                          : color === 'Grey' || color === 'Gray'
                          ? '#9CA3AF'
                          : color === 'Navy'
                          ? '#1E3A8A'
                          : color === 'Beige'
                          ? '#F5F5DC'
                          : color === 'Burgundy'
                          ? '#800020'
                          : color === 'Olive'
                          ? '#808000'
                          : color === 'Natural'
                          ? '#F5F5DC'
                          : color === 'Clear'
                          ? 'transparent'
                          : '#CCCCCC',
                    }}
                  ></div>
                  <span>{color}</span>
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Step 3: Size / Phone Model Selection */}
        {step === 3 && currentProduct && (
          <div className="space-y-6">
            <button
              onClick={() => setStep(2)}
              className="text-gray-600 hover:text-black flex items-center gap-2 mb-6"
            >
              ← Back
            </button>

            {currentProduct.requiresSize && (
              <div>
                <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-2">Choose Size</h2>
                <p className="text-gray-600">Select your size</p>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-5 gap-4 mt-6">
                  {currentProduct.sizes.map((size) => (
                    <button
                      key={size}
                      onClick={() => {
                        handleChange('size', size);
                        setStep(4);
                      }}
                      className={`p-6 border-2 rounded-xl font-semibold text-xl transition-all flex items-center justify-center ${
                        formData.size === size
                          ? 'border-black bg-black text-white'
                          : 'border-gray-200 hover:border-black'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {size}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {currentProduct.requiresPhoneModel && (
              <div>
                <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-2">Choose Phone Model</h2>
                <p className="text-gray-600">Select your device</p>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4 mt-6">
                  {currentProduct.phoneModels.map((model) => (
                    <button
                      key={model}
                      onClick={() => {
                        handleChange('phoneModel', model);
                        setStep(4);
                      }}
                      className={`p-4 border-2 rounded-xl font-medium transition-all text-left ${
                        formData.phoneModel === model
                          ? 'border-black bg-black text-white'
                          : 'border-gray-200 hover:border-black'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {model}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {!currentProduct.requiresSize && !currentProduct.requiresPhoneModel && (
              <div>
                <p className="text-center text-gray-600 mb-6">This product doesn't require size selection</p>
                <button
                  onClick={() => setStep(4)}
                  className="w-full btn-primary"
                >
                  Continue to Design Upload
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Step 4: Upload Designs */}
        {step === 4 && currentProduct && (
          <div className="space-y-6">
            <button
              onClick={() => setStep(3)}
              className="text-gray-600 hover:text-black flex items-center gap-2 mb-6"
            >
              ← Back
            </button>

            <div>
              <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-2">Upload Your Designs</h2>
              <p className="text-gray-600">
                Upload your design files for each placement area
              </p>
            </div>

            <MultiFileUpload
              uploadAreas={uploadAreas}
              onFilesChange={handleFilesChange}
              disabled={isUploading}
            />

            {uploadError && (
              <div className="p-4 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 rounded-lg text-red-600">
                {uploadError}
              </div>
            )}

            <button
              onClick={handleUploadDesigns}
              disabled={isUploading || Object.keys(uploadedFiles).length === 0}
              className="w-full btn-primary disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
            >
              {isUploading ? 'Uploading Designs...' : 'Continue to Preview'}
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Step 5: Preview */}
        {step === 5 && currentProduct && (
          <div className="space-y-6">
            <button
              onClick={() => setStep(4)}
              className="text-gray-600 hover:text-black flex items-center gap-2 mb-6"
            >
              ← Back
            </button>

            <div>
              <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-2">Preview Your Design</h2>
              <p className="text-gray-600">Review your customization before checkout</p>
            </div>

            {/* Order Summary */}
            <div className="bg-gray-50 p-6 rounded-xl border border-gray-200">
              <h3 className="font-bold text-xl mb-4">Order Summary</h3>
              <div className="space-y-3">
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span className="text-gray-600">Product:</span>
                  <span className="font-semibold">{formData.productType}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span className="text-gray-600">Color:</span>
                  <span className="font-semibold">{formData.color}</span>
                </div>
                {formData.size && (
                  <div className="flex justify-between">
                    <span className="text-gray-600">Size:</span>
                    <span className="font-semibold">{formData.size}</span>
                  </div>
                )}
                {formData.phoneModel && (
                  <div className="flex justify-between">
                    <span className="text-gray-600">Phone Model:</span>
                    <span className="font-semibold">{formData.phoneModel}</span>
                  </div>
                )}
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span className="text-gray-600">Design Areas:</span>
                  <span className="font-semibold">{Object.keys(formData.designUrls).length}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between pt-3 border-t border-gray-300">
                  <span className="text-gray-600">Payment:</span>
                  <span className="font-semibold">Cash on Delivery</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Design Previews */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              {Object.entries(formData.designUrls).map(([areaId, url]) => {
                const area = uploadAreas.find((a) => a.id === areaId);
                return (
                  <div key={areaId} className="border-2 border-gray-200 rounded-lg p-4">
                    <h4 className="font-semibold mb-2">{area?.name}</h4>
                    <img
                      src={url}
                      alt={area?.name}
                      className="w-full h-48 object-contain bg-gray-50 rounded"
                    />
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>

            <button
              onClick={() => setStep(6)}
              className="w-full btn-primary"
            >
              Continue to Shipping Details
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Step 6: Shipping Details */}
        {step === 6 && (
          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-6">
            <button
              onClick={() => setStep(5)}
              className="text-gray-600 hover:text-black flex items-center gap-2 mb-6"
            >
              ← Back
            </button>

            <div>
              <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-2">Shipping Details</h2>
              <p className="text-gray-600">Enter your delivery information</p>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
              <div>
                <label htmlFor="pod-name" className="block mb-2 font-medium">
                  Full Name <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                </label>
                <input
                  id="pod-name"
                  type="text"
                  value={formData.customerName}
                  onChange={(e) => handleChange('customerName', e.target.value)}
                  className={`w-full px-4 py-3 border-2 rounded-xl focus:outline-none focus:border-black transition-colors ${
                    fieldErrors.customerName ? 'border-red-500' : 'border-gray-200'
                  }`}
                  placeholder="John Doe"
                />
                {fieldErrors.customerName && (
                  <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-red-600">{fieldErrors.customerName}</p>
                )}
              </div>

              <div>
                <label htmlFor="pod-email" className="block mb-2 font-medium">
                  Email <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                </label>
                <input
                  id="pod-email"
                  type="email"
                  value={formData.customerEmail}
                  onChange={(e) => handleChange('customerEmail', e.target.value)}
                  className={`w-full px-4 py-3 border-2 rounded-xl focus:outline-none focus:border-black transition-colors ${
                    fieldErrors.customerEmail ? 'border-red-500' : 'border-gray-200'
                  }`}
                  placeholder="john@example.com"
                />
                {fieldErrors.customerEmail && (
                  <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-red-600">{fieldErrors.customerEmail}</p>
                )}
              </div>

              <div>
                <label htmlFor="pod-phone" className="block mb-2 font-medium">
                  Phone <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                </label>
                <input
                  id="pod-phone"
                  type="tel"
                  value={formData.customerPhone}
                  onChange={(e) => handleChange('customerPhone', e.target.value)}
                  className={`w-full px-4 py-3 border-2 rounded-xl focus:outline-none focus:border-black transition-colors ${
                    fieldErrors.customerPhone ? 'border-red-500' : 'border-gray-200'
                  }`}
                  placeholder="+1 234 567 8900"
                />
                {fieldErrors.customerPhone && (
                  <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-red-600">{fieldErrors.customerPhone}</p>
                )}
              </div>

              <div className="md:col-span-2">
                <label htmlFor="pod-address" className="block mb-2 font-medium">
                  Shipping Address <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                </label>
                <textarea
                  id="pod-address"
                  value={formData.customerAddress}
                  onChange={(e) => handleChange('customerAddress', e.target.value)}
                  rows={3}
                  className={`w-full px-4 py-3 border-2 rounded-xl focus:outline-none focus:border-black transition-colors resize-none ${
                    fieldErrors.customerAddress ? 'border-red-500' : 'border-gray-200'
                  }`}
                  placeholder="123 Main St, City, State, ZIP"
                />
                {fieldErrors.customerAddress && (
                  <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-red-600">{fieldErrors.customerAddress}</p>
                )}
              </div>

              <div className="md:col-span-2">
                <label htmlFor="pod-notes" className="block mb-2 font-medium">
                  Additional Notes (Optional)
                </label>
                <textarea
                  id="pod-notes"
                  value={formData.notes}
                  onChange={(e) => handleChange('notes', e.target.value)}
                  rows={3}
                  className="w-full px-4 py-3 border-2 border-gray-200 rounded-xl focus:outline-none focus:border-black transition-colors resize-none"
                  placeholder="Any special instructions..."
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={isSubmitting}
              className="w-full btn-primary text-lg py-4 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
            >
              {isSubmitting ? 'Placing Order...' : 'Place Order (COD)'}
            </button>
          </form>
        )}

        {/* Step 7: Success */}
        {step === 7 && submitSuccess && (
          <div className="text-center space-y-6 py-12">
            <div className="w-20 h-20 bg-black rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mx-auto">
              <svg
                className="w-10 h-10 text-white"
                fill="none"
                stroke="currentColor"
                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
              >
                <path
                  strokeLinecap="round"
                  strokeLinejoin="round"
                  strokeWidth={3}
                  d="M5 13l4 4L19 7"
                />
              </svg>
            </div>
            <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold">Order Placed Successfully!</h2>
            <p className="text-gray-600 max-w-md mx-auto text-lg">
              Thank you for your custom order! We'll contact you soon to confirm the details and
              arrange delivery.
            </p>
            <div className="flex gap-4 justify-center pt-6">
              <button onClick={resetForm} className="btn-primary">
                Create Another Design
              </button>
              <a href="/" className="btn-secondary">
                Back to Home
              </a>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```javascriptreact
'use client';

/**
 * Checkout Page
 * Order form and confirmation
 */

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useCart } from '@/context/CartContext';
import CartSummary from '@/components/CartSummary';
import { sendRegularOrderEmail } from '@/lib/order-email';
import { sendCustomerOrderConfirmation } from '@/lib/customer-email';
import { validateForm, commonRules } from '@/lib/validation';
import { trackPurchase } from '@/lib/analytics';

export default function CheckoutPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { cart, clearCart, getCartTotal, getCartItemsCount } = useCart();
  const toast = useToast();
  
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    customerName: '',
    customerEmail: '',
    customerPhone: '',
    customerAddress: '',
    notes: '',
  });

  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState({});

  // Redirect if cart is empty
  useEffect(() => {
    if (cart.length === 0 && !isSubmitting) {
      router.push('/cart');
    }
  }, [cart.length, isSubmitting, router]);

  // Show loading while redirecting
  if (cart.length === 0) {
    return (
      <main className="min-h-screen bg-gray-50 flex items-center justify-center">
        <div className="text-center">
          <p className="text-gray-600">Redirecting to cart...</p>
        </div>
      </main>
    );
  }

  const handleChange = (field, value) => {
    setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, [field]: value }));
    // Clear field error when user starts typing
    if (fieldErrors[field]) {
      setFieldErrors((prev) => {
        const newErrors = { ...prev };
        delete newErrors[field];
        return newErrors;
      });
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setFieldErrors({});

    // Validate form
    const validation = validateForm(formData, commonRules);
    if (!validation.isValid) {
      setFieldErrors(validation.errors);
      toast.error('Please fix the errors in the form');
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);

    try {
      const orderInfo = {
        ...formData,
        items: cart,
      };

      // Send order email to business
      await sendRegularOrderEmail(orderInfo);

      // Send confirmation email to customer (non-blocking)
      sendCustomerOrderConfirmation(orderInfo).catch(err => {
        console.error('Failed to send customer confirmation:', err);
        // Don't block the order - just log the error
      });

      // Track purchase in analytics
      const subtotal = getCartTotal();
      const shipping = subtotal > 100 ? 0 : 10;
      trackPurchase({ total: subtotal + shipping });

      // Clear cart
      clearCart();

      // Show success message
      toast.success('Order placed successfully! Check your email for confirmation.');
```

```javascriptreact
'use client';

/**
 * Checkout Page
 * Order form and confirmation
 */

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useCart } from '@/context/CartContext';
import CartSummary from '@/components/CartSummary';
import { sendRegularOrderEmail } from '@/lib/order-email';
import { sendCustomerOrderConfirmation } from '@/lib/customer-email';
import { validateForm, commonRules } from '@/lib/validation';
import { trackPurchase } from '@/lib/analytics';

export default function CheckoutPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { cart, clearCart, getCartTotal, getCartItemsCount } = useCart();
  
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    customerName: '',
    customerEmail: '',
    customerPhone: '',
    customerAddress: '',
    notes: '',
  });

  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState({});

  // Redirect if cart is empty
  useEffect(() => {
    if (cart.length === 0 && !isSubmitting) {
      router.push('/cart');
    }
  }, [cart.length, isSubmitting, router]);

  // Show loading while redirecting
  if (cart.length === 0) {
    return (
      <main className="min-h-screen bg-gray-50 flex items-center justify-center">
        <div className="text-center">
          <p className="text-gray-600">Redirecting to cart...</p>
        </div>
      </main>
    );
  }

  const handleChange = (field, value) => {
    setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, [field]: value }));
    // Clear field error when user starts typing
    if (fieldErrors[field]) {
      setFieldErrors((prev) => {
        const newErrors = { ...prev };
        delete newErrors[field];
        return newErrors;
      });
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setFieldErrors({});

    // Validate form
    const validation = validateForm(formData, commonRules);
    if (!validation.isValid) {
      setFieldErrors(validation.errors);
      toast.error('Please fix the errors in the form');
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);

    try {
      const orderInfo = {
        ...formData,
        items: cart,
      };

      // Send order email to business
      await sendRegularOrderEmail(orderInfo);

      // Send confirmation email to customer (non-blocking)
      sendCustomerOrderConfirmation(orderInfo).catch(err => {
        console.error('Failed to send customer confirmation:', err);
        // Don't block the order - just log the error
      });

      // Track purchase in analytics
      const subtotal = getCartTotal();
      const shipping = subtotal > 100 ? 0 : 10;
      trackPurchase({ total: subtotal + shipping });

      // Clear cart
      clearCart();

      // Show success message
      toast.success('Order placed successfully! Check your email for confirmation.');

      // Redirect to success page
      setTimeout(() => {
        router.push('/checkout/success');
      }, 500);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Order submission error:', err);
      toast.error('Failed to submit order. Please try again.');
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-gray-50">
      {/* Header */}
      <section className="bg-gradient-to-b from-gray-50 to-white border-b border-gray-200">
        <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-12 sm:py-16">
          <h1 className="text-3xl sm:text-4xl md:text-5xl font-bold animate-fade-in">
            Checkout
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm sm:text-base text-gray-600 mt-2">
            Complete your order
          </p>
        </div>
      </section>

      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8 sm:py-12">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6 lg:gap-8">
          {/* Checkout Form */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-2">
            <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-xl p-4 sm:p-6 md:p-8 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow">
              <h2 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold mb-4 sm:mb-6">Shipping Information</h2>

              <div className="space-y-6">
                {/* Full Name */}
                <div>
                  <label htmlFor="customer-name" className="block mb-2 font-medium">
                    Full Name <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                  </label>
                  <input
                    id="customer-name"
                    type="text"
                    value={formData.customerName}
                    onChange={(e) => handleChange('customerName', e.target.value)}
                    className={`w-full px-4 py-3 border rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-black ${
                      fieldErrors.customerName ? 'border-red-500' : 'border-gray-300'
                    }`}
                    placeholder="John Doe"
                    aria-invalid={!!fieldErrors.customerName}
                    aria-describedby={fieldErrors.customerName ? 'name-error' : undefined}
                  />
                  {fieldErrors.customerName && (
                    <p id="name-error" className="mt-1 text-sm text-red-600" role="alert">
                      {fieldErrors.customerName}
                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Email */}
                <div>
                  <label htmlFor="customer-email" className="block mb-2 font-medium">
                    Email Address <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                  </label>
                  <input
                    id="customer-email"
                    type="email"
                    value={formData.customerEmail}
                    onChange={(e) => handleChange('customerEmail', e.target.value)}
                    className={`w-full px-4 py-3 border rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-black ${
                      fieldErrors.customerEmail ? 'border-red-500' : 'border-gray-300'
                    }`}
                    placeholder="john@example.com"
                    aria-invalid={!!fieldErrors.customerEmail}
                    aria-describedby={fieldErrors.customerEmail ? 'email-error' : undefined}
                  />
                  {fieldErrors.customerEmail && (
                    <p id="email-error" className="mt-1 text-sm text-red-600" role="alert">
                      {fieldErrors.customerEmail}
                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Phone */}
                <div>
                  <label htmlFor="customer-phone" className="block mb-2 font-medium">
                    Phone Number <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                  </label>
                  <input
                    id="customer-phone"
                    type="tel"
                    value={formData.customerPhone}
                    onChange={(e) => handleChange('customerPhone', e.target.value)}
                    className={`w-full px-4 py-3 border rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-black ${
                      fieldErrors.customerPhone ? 'border-red-500' : 'border-gray-300'
                    }`}
                    placeholder="+1 234 567 8900"
                    aria-invalid={!!fieldErrors.customerPhone}
                    aria-describedby={fieldErrors.customerPhone ? 'phone-error' : undefined}
                  />
                  {fieldErrors.customerPhone && (
                    <p id="phone-error" className="mt-1 text-sm text-red-600" role="alert">
                      {fieldErrors.customerPhone}
                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Address */}
                <div>
                  <label htmlFor="customer-address" className="block mb-2 font-medium">
                    Shipping Address <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                  </label>
                  <textarea
                    id="customer-address"
                    value={formData.customerAddress}
                    onChange={(e) => handleChange('customerAddress', e.target.value)}
                    rows={4}
                    className={`w-full px-4 py-3 border rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-black resize-none ${
                      fieldErrors.customerAddress ? 'border-red-500' : 'border-gray-300'
                    }`}
                    placeholder="Street address, City, State, ZIP Code"
                    aria-invalid={!!fieldErrors.customerAddress}
                    aria-describedby={fieldErrors.customerAddress ? 'address-error' : undefined}
                  />
                  {fieldErrors.customerAddress && (
                    <p id="address-error" className="mt-1 text-sm text-red-600" role="alert">
                      {fieldErrors.customerAddress}
                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Notes */}
                <div>
                  <label htmlFor="order-notes" className="block mb-2 font-medium">
                    Order Notes (Optional)
                  </label>
                  <textarea
                    id="order-notes"
                    value={formData.notes}
                    onChange={(e) => handleChange('notes', e.target.value)}
                    rows={3}
                    className="w-full px-4 py-3 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-black resize-none"
                    placeholder="Any special instructions for your order..."
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Payment Method */}
              <div className="mt-8 p-6 bg-yellow-50 border border-yellow-200 rounded-lg">
                <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                  <svg
                    className="w-6 h-6 text-yellow-600 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5"
                    fill="none"
                    stroke="currentColor"
                    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                  >
                    <path
                      strokeLinecap="round"
                      strokeLinejoin="round"
                      strokeWidth={2}
                      d="M12 8c-1.657 0-3 .895-3 2s1.343 2 3 2 3 .895 3 2-1.343 2-3 2m0-8c1.11 0 2.08.402 2.599 1M12 8V7m0 1v8m0 0v1m0-1c-1.11 0-2.08-.402-2.599-1M21 12a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z"
                    />
                  </svg>
                  <div>
                    <h3 className="font-bold text-yellow-800 mb-1">
                      Payment Method: Cash on Delivery
                    </h3>
                    <p className="text-sm text-yellow-700">
                      You'll pay when you receive your order. We'll contact you to confirm delivery details.
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Submit Button */}
              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={isSubmitting}
                className="w-full mt-8 btn-primary text-lg py-4 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
              >
                {isSubmitting ? 'Processing Order...' : 'Place Order'}
              </button>
            </form>
          </div>

          {/* Order Summary */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-1">
            <CartSummary showCheckoutButton={false} />

            {/* Order Items Preview */}
            <div className="mt-6 bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-xl p-6">
              <h3 className="font-bold text-lg mb-4">Order Items ({getCartItemsCount()})</h3>
              <div className="space-y-3">
                {cart.map((item) => (
                  <div key={item.cartItemId} className="flex justify-between text-sm">
                    <div className="flex-1">
                      <p className="font-medium">{item.title}</p>
                      <p className="text-gray-600 text-xs">
                        {item.selectedSize} • {item.selectedColor} • Qty: {item.quantity}
                      </p>

                    <p className="font-bold">
```

```javascriptreact
                      fieldErrors.customerPhone ? 'border-red-500' : 'border-gray-300'
                    }`}
                    placeholder="+1 234 567 8900"

                    aria-describedby={fieldErrors.customerPhone ? 'phone-error' : undefined}

                  {fieldErrors.customerPhone && (
                    <p id="phone-error" className="mt-1 text-sm text-red-600" role="alert">

                {/* Address */}
                <div>
                  <label htmlFor="customer-address" className="block mb-2 font-medium">

                  <textarea
                    id="customer-address"
                    value={formData.customerAddress}
                    onChange={(e) => handleChange('customerAddress', e.target.value)}
                    rows={4}
                    className={`w-full px-4 py-3 border rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-black resize-none ${
                      fieldErrors.customerAddress ? 'border-red-500' : 'border-gray-300'
                    }`}
                    placeholder="Street address, City, State, ZIP Code"
                    aria-invalid={!!fieldErrors.customerAddress}
                    aria-describedby={fieldErrors.customerAddress ? 'address-error' : undefined}
                  />
                  {fieldErrors.customerAddress && (
                    <p id="address-error" className="mt-1 text-sm text-red-600" role="alert">
                      {fieldErrors.customerAddress}
                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Notes */}
                <div>
                  <label htmlFor="order-notes" className="block mb-2 font-medium">

                  <textarea
                    id="order-notes"
                    value={formData.notes}
                    onChange={(e) => handleChange('notes', e.target.value)}
                    rows={3}
                    className="w-full px-4 py-3 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-black resize-none"
                    placeholder="Any special instructions for your order..."

                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Payment Method */}
              <div className="mt-8 p-6 bg-yellow-50 border border-yellow-200 rounded-lg">
                <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                  <svg
                    className="w-6 h-6 text-yellow-600 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5"

                    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                  >
                    <path
                      strokeLinecap="round"
                      strokeLinejoin="round"
                      strokeWidth={2}
                      d="M12 8c-1.657 0-3 .895-3 2s1.343 2 3 2 3 .895 3 2-1.343 2-3 2m0-8c1.11 0 2.08.402 2.599 1M12 8V7m0 1v8m0 0v1m0-1c-1.11 0-2.08-.402-2.599-1M21 12a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z"

                  <div>
                    <h3 className="font-bold text-yellow-800 mb-1">
                      Payment Method: Cash on Delivery

              {/* Submit Button */}

          </div>

          {/* Order Summary */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-1">
            <CartSummary showCheckoutButton={false} />

            {/* Order Items Preview */}
            <div className="mt-6 bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-xl p-6">

              <div className="space-y-3">
                {cart.map((item) => (

                        {item.selectedSize} • {item.selectedColor} • Qty: {item.quantity}

                    <p className="font-bold">
                      ${(item.price * item.quantity).toFixed(2)}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}
```

```javascriptreact
'use client';

/**
 * Checkout Page
 * Order form and confirmation
 */

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useCart } from '@/context/CartContext';
import CartSummary from '@/components/CartSummary';
import { sendRegularOrderEmail } from '@/lib/order-email';
import { sendCustomerOrderConfirmation } from '@/lib/customer-email';
import { validateForm, commonRules } from '@/lib/validation';
import { trackPurchase } from '@/lib/analytics';

export default function CheckoutPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { cart, clearCart, getCartTotal, getCartItemsCount } = useCart();
  
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    customerName: '',
    customerEmail: '',
    customerPhone: '',
    customerAddress: '',
    notes: '',
  });

  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState({});

  // Redirect if cart is empty
  useEffect(() => {
    if (cart.length === 0 && !isSubmitting) {
      router.push('/cart');
    }
  }, [cart.length, isSubmitting, router]);

  // Show loading while redirecting
  if (cart.length === 0) {
    return (
      <main className="min-h-screen bg-gray-50 flex items-center justify-center">
        <div className="text-center">
          <p className="text-gray-600">Redirecting to cart...</p>
        </div>
      </main>
    );
  }

  const handleChange = (field, value) => {
    setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, [field]: value }));
    // Clear field error when user starts typing
    if (fieldErrors[field]) {
      setFieldErrors((prev) => {
        const newErrors = { ...prev };
        delete newErrors[field];
        return newErrors;
      });
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setFieldErrors({});

    // Validate form
    const validation = validateForm(formData, commonRules);
    if (!validation.isValid) {
      setFieldErrors(validation.errors);
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);

    try {
      const orderInfo = {
        ...formData,
        items: cart,
      };

      // Send order email to business
      await sendRegularOrderEmail(orderInfo);

      // Send confirmation email to customer (non-blocking)
      sendCustomerOrderConfirmation(orderInfo).catch(err => {
        console.error('Failed to send customer confirmation:', err);
        // Don't block the order - just log the error
      });

      // Track purchase in analytics
      const subtotal = getCartTotal();
      const shipping = subtotal > 100 ? 0 : 10;
      trackPurchase({ total: subtotal + shipping });

      // Clear cart
      clearCart();

      // Redirect to success page
      setTimeout(() => {
        router.push('/checkout/success');
      }, 500);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Order submission error:', err);
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-gray-50">
      {/* Header */}
      <section className="bg-gradient-to-b from-gray-50 to-white border-b border-gray-200">
        <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-12 sm:py-16">
          <h1 className="text-3xl sm:text-4xl md:text-5xl font-bold animate-fade-in">
            Checkout
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm sm:text-base text-gray-600 mt-2">
            Complete your order
          </p>
        </div>
      </section>

      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8 sm:py-12">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6 lg:gap-8">
          {/* Checkout Form */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-2">
            <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-xl p-4 sm:p-6 md:p-8 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow">
              <h2 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold mb-4 sm:mb-6">Shipping Information</h2>

              <div className="space-y-6">
                {/* Full Name */}
                <div>
                  <label htmlFor="customer-name" className="block mb-2 font-medium">
                    Full Name <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                  </label>
                  <input
                    id="customer-name"
                    type="text"
                    value={formData.customerName}
                    onChange={(e) => handleChange('customerName', e.target.value)}
                    className={`w-full px-4 py-3 border rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-black ${
                      fieldErrors.customerName ? 'border-red-500' : 'border-gray-300'
                    }`}
                    placeholder="John Doe"
                    aria-invalid={!!fieldErrors.customerName}
                    aria-describedby={fieldErrors.customerName ? 'name-error' : undefined}
                  />
                  {fieldErrors.customerName && (
                    <p id="name-error" className="mt-1 text-sm text-red-600" role="alert">
                      {fieldErrors.customerName}
                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Email */}
                <div>
                  <label htmlFor="customer-email" className="block mb-2 font-medium">
                    Email Address <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                  </label>
                  <input
                    id="customer-email"
                    type="email"
                    value={formData.customerEmail}
                    onChange={(e) => handleChange('customerEmail', e.target.value)}
                    className={`w-full px-4 py-3 border rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-black ${
                      fieldErrors.customerEmail ? 'border-red-500' : 'border-gray-300'
                    }`}
                    placeholder="john@example.com"
                    aria-invalid={!!fieldErrors.customerEmail}
                    aria-describedby={fieldErrors.customerEmail ? 'email-error' : undefined}
                  />
                  {fieldErrors.customerEmail && (
                    <p id="email-error" className="mt-1 text-sm text-red-600" role="alert">
                      {fieldErrors.customerEmail}
                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Phone */}
                <div>
                  <label htmlFor="customer-phone" className="block mb-2 font-medium">
                    Phone Number <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                  </label>
                  <input
                    id="customer-phone"
                    type="tel"
                    value={formData.customerPhone}
                    onChange={(e) => handleChange('customerPhone', e.target.value)}
                    className={`w-full px-4 py-3 border rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-black ${
                      fieldErrors.customerPhone ? 'border-red-500' : 'border-gray-300'
                    }`}
                    placeholder="+1 234 567 8900"
                    aria-invalid={!!fieldErrors.customerPhone}
                    aria-describedby={fieldErrors.customerPhone ? 'phone-error' : undefined}
                  />
                  {fieldErrors.customerPhone && (
                    <p id="phone-error" className="mt-1 text-sm text-red-600" role="alert">
                      {fieldErrors.customerPhone}
                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Address */}
                <div>
                  <label htmlFor="customer-address" className="block mb-2 font-medium">
                    Shipping Address <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                  </label>
                  <textarea
                    id="customer-address"
                    value={formData.customerAddress}
                    onChange={(e) => handleChange('customerAddress', e.target.value)}
                    rows={4}
                    className={`w-full px-4 py-3 border rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-black resize-none ${
                      fieldErrors.customerAddress ? 'border-red-500' : 'border-gray-300'
                    }`}
                    placeholder="Street address, City, State, ZIP Code"
                    aria-invalid={!!fieldErrors.customerAddress}
                    aria-describedby={fieldErrors.customerAddress ? 'address-error' : undefined}
                  />
                  {fieldErrors.customerAddress && (
                    <p id="address-error" className="mt-1 text-sm text-red-600" role="alert">
                      {fieldErrors.customerAddress}
                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Notes */}
                <div>
                  <label htmlFor="order-notes" className="block mb-2 font-medium">
                    Order Notes (Optional)
                  </label>
                  <textarea
                    id="order-notes"
                    value={formData.notes}
                    onChange={(e) => handleChange('notes', e.target.value)}
                    rows={3}
                    className="w-full px-4 py-3 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-black resize-none"
                    placeholder="Any special instructions for your order..."
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Payment Method */}
              <div className="mt-8 p-6 bg-yellow-50 border border-yellow-200 rounded-lg">
                <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                  <svg
                    className="w-6 h-6 text-yellow-600 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5"
                    fill="none"
                    stroke="currentColor"
                    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                  >
                    <path
                      strokeLinecap="round"
                      strokeLinejoin="round"
                      strokeWidth={2}
                      d="M12 8c-1.657 0-3 .895-3 2s1.343 2 3 2 3 .895 3 2-1.343 2-3 2m0-8c1.11 0 2.08.402 2.599 1M12 8V7m0 1v8m0 0v1m0-1c-1.11 0-2.08-.402-2.599-1M21 12a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z"
                    />
                  </svg>
                  <div>
                    <h3 className="font-bold text-yellow-800 mb-1">
                      Payment Method: Cash on Delivery
                    </h3>
                    <p className="text-sm text-yellow-700">
                      You'll pay when you receive your order. We'll contact you to confirm delivery details.
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Submit Button */}
              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={isSubmitting}
                className="w-full mt-8 btn-primary text-lg py-4 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
              >
                {isSubmitting ? 'Processing Order...' : 'Place Order'}
              </button>
            </form>
          </div>

          {/* Order Summary */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-1">
            <CartSummary showCheckoutButton={false} />

            {/* Order Items Preview */}
            <div className="mt-6 bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-xl p-6">
              <h3 className="font-bold text-lg mb-4">Order Items ({getCartItemsCount()})</h3>
              <div className="space-y-3">
                {cart.map((item) => (
                  <div key={item.cartItemId} className="flex justify-between text-sm">
                    <div className="flex-1">
                      <p className="font-medium">{item.title}</p>
                      <p className="text-gray-600 text-xs">
                        {item.selectedSize} • {item.selectedColor} • Qty: {item.quantity}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                    <p className="font-bold">
                      ${(item.price * item.quantity).toFixed(2)}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}
```

```javascriptreact
'use client';

/**
 * ProductDetail Component
 * Interactive product detail with Add to Cart
 */

import { useState } from 'react';
import Image from 'next/image';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useCart } from '@/context/CartContext';
import { trackAddToCart } from '@/lib/analytics';

export default function ProductDetail({ product }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { addToCart } = useCart();
  const toast = useToast();

  const [selectedSize, setSelectedSize] = useState(product.sizes[0] || '');
  const [selectedColor, setSelectedColor] = useState(product.colors[0]?.name || '');
  const [quantity, setQuantity] = useState(1);
  const [addedToCart, setAddedToCart] = useState(false);

  const handleAddToCart = () => {
    if (!selectedSize || !selectedColor) {
      toast.warning('Please select size and color');
      return;
    }

    addToCart(product, selectedSize, selectedColor, quantity);
    setAddedToCart(true);
    
    // Track analytics
    trackAddToCart(product);
    
    toast.success(`Added ${quantity} ${product.title} to cart!`);

    // Reset notification after 3 seconds
    setTimeout(() => {
      setAddedToCart(false);
    }, 3000);
  };

  const handleBuyNow = () => {
    handleAddToCart();
    router.push('/cart');
  };

  return (
    <>
      {/* Success Notification */}
      {addedToCart && (
        <div className="fixed top-20 right-4 bg-green-600 text-white px-6 py-4 rounded-lg shadow-lg z-50 animate-slide-in">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <svg
              className="w-6 h-6"
              fill="none"
              stroke="currentColor"
              viewBox="0 0 24 24"
            >
              <path
                strokeLinecap="round"
                strokeLinejoin="round"
                strokeWidth={2}
                d="M5 13l4 4L19 7"
              />
            </svg>
            <span className="font-medium">Added to cart!</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-12">
        {/* Product Images */}
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div className="aspect-square bg-gray-100 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border border-gray-200 relative">
            {product.images[0] ? (
              <Image
                src={product.images[0]}
                alt={product.title}
                fill
                className="object-cover"
              />
            ) : (
              <div className="w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center">
                <svg
                  className="w-32 h-32 text-gray-300"
                  fill="none"
                  stroke="currentColor"
                  viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                >
                  <path
                    strokeLinecap="round"
                    strokeLinejoin="round"
                    strokeWidth={1}
                    d="M4 16l4.586-4.586a2 2 0 012.828 0L16 16m-2-2l1.586-1.586a2 2 0 012.828 0L20 14m-6-6h.01M6 20h12a2 2 0 002-2V6a2 2 0 00-2-2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v12a2 2 0 002 2z"
                  />
                </svg>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Product Details */}
        <div className="space-y-6">
          <div>
            <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wide mb-2">
              {product.category}
            </p>
            <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold mb-3">{product.title}</h1>
            <p className="text-3xl font-bold">${product.price.toFixed(2)}</p>
          </div>

          <p className="text-lg text-gray-600 leading-relaxed">
            {product.description}
          </p>

          {/* Size Selection */}
          <div>
            <label className="block font-semibold mb-3 text-lg">
              Size: <span className="text-gray-600 font-normal">{selectedSize}</span>
            </label>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
              {product.sizes.map((size) => (
                <button
                  key={size}
                  onClick={() => setSelectedSize(size)}
                  className={`px-6 py-3 border-2 rounded-lg font-medium transition-all ${
                    selectedSize === size
                      ? 'border-black bg-black text-white'
                      : 'border-gray-300 hover:border-black'
                  }`}
                >
                  {size}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Color Selection */}
          <div>
            <label className="block font-semibold mb-3 text-lg">
              Color: <span className="text-gray-600 font-normal">{selectedColor}</span>
            </label>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
              {product.colors.map((color) => (
                <button
                  key={color.name}
                  onClick={() => setSelectedColor(color.name)}
                  className={`px-6 py-3 border-2 rounded-lg font-medium transition-all flex items-center gap-2 ${
                    selectedColor === color.name
                      ? 'border-black bg-black text-white'
                      : 'border-gray-300 hover:border-black'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div
                    className="w-5 h-5 rounded-full border-2"
                    style={{
                      backgroundColor: color.hex,
                      borderColor: color.hex === '#FFFFFF' ? '#e5e7eb' : color.hex,
                    }}
                  ></div>
                  {color.name}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Quantity */}
          <div>
            <label className="block font-semibold mb-3 text-lg">Quantity</label>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
              <button
                onClick={() => setQuantity(Math.max(1, quantity - 1))}
                className="w-12 h-12 border-2 border-gray-300 rounded-lg hover:border-black transition-colors font-medium text-xl"
              >
                −
              </button>
              <span className="text-2xl font-bold w-12 text-center">{quantity}</span>
              <button
                onClick={() => setQuantity(quantity + 1)}
                className="w-12 h-12 border-2 border-gray-300 rounded-lg hover:border-black transition-colors font-medium text-xl"
              >
                +
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Add to Cart Buttons */}
          <div className="space-y-3 pt-6">
            {product.inStock ? (
              <>
                <button
                  onClick={handleAddToCart}
                  className="w-full btn-primary text-lg py-4"
                >
                  Add to Cart - ${(product.price * quantity).toFixed(2)}
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={handleBuyNow}
                  className="w-full btn-secondary text-lg py-4"
                >
                  Buy Now
                </button>
              </>
            ) : (
              <button
                disabled
                className="w-full bg-gray-300 text-gray-600 px-8 py-4 rounded-lg font-medium cursor-not-allowed text-lg"
              >
                Out of Stock
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Features */}
          <div className="border-t border-gray-200 pt-6">
            <h3 className="font-bold text-xl mb-4">Features</h3>
            <ul className="space-y-2">
              {product.features.map((feature, index) => (
                <li key={index} className="flex items-start">
                  <svg
                    className="w-6 h-6 text-black mr-2 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5"
                    fill="none"
                    stroke="currentColor"
                    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                  >
                    <path
                      strokeLinecap="round"
                      strokeLinejoin="round"
                      strokeWidth={2}
                      d="M5 13l4 4L19 7"
                    />
                  </svg>
                  <span className="text-gray-700">{feature}</span>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
```

## 🗑️ **Removed Toast System Completely**

### **2. Updated Layout:**

- Removed `ToastProvider` wrapper

**`src/components/ProductCard.jsx`**

```javascriptreact
            </svg>
            <h2 className="text-2xl font-semibold mb-2">Your wishlist is empty</h2>
            <p className="text-gray-600 mb-8">Start adding products you love!</p>
            <Link
              href="/products"
              className="px-8 py-3 bg-black text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-800 transition-all duration-300 hover:scale-105 font-medium"
            >
              Browse Products
            </Link>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-white pt-24 pb-20">
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between mb-12 gap-4">
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold mb-2">My Wishlist</h1>
            <p className="text-gray-600 text-lg">{wishlist.length} {wishlist.length === 1 ? 'item' : 'items'}</p>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={() => {
              clearWishlist();
            }}
            className="px-6 py-2.5 border border-red-500 text-red-500 rounded-lg hover:bg-red-500 hover:text-white transition-all duration-300 font-medium"
          >
            Clear All
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Wishlist Grid */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-6">
          {wishlist.map((product) => (
            <article
              key={product.id}
              className="group bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-xl overflow-hidden hover:shadow-2xl transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1 flex flex-col"
            >
              {/* Product Image */}
              <div className="relative">
                <Link href={`/products/${product.slug}`}>
                  <div className="relative aspect-square bg-gray-50 overflow-hidden cursor-pointer">
                    {product.images && product.images[0] ? (
                      <Image
                        src={product.images[0]}
                        alt={product.title}
                        fill
                        className="object-cover group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform duration-500"
                      />
                    ) : (
                      <div className="w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center">
                        <svg className="w-20 h-20 text-gray-300" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                          <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={1} d="M4 16l4.586-4.586a2 2 0 012.828 0L16 16m-2-2l1.586-1.586a2 2 0 012.828 0L20 14m-6-6h.01M6 20h12a2 2 0 002-2V6a2 2 0 00-2-2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v12a2 2 0 002 2z" />
                        </svg>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </Link>

                {/* Remove Button */}
                <button
                  onClick={() => {
                    removeFromWishlist(product.id);
                  }}
                  className="absolute top-3 right-3 w-9 h-9 flex items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-white text-black border border-black hover:bg-red-500 hover:text-white hover:border-red-500 transition-all duration-300 hover:scale-110 z-10"
                  aria-label="Remove from wishlist"
                >
                  <svg className="w-5 h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                    <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12" />
                  </svg>
                </button>
              </div>

              {/* Product Info */}
              <div className="p-4 flex flex-col flex-1">
                <Link href={`/products/${product.slug}`}>
                  <h3 className="text-base font-semibold mb-2 hover:text-gray-600 transition-colors cursor-pointer line-clamp-2">
                    {product.title}
                  </h3>
                </Link>
                <p className="text-xl font-bold mb-4">${product.price.toFixed(2)}</p>

                {/* Spacer */}
                <div className="flex-1"></div>

                {/* Action Buttons */}
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <button
                    onClick={() => handleAddToCart(product)}
                    disabled={!product.inStock}
                    className={`flex-1 py-2.5 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium transition-all duration-300 ${
                      product.inStock
                        ? 'bg-black text-white hover:bg-gray-800 hover:scale-105'
                        : 'bg-gray-300 text-gray-500 cursor-not-allowed'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {product.inStock ? 'Add to Cart' : 'Out of Stock'}
                  </button>
                  
                  {product.inStock && (
                    <button
                      onClick={() => handleBuyNow(product)}
                      className="p-2.5 bg-black text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-800 transition-all duration-300 hover:scale-110"
                      aria-label="Buy now"
                    >
                      <svg className="w-5 h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                        <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M13 7l5 5m0 0l-5 5m5-5H6" />
                      </svg>
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            </article>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


```

Perfect! ✅ I've removed the confirmation dialog. 

**Before:**
```javascript
onClick={() => {
  if (confirm('Are you sure you want to clear your entire wishlist?')) {
    clearWishlist();
  }
}}
```

**After:**
```javascript
onClick={() => {
  clearWishlist();
}}
```

Now clicking the **"Clear All"** button will immediately clear the wishlist without showing any confirmation dialog! 🎯

```javascript
onClick={() => {
  if (confirm('Are you sure you want to clear your entire wishlist?')) {
    clearWishlist();
  }
}}
```

```javascript
onClick={() => {
  clearWishlist();
}}
```
